killers.name: The Trapper
killers.otzComment:
The Trapper can shut down almost any window and pallet in the game and even completely lock down a small area by using several traps. While his power is slow and suffers against coordinated teams, one wrong step is all it takes for the game to turn around entirely.
The Trapper has a fairly simple power and doesn't need to be played perfectly to get decent results when you're starting out. His perks are generally not extremely impactful for beginners, but he's still worth playing to learn the basics. Once you start going against experienced opponents, the Trapper becomes much harder to play well.

teachables.name: Brutal Strength
teachables.desc:
While performing the Break or Damage action on Breakable Walls, Pallets, or Generators, Brutal Strength triggers its effect:
Increases the Action speed by 10/15/20 %.

teachables.name: Unnerving Presence
teachables.desc:
While inside your Terror Radius, Survivors performing Repairing or Healing actions suffer from the following effects:
Increases the chances of triggering a Skill Check by +10 %.
Reduces the Success zone of those Skill Checks by 40/50/60 %.

teachables.name: Agitation
teachables.desc:
While carrying a Survivor, Agitation activates:
Increases your Carrying speed by 14/16/18 %.
Increases your Terror Radius by +12 metres.

builds.name: Generic Build
notes: Reliable and well-rounded build; a good starting point until you find the ideal build for your playstyle.
Focuses heavily on gen slowdown. Agitation can help you to reliably reach your Scourge Hooks and hook in uncomfortable areas near gens or even basement, which is always scary against Trapper.

perks.name: Corrupt Intervention
perks.desc:
Your prayers invoke a dark power that meddles with the Survivors' chances of survival.
At the start of the Trial, the 3 Generators located farthest from you are blocked by The Entity for 80/100/120 seconds.
Corrupt Intervention deactivates prematurely once the first Survivor is put into the Dying State.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance
perks.desc:
Overwhelming pain reverberates outwards.
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Start the Trial with 4 Token.
Whenever a Survivor is hooked onto a Scourge Hook for the first time, Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance consumes -1 Token and applies the following effects:
Causes the Generator with the most progression to explode, damaging it.
Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by 10/15/20 % of its total Progression.
Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors repairing the Damaged Generator to scream.
This does not trigger a Loud Noise Notification.
Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance is disabled for the remainder of the Trial once all Tokens are consumed.

perks.name: Dead Man's Switch
perks.desc:
After hooking a Survivor, Dead Man's Switch triggers its effect:
The first Generator any Survivor stops repairing for 2 seconds is blocked for 30/35/40 seconds
The Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.
Dead Man's Switch cannot activate if its effect is still active from a previous activation.

alts.name: Hex: Ruin
alts.desc:
All Generators not currently being repaired experience the following effect:
Causes them to automatically regress at 100/125/150 % of the default Regression rate.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Grim Embrace
alts.desc:
Your act of servitude to The Entity has not gone unnoticed.
Each time a Survivor is hooked for the first time, Grim Embrace gains +1 Token and activates once you are at least 16 metres away from the Hook:
1-3 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 6/8/10 seconds.
4 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 40 seconds and the Aura of the Obsession is revealed to you for 6 seconds.

perks.name: Agitation
perks.desc:
While carrying a Survivor, Agitation activates:
Increases your Carrying speed by 14/16/18 %.
Increases your Terror Radius by +12 metres.

alts.name: Surge
alts.desc:
Whenever you put a Survivor into the Dying State with your Basic Attack, Surge triggers its effect:
Causes all Generators within 32 metres of your location to instantly explode and start regressing.
Instantly regresses all affected Generators by 6/7/8 %.

alts.name: Ravenous
alts.desc:
Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, Ravenous gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 4 Tokens.
For each Token:
Grants +4 % Haste Status Effect while carrying a Survivor.
Increases your hooking speed by +4 %.
Once you accumulate 4 Tokens, all Survivors suffer from the following effects:
Causes them to scream.
Inflicts the Exposed Status Effect for 80/85/90 seconds.

builds.name: Compromised Build
notes: Corrupt Intervention buys you a bit of time to set up a couple traps quickly. Later on, you'll try to keep an area of the map under control and occasionally kick gens to set up your gen-compromise perks.

These perks give you stealth, haste, attack cooldown recovery and even gen regression for a limited time. Try to trap around very strong loops; weaker ones will be very easy to outplay with these effects.
NOED can be crippling if you prepare ahead; try to get rid of strong pallets early (especially near gates) and make sure that you trigger your compromised perks on the final generator.

At the start of the Trial, the 3 Generators located farthest from you are blocked by The Entity for 80/100/120 seconds.

alts.name: Lethal Pursuer
alts.desc:
At the start of the Trial, the Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 7/8/9 seconds.
Extends the duration of all instances of a Survivor Aura being revealed to you by +2 seconds.
Lethal Pursuer benefits from its own effect.

alts.name: Whispers
alts.desc:
Whenever any Survivor is within 28/26/24 metres of your location:
Causes you to hear the sporadic whispers of The Entity, indicating a Survivor's presence.
Whenever any Survivor is outside 28/26/24 metres of your location:
Gain +5 % Haste Status Effect.

perks.name: Help Wanted
perks.desc:
After performing the Damage Generator action, Help Wanted activates:
Causes that Generator to become a Compromised Generator.
Up to 3 Generators can be Compromised at a time.
The Auras of all Compromised Generators are highlighted to you in yellow.
Once a Compromised Generator is completed, Help Wanted triggers its effects for 70/80/90 seconds:
Increases the Recovery speed of successful Basic Attacks by +25 %.
All Generators not being repaired will automatically regress at 150 % of the default Regression rate.
Additionally, all other Generators are no longer Compromised.

perks.name: Machine Learning
perks.desc:
After performing the Damage Generator action, Machine Learning activates:
Causes that Generator to become a Compromised Generator.
Up to 3 Generators can be Compromised at a time.
The Auras of all Compromised Generators are highlighted to you in yellow.
Once a Compromised Generator is completed, you benefit from the following effects for 40/50/60 seconds:
Undetectable Status Effect
+8 % Haste Status Effect
Additionally, all other Generators are no longer Compromised.

perks.name: Hex: No One Escapes Death
perks.desc:
Once the Exit Gates are powered, if there is still a Dull Totem remaining in the environment, Hex: No One Escapes Death activates and lights it:
Grants a 2/3/4 % Haste Status Effect.
Causes all Survivors to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect.
Once the Status Effect is revealed to Survivors, Hex: No One Escapes Death triggers the following effect:
The Aura of its Hex Totem is revealed to all Survivors within 4 metres.
This range gradually expands to 24 metres over the course of 30 seconds.
Hex: No One Escapes Death remains inactive if no Dull Totems are available.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Remember Me
alts.desc:
Whenever the Obsession loses a Health State by any means, Remember Me gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 3/4/5 Tokens:
Increases the Opening time of both Exit Gates by a stack-able 6 seconds per Token, up to a maximum additional Opening time of 18/24/30 seconds.
This results in a maximum possible Opening time of 38/44/50 seconds for both Exit Gates.
Remember Me does not apply its penalty to the Obsession, allowing them to open both Exit Gates in the default time of 20 seconds.
You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

builds.name: Stealth Gen Block Build
notes: Variation of the "Stealth & Stall" build that works wonder here. You'll become Undetectable throughout the match thanks to Secret Project and will be able to contest generators with your 4th perk.

Whenever a Totem is blessed or cleansed, a random unblocked generator becomes blocked for  20/25/30 seconds.
Whenever any number of Generators become blocked, you gain Undetectable Status Effect for 30 seconds.

perks.name: Thrilling Tremors
perks.desc:
After picking up a Survivor, Thrilling Tremors triggers its effects:
Blocks all Generators not currently being repaired by any Survivors for 16 seconds.
The Auras of Blocked Generators are highlighted to you in white.
Thrilling Tremors has a cool-down of 40/35/30 seconds.

Each time a Generator is completed, No Holds Barred calls upon The Entity for the following effects:

The Aura of the Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.

perks.name: Turn Back the Clock
perks.desc: After hooking a Survivor, for 40/50/60 seconds, press the Active Ability button to make a target generator within 20 meters explode, lose -10 % progress, and start regressing.

alts.name: Undone
alts.desc:
For every time you hook a Survivor, Undone gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 1/2/3 Token(s).
Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator consumes all accumulated Tokens and applies the following effects:
Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by a stack-able -10 % of its total Progression per Token, up to a maximum of 10/20/30 %.
Blocks the Damaged Generator for 10 seconds per Token, up to a maximum of 10/20/30 seconds.
Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing once it becomes unblocked.

After hooking a Survivor, Dead Man's Switch triggers its effect:
The first Generator any Survivor stops repairing for 2 seconds is blocked for 30/35/40 seconds
The Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.

builds.name: Beginner Perks Only
notes: Only uses perks available to this Killer or global perks available to everyone. It might include some alternative perk ideas from one of the five free Killers too.

Whispers will let you know if someone is nearby (so you're aware that any traps placed might get spotted). It's a great tool to quickly find Survivors early on after quickly setting down a trap or two and will also help later to make sure you never search empty areas. Try one of the suggested alternatives instead if you prefer.
Agitation allows us to easily reach basement or an area that we've already trapped extensively. Other perks such as Tinkerer can help us keep up with gens and be ready for the endgame.
No One Escapes Death can be devastating in the endgame. Don't forget that you can trap it (or trap exit gates) if the situation calls for it!

Survivors hit with your vicious Basic Attack suffer from the following effects for 70/80/90 seconds:

Whenever a Generator is repaired to 70 %, you benefit from the following effects:
Triggers a Loud Noise Notification for that Generator, revealing its location.
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect for the next 12/14/16 seconds.
Tinkerer can only trigger once per Generator per Trial.

alts.name: Hex: Fortune's Fool
alts.desc:
If there is still a Dull Totem in the environment, Hex: Fortune's Fool lights a Hex Totem whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, cursing them with its Hex Effects.
Inflicts the Oblivious Status Effect.
Blocks the Hex Totem for all other Survivors for 90 seconds.
Blocked Hex Totems cannot be cleansed or blessed by Survivors.
This does not affect the Cursed Survivor.
The Aura of the Hex Totem is revealed to the Cursed Survivor within 24/20/16 metres.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Unrelenting
alts.desc:
Basic Attacks benefit from the following effect:
Increases the recovery speed of missed basic-attacks by 30/35/40 %.
Increases the recovery speed of successful basic-attacks by 10 %.

addons.name: Bloody Coil
addons.comment: Passively injures any healthy Survivor that disarms a trap. Note that injured Survivors that are partially healed can still disarm them and then finish their heal afterwards. Obviously, this add-on isn't ideal if you plan to hide all of your traps very carefully but it's quite useful if you play more aggressively and place traps in high-traffic areas that would normally be useless when spotted and disarmed. Critically, Survivors have no way of knowing if this add-on is in play until at least one healthy person tries disarming a trap. At its worst, it will force Survivors to be very careful. At its best, it can keep a team injured or even prevent them from being able to rescue someone trapped in basement altogether. Injuring people with this add-on also has many synergies with perks such as "Hysteria", "Blood Favor", etc.
addons.desc: When a healthy Survivor disarms a Bear Trap, the Bloody Coil exacts its price, putting the Survivor into the Injured State.

addons.name: Iridescent Stone
addons.comment: Disarmed traps on the ground will reactivate based on an internal timer. Not very effective at the start of the match or when there's several disarmed traps, but can be quite powerful when there's only a few of them. For this reason, it pairs particularly well with the purple Trapper Sack, since there will be less traps to cycle through. It also pairs well with the iridescent Bloody Coil to create lose-lose situations where disarming traps can backfire for Survivors. It can also be used on exit gates as part of endgame builds; if Survivors disarm the trap and begin to open the gate they run the risk of being caught when it re-opens later. When not using the Trapper Sack, you might also have instances where Survivors run into the randomly spawned traps since they don't expect them to be there.
addons.desc: Automatically resets and arms a random disarmed Bear Trap every 30 seconds.

addons.name: Trapper Sack
addons.comment: Makes you start with all of your traps on your inventory at the cost of not being able to pick them up and relocate them anymore. Despite the downside making you a bit less flexible in some scenarios, this add-on is still incredibly powerful as it removes a lot of randomness and mitigates many of the Trapper's weaknesses. Carrying all of your traps at once enables a lot of different playstyles; you can set up aggressively at the start, set up lots of traps in chase in key areas or even completely lock down all entrances after a basement hook. Since there's no random trap spawns around the map, Survivors might also take longer to realize they're playing against a Trapper. Keep in mind that even though you cannot pick up traps, you can still rearm them on the ground. Overall this is a great add-on but very experienced Trappers might prefer to juggle traps throughout the match without it so that they can use two add-ons for other, more impactful effects.
addons.desc:
Causes all Bear Traps to be carried in your inventory at the beginning of the Trial.
You can no longer pick up any placed Bear Traps, only reset them.

addons.name: Honing Stone
addons.comment: Removes all luck involved from escaping a trap, making Survivors completely unable to free themselves without help unless they are ready to put themselves in the dying state. Notably, Survivors that down themselves will trigger certain Killer perks such as "Infectious Fright" or "Eruption". More importantly, this add-on gives you the certainty that either a Survivor will go down or that at least you'll be bothering multiple Survivors if someone is going for the rescue. This add-on is particularly mean against solo players that might not go for the rescue since they have no idea that this add-on is in play. In some situations, this effect can literally win you an entire game by paralyzing a Survivor and allowing you to chase the only other standing person. However, even with this add-on, you should still follow the general guideline of staying close to your traps. Despite its obvious strength, this add-on can still be 100% useless if Survivors only step in traps next to you or don't step in any trap in the first place.
addons.desc: Survivors caught in a Bear Trap,  who free themselves, are inflicted with the Dying State.

addons.name: Fastening Tools
addons.comment: Noticeably speeds up the setting and resetting of bear traps. On top of that, it also slows down the escape and rescue times which can sometimes mean the difference between a successful down or a narrow escape. This add-on provides nice value and pairs well with almost anything else.
addons.desc:
Increases the Rescue and Escape times from the Bear Trap by +25 %.
Increases the Setting speed of the Bear Trap by +50 %.

addons.name: Trapper Bag
addons.comment: Increases your trap carrying capacity, allowing you to be a bit more flexible in your approach or set up more aggressively around a certain area. It's also quite helpful if you keep placing traps during chase, since Survivors are more likely to run out of options before you run out of traps. Keep in mind that normally this add-on doesn't change the amount of traps on the map (10). However, when used together with the purple Trapper Sack it will actually spawn one extra (11 in total).
addons.desc: Increases the number of carried Bear Traps by +1.

addons.name: Makeshift Wrap
addons.comment: Enables the ability to walk through your own traps without getting caught in them. Any traps stepped on are automatically disarmed. This effect might seem like something that only a beginner would benefit from, but it actually enables a few unique and powerful strategies. First, it allows you to walk through your own traps on your way to hook someone in an already trapped shack basement or similar structure. Second, it can catch Survivors by surprise if they are disarming a trap unaware of the presence of this add-on. And finally, it can also be used to put a trap on the edge of a loop to help you in chase; even if Survivors see the trap, they'll have to walk around it to avoid it while you can go straight through it and thus catch up to them faster around the loop.
addons.desc: You are no longer caught in your own Bear Traps, they are automatically disarmed instead.

addons.name: Secondary Coil
addons.comment: Significantly delays the already long animation that Survivors must perform to disarm a trap. In some critical situations, this extra time can allow you to prevent multiple Survivors from escaping a trapped basement shack since you can hit one and still interrupt the other one before they can finish the disarm. It also helps a bit to slow down Survivors that are constantly chasing after you trying to disarm every trap you set up. This add-on is great for brute-force strategies but not that useful when you're trying to keep most of your traps hidden from Survivors.
addons.desc: Increases the Disarm time of the Bear Trap by +50 %.

addons.name: Coffee Grounds
addons.comment: Provides a small speed boost when placing or resetting a trap. This effect stacks with the natural speed boost that the Trapper gets normally. This effect is very small when it comes to overall mobility, but it can make a difference when catching up to a Survivor after placing a trap during chase. A decent effect, but don't let it affect your playstyle in a negative way; sometimes it's best to fake out a trap placement instead of actually placing it.
addons.desc: Increases the strength of the Haste Status Effect after setting a Bear Trap by +5 % .

addons.name: Oily Coil
addons.comment: Allows you to briefly see the aura of whatever Survivor interacted with a disarmed trap. If you pay attention during the match, you can use this effect to quickly locate specific Survivors that you're hunting down. Doing this can sometimes be extremely helpful in the late game when a particularly vulnerable Survivor is trying to stay hidden. Keep in mind, however, that aura reading can be countered by several Survivor perks. In other instances, you might also find that some Survivors are constantly around you and that this effect is simply redundant. This add-on pairs well with the iridescent Bloody Coil, since it might help you find an injured Survivor after they disarm a trap.
addons.desc: Resetting a Bear Trap reveals the Aura of the last Survivor to have disarmed it for 5 seconds.

addons.name: 4-Coil Spring Kit
addons.comment: Not as powerful as its blue counterpart, but still has a noticeable effect. It can be stacked together with it, but it's typically better to pair it with other aggressive add-ons such as the Iridescent Stone.
addons.desc: Increases the Disarm time of the Bear Trap by +33 %.

addons.name: Trapper Gloves
addons.comment: Gives a small but noticeable boost to your trap setting and resetting speed. Overall quite decent for its rarity but obviously outclassed by its blue counterpart which also has an extra secondary effect.
addons.desc: Increases the Setting speed of the Bear Trap by +30 %.

addons.name: Tension Spring
addons.comment: This add-on provides a powerful yet situational effect. Whenever a Survivor escapes or is rescued, the trap they stepped in will be immediately rearmed. Keep in mind that this does not trigger when you grab or hit a Survivor out of a trap yourself, only when they escape it. Even though it's quite rare, this add-on can create very chaotic situations where a Survivor steps on a trap, escapes and then gets unexpectedly caught again. This scenario occurs often if a Survivor is caught when trying to cleanse a hex totem or open a gate, since they'll stay on the same spot trying to finish the action. Most of the times you will try your best to stay close to your own traps, so this add-on simply doesn't come into play very often.
addons.desc: Automatically resets the Bear Trap 2 seconds after a Survivor escaped from it.

addons.name: Tar Bottle
addons.comment: This add-on significantly darkens the appearance of the traps, making them far less visible on dark surfaces and when hidden under dark grass. Unfortunately, this effect is very likely to backfire unless you know which map you will be playing in. In many maps, the ground is actually very bright and this add-on will actually make the traps even more visible than before. This inherent risk makes this add-on far less appealing compared to other options.
addons.desc: Darkens the Bear Trap.

addons.name: Wax Brick
addons.comment: Slows down the the process of escaping or being rescued from a trap. The effect is nice, but without a bit of luck the effects of this add-on on its own won't always make a big difference. Ideally, you should keep your traps close to yourself so that they'll be effective even if Survivors manage to escape quickly.
addons.desc: Increases the Rescue and Escape times of the Bear Trap by +33 %.

addons.name: Rusted Jaws
addons.comment: Can make healing take a bit longer after a Survivors steps on a trap. However, unlike other Killers, the Trapper often doesn't down Survivors directly with their power and you'll find that this add-on doesn't even come into play that often. The status effect also has a limited duration making it even less likely that it will make a difference.
addons.desc: Survivors injured by a Bear Trap suffer from the Mangled Status Effect for 70 seconds.

addons.name: Lengthened Jaws
addons.comment: Inflicts the Deep Wound status effect to a Survivor. Not particularly useful, since you will typically either down or immediately chase that Survivor anyway. In some rare scenarios, it might allow you outplay certain Survivor perks or prevent them from immediately using a medkit. Other add-ons with more consistent effects are typically a better option.
addons.desc: Survivors who escape from Bear Traps suffer from the Deep Wound Status Effect.

addons.name: Serrated Jaws
addons.comment: Inflicts the Haemorrhage status effect on Survivors getting caught on a trap. The effect lasts until healed. Sounds nice in theory, but in practice you will almost never benefit from this add-on. It's extremely rare that someone will step in a trap and later be interrupted while healing. Other add-ons with more consistent effects are typically a better option.
addons.desc: Survivors injured by a Bear Trap suffer from the Haemorrhage Status Effect until fully healed.

addons.name: Bear Oil
addons.comment: Silences the metallic sound that normally occurs when setting or resetting traps. Sounds useful, but even if Survivors aren't directly seeing you, they might still hear the leathery sounds that the Trapper typically makes when performing these animations. The silent trap placement might come in clutch in some very specific scenarios but it's simply too situational. It's typically preferable to go for add-ons with stronger or more consistent effects.
addons.desc: Setting a Bear Trap is silent.

addons.name: Padded Jaws
addons.comment: Makes your traps not injure healthy Survivors that get caught in them. This is overall a massive downside and is not worth bringing, even considering the extra bloodpoints it provides. Keep in mind that if you're using it along with the purple Honing Stone, Survivors will be healthy if rescued but still down themselves if they escape on their own. Since trapped Survivors can be hit twice with this add-on, you could also use it to quickly gain stacks of the perk "Save the Best for Last" but even then, it's probably not worth it.
addons.desc:
Modifies the Bear Traps with the following effect:
No longer inflict damage on trapped Survivors.
Padded Jaws grants +100 % bonus Bloodpoints for triggering the Trapped Score Event.
Padded Jaws negates the effects of the Serrated Jaws and Rusted Jaws Add-ons.

Your prayers invoke a dark power that meddles with the Survivors' chances of survival.
At the start of the Trial, the 3 Generators located farthest from you are blocked by The Entity for 80/100/120 seconds.
Corrupt Intervention deactivates prematurely once the first Survivor is put into the Dying State.

Your act of servitude to The Entity has not gone unnoticed.
Each time a Survivor is hooked for the first time, Grim Embrace gains +1 Token and activates once you are at least 16 metres away from the Hook:
1-3 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 6/8/10 seconds.
4 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 40 seconds and the Aura of the Obsession is revealed to you for 6 seconds.

killers.name: The Wraith
killers.otzComment:
Being almost entirely silent and invisible from a distance, the Wraith can cover large distances quickly and immediately inflict damage after a successful ambush. He doesn’t have many tools to help him in prolonged chases, however.
The Wraith's personal perks aren't the absolute best, but everything else about this character makes him an ideal pick for beginners. His simple power can still be really effective if you learn how to take full advantage of his stealth and mobility. His best perk, Predator, is useful to ensure that you don't lose track of an important target. It can also be useful by Killers such as Nurse that can ready up attacks from a distance. He will become even more powerful when you unlock stronger perks from other Killers.

teachables.name: Predator
teachables.desc:
Whenever you lose a Survivor in a Chase, Predator triggers its effect:
Their Aura is revealed to you for 4 seconds.
Predator has a cool-down of 60/50/40 seconds.

teachables.name: Bloodhound
teachables.desc:
Bloodhound causes the following effects:
Pools of Blood left by injured Survivors appear in bright red.
Extends their lifetime by 2/3/4 seconds.

teachables.name: Shadowborn
teachables.desc:
Whenever you are blinded by any means, Shadowborn triggers its effect:
Grants a 6/8/10 % Haste Status Effect for 10 seconds.

builds.name: Generic Build
notes: Reliable and well-rounded build; a good starting point until you find the ideal build for your playstyle.
Pain Res & TBTC help you slow down gens without much time wasted. Perks like Surge are good alternatives too.
Sloppy Butcher helps keep survivors injured, but can be swapped to Bamboozle if you struggle with windows.

perks.name: Barbecue & Chilli
perks.desc:
A deep bond with The Entity unlocks potential in one's Aura-reading ability.
After hooking a Survivor, all Survivors who are at least 60/50/40 metres away from that Hook have their Aura revealed to you for 5 seconds.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance
perks.desc:
Overwhelming pain reverberates outwards.
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Start the Trial with 4 Token.
Whenever a Survivor is hooked onto a Scourge Hook for the first time, Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance consumes -1 Token and applies the following effects:

This does not trigger a Loud Noise Notification.
Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance is disabled for the remainder of the Trial once all Tokens are consumed.

alts.name: Surge
alts.desc:
Whenever you put a Survivor into the Dying State with your Basic Attack, Surge triggers its effect:
Causes all Generators within 32 metres of your location to instantly explode and start regressing.
Instantly regresses all affected Generators by 6/7/8 %.

perks.name: Turn Back the Clock
perks.desc: After hooking a Survivor, for 40/50/60 seconds, press the Active Ability button to make a target generator within 20 meters explode, lose -10 % progress, and start regressing.

perks.name: Sloppy Butcher
perks.desc:
Survivors hit with your vicious Basic Attack suffer from the following effects for 70/80/90 seconds:
Inflicts the Haemorrhage and Mangled Status Effects.
Modifies the potency of Haemorrhage:
Increases the Spawn frequency of Pools of Blood by 50/75/100 %.
Increases the Regression rate of partial Healing progression by +25 %.

alts.name: Bamboozle
alts.desc:
You benefit from the following permanent effect:
Increases your Vaulting speed by 5/10/15 %.
Whenever you vault a Window, Bamboozle calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks it to all Survivors for 8/12/16 seconds.
Vaulting it again within that time resets the timer.
Vaulting a different one transfers the effect to it instead.
Bamboozle does not extend its effects to vaulting a dropped Pallet.

builds.name: Gen-Kick Build
notes: Dragon's Grip makes it risky for Survivors to return to a generator that you kicked.

This build is even stronger if you run the iridescent "All Seeing - Blood" add-on to have perfect info on gen progress. Otherwise, you'll need some perk like Tinkerer or Thrilling Tremors to keep an eye on the gens (or your own intuition).

perks.name: Help Wanted
perks.desc:
After performing the Damage Generator action, Help Wanted activates:
Causes that Generator to become a Compromised Generator.
Up to 3 Generators can be Compromised at a time.
The Auras of all Compromised Generators are highlighted to you in yellow.
Once a Compromised Generator is completed, Help Wanted triggers its effects for 70/80/90 seconds:
Increases the Recovery speed of successful Basic Attacks by +25 %.
All Generators not being repaired will automatically regress at 150 % of the default Regression rate.
Additionally, all other Generators are no longer Compromised.

alts.name: Mindbreaker
alts.desc:
While repairing a Generator, Survivors suffer from the following effects:
Incurs the Blindness and Exhausted Status Effects.
Both Status Effects linger for 3/4/5 seconds after ending the interaction.
Mindbreaker cannot be used to override an existing Exhausted Status Effect, but pauses its timer instead.

perks.name: Machine Learning
perks.desc:
After performing the Damage Generator action, Machine Learning activates:
Causes that Generator to become a Compromised Generator.
Up to 3 Generators can be Compromised at a time.
The Auras of all Compromised Generators are highlighted to you in yellow.
Once a Compromised Generator is completed, you benefit from the following effects for 40/50/60 seconds:
Undetectable Status Effect
+8 % Haste Status Effect
Additionally, all other Generators are no longer Compromised.

alts.name: Discordance
alts.desc:
Any Generator within a range of 64/96/128 metres that is being repaired by 2 or more Survivors is marked by a yellow Aura.
When the Generator is first highlighted, Discordance triggers a Loud Noise Notification on the Generator.
After the Generator is no longer within range or is being repaired by just 1 Survivor, the highlighted Aura will linger for another 4 seconds.

alts.name: Tinkerer
alts.desc:
Whenever a Generator is repaired to 70 %, you benefit from the following effects:
Triggers a Loud Noise Notification for that Generator, revealing its location.
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect for the next 12/14/16 seconds.
Tinkerer can only trigger once per Generator per Trial.

perks.name: Dragon's Grip
perks.desc:
After performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator, Dragon's Grip activates for 30 seconds.
While active, the first Survivor interacting with that Generator suffers from the following effects:
Causes them to scream and reveal their location for 4 seconds.
Inflicts the Exposed Status Effect for 60 seconds.
Dragon's Grip has a cool-down of 60/45/30 seconds.

alts.name: Mindbreaker
alts.desc:
While repairing a Generator, Survivors suffer from the following effects:
Incurs the Blindness and Exhausted Status Effects.
Both Status Effects linger for 3/4/5 seconds after ending the interaction.
Mindbreaker cannot be used to override an existing Exhausted Status Effect, but pauses its timer instead.

alts.name: Eruption
alts.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on Generators highlights their Auras in yellow.
Whenever a Survivor enters the Dying State by any means, Eruption triggers the following effects on all highlighted Generators:
Causes them to explode, damaging them.
Instantly regresses them by -10 % of their total Progression.
Causes them to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors currently repairing them to suffer from the following effects:
Causes them to scream.
Their Auras are revealed to you for 8/10/12 seconds.
Eruption has a cool-down of 30 seconds after triggering its effects, which also resets the highlighted Auras.

perks.name: Lay Waste
perks.desc:
Damaging a Generator makes it regress +2 % faster for each Charge it has.
This perk has a cool-down of 55/50/45 seconds after damaging a Generator.

alts.name: Call of Brine
alts.desc:
After performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator, Call of Brine applies its effects to it for 90 seconds:
Increases its Regression speed to 130/140/150 % of the default value.
Highlights its Aura to you in yellow.
Triggers a Loud Noise Notification whenever a Survivor succeeds a Good Skill Check while repairing it.

alts.name: Nowhere to Hide
alts.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator triggers Nowhere to Hide:
The Auras of all Survivors within 24 metres of the Generator's location are revealed to you for 3/4/5 seconds.

perks.name: Hex: Ruin
perks.desc:
All Generators not currently being repaired experience the following effect:
Causes them to automatically regress at 100/125/150 % of the default Regression rate.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Hex: Blood Favour
perks.desc:
Hex: Blood Favour lights a Hex Totem at the start of the Trial, cursing Survivors with its Hex Effects.
Whenever a Survivor loses a Health State by a basic-attack, Hex: Blood Favour triggers its effect for 13/14/15 seconds:
Blocks all upright Pallets within 32 metres of that Survivor.
Blocked Pallets cannot be dropped by any Survivor.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Barbecue & Chilli
perks.desc:
A deep bond with The Entity unlocks potential in one's Aura-reading ability.
After hooking a Survivor, all Survivors who are at least 60/50/40 metres away from that Hook have their Aura revealed to you for 5 seconds.

alts.name: Hex: Hive Mind
alts.desc:
The first time you hook any Survivor, a random Dull Totem becomes a Hex Totem, provided that a Dull Totem remains in the Trial Grounds.
Generators are highlighted; the intensity of the generator's Auras reveals their repair progress.
As soon as a total of 4 generators have been completed in the Trial:
All remaining generators explode, lose 6/8/10 % progess, and start regressing.
The associated Hex Totem becomes dull, and this perk becomes disabled for the remainder of the trial.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Friends 'til the End
alts.desc:
When you hook any Survivors that is not the Obsession, the following effects apply to the Obsession:
Their Aura is revealed for 6/8/10 seconds.
They suffer from the Exposed Status Effect for 20 seconds.
When you hook the Obsession, the following effects apply to a random Survivor:
Causes the Survivor to scream and reveal their location to the Killer.
They become the new Obsession.
You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

perks.name: Hex: Undying
perks.desc:
Whenever a Survivor is within 2/3/4 metres of a Dull Totem, Hex: Undying triggers its primary effect:
Their Aura is revealed to you for as long as they remain in that range.
Whenever a Hex Totem is cleansed, Hex: Undying triggers its secondary effect:
Transfers the cleansed Hex to the Hex Totem associated with Hex: Undying instead, replacing it.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Hex: Thrill of the Hunt
alts.desc:
If there is still a Dull Totem in the environment, Hex: Thrill of the Hunt lights a Hex Totem whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, cursing them with its Hex Effects.
For each lit Hex Totem located in the environment, gain a token.
Hooking a Survivor causes all Totems to be blocked by the Entity by a stack-able 4/5/6 seconds per Token, up to a maximum of 20/25/30 seconds.
Hex: Thrill of the Hunt loses -1 Token whenever a Hex Totem is cleansed.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

builds.name: Beginner Perks Only
notes: Only uses perks available to this Killer or global perks available to everyone. It might include some alternative perk ideas from one of the five free Killers too.

Whispers is a great perk on Wraith; it allows you to quickly move around the map until it activates, letting you know you're getting close to someone. "Spies from the Shadows" or "Bitter Murmur" are good alternatives as well.

Each time a Generator is completed, No Holds Barred calls upon The Entity for the following effects:
Blocks the Generator with the most Progression for 15/20/25 seconds.
The Aura of the Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.

Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Haemorrhage Status Effect for 90 seconds.
After the first time that Survivor is healed back to full health, they suffer from the following effect until they are injured again by any means:
Reduces their Action speeds for Healing and Repairing by 10/13/16 %.

perks.name: Whispers
perks.desc:
Whenever any Survivor is within 28/26/24 metres of your location:
Causes you to hear the sporadic whispers of The Entity, indicating a Survivor's presence.
Whenever any Survivor is outside 28/26/24 metres of your location:
Gain +5 % Haste Status Effect.

alts.name: Spies from the Shadows
alts.desc:
Whenever a Survivor startles a Crow within 36/38/40 metres of your location, Spies from the Shadows triggers its effect:
Alerts you with a unique Loud Noise Notification in the shape of a Crow.
Spies from the Shadows has a cool-down of 3 seconds between alerts.

alts.name: Bitter Murmur
alts.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability.
Whenever a Generator is completed, Bitter Murmur triggers its primary effect:
The Auras of any Survivors within 20 metres of that Generator are revealed to you for 10 seconds.
Once the last Generator is completed, Bitter Murmur triggers its secondary effect:
The Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 16/18/20 seconds.

perks.name: Hex: No One Escapes Death
perks.desc:
Once the Exit Gates are powered, if there is still a Dull Totem remaining in the environment, Hex: No One Escapes Death activates and lights it:
Grants a 2/3/4 % Haste Status Effect.
Causes all Survivors to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect.
Once the Status Effect is revealed to Survivors, Hex: No One Escapes Death triggers the following effect:
The Aura of its Hex Totem is revealed to all Survivors within 4 metres.
This range gradually expands to 24 metres over the course of 30 seconds.
Hex: No One Escapes Death remains inactive if no Dull Totems are available.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Unrelenting
alts.desc:
Basic Attacks benefit from the following effect:
Increases the recovery speed of missed basic-attacks by 30/35/40 %.
Increases the recovery speed of successful basic-attacks by 10 %.

addons.name: "Windstorm" - Blood
addons.comment: Increases your movement speed when cloaked. The increased mobility helps you find targets quicker, cover big distances faster and makes it even more viable to cloak after a hit for an easier time catching up. It also makes a tremendous difference when it comes to moving ahead of Survivors in chase to bodyblock them and prevent them from reaching safety.
addons.desc: Increases your Movement Speed while Cloaked by +9 %.

addons.name: "Windstorm" - White
addons.comment: Increases your movement speed when cloaked. The increased mobility helps you find targets quicker, cover big distances faster and makes it even more viable to cloak after a hit for an easier time catching up. It also makes a tremendous difference when it comes to moving ahead of Survivors in chase to bodyblock them and prevent them from reaching safety.
addons.desc: Increases your Movement Speed while Cloaked by +7 %.

addons.name: "Swift Hunt" - Blood
addons.comment: Allows you to uncloak sooner. This is almost universally helpful and gives Survivors far less time to reach safety after being ambushed or suddenly bodyblocked during chase. Since the uncloaking animation is very slow, all add-ons of this type have a very noticeable effect.
addons.desc: Reduces the Uncloaking time by -12 %.

addons.name: "Swift Hunt" - White
addons.comment: Allows you to uncloak sooner. This is almost universally helpful and gives Survivors far less time to reach safety after being ambushed or suddenly bodyblocked during chase. Since the uncloaking animation is very slow, all add-ons of this type have a very noticeable effect.
addons.desc: Reduces the Uncloaking time by -10 %.

addons.name: "All Seeing" - Spirit
addons.comment: Allows you to accurately gauge the progress of all generators when cloaked. This greatly reduces the need for information perks and is very effective on builds that rely on keeping the generators regressing. Not a bad effect at all, but experienced players might trust their own ability to control the map without this information and might prefer other add-ons that help in chase a bit more directly.
addons.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability while Cloaked:
The intensity of the Generator Auras reveals their current Repair progress.

addons.name: "All Seeing" - Blood
addons.comment: Allows you to see Survivor auras when nearby. This helps with tracking and finding stealthy Survivors but is also very useful even during chase, since seeing the precise location of your target enables a lot of plays that would otherwise be very risky. The effects of this add-on can unfortunately be mitigated by certain Survivor perks that can conceal their aura and prevent it from being revealed.
addons.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability while Cloaked:
The Auras of Survivors are revealed to you within 8 metres of your location.

addons.name: "Swift Hunt" - Mud
addons.comment: Allows you to uncloak sooner. This is almost universally helpful and gives Survivors far less time to reach safety after being ambushed or suddenly bodyblocked during chase. Since the uncloaking animation is very slow, all add-ons of this type have a very noticeable effect.
addons.desc: Reduces the Uncloaking time by -8 %.

addons.name: "Windstorm" - Mud
addons.comment: Increases your movement speed when cloaked. The increased mobility helps you find targets quicker, cover big distances faster and makes it even more viable to cloak after a hit for an easier time catching up. Not as powerful as its blue and purple counterparts, but still quite good.
addons.desc: Increases your Movement Speed while Cloaked by +5 %.

addons.name: Coxcombed Clapper
addons.comment: Completely silences the bell sound. Keep in mind that you're not 100% silent since the Wraith himself produces a characteristic sound. Similar effect as the Bone Clapper, but obviously doesn't pair well together with it.
addons.desc: Silences the Wailing Bell.

addons.name: Bone Clapper
addons.comment: Makes your cloak and uncloak sounds non-directional. This can disorient Survivors and keep them paranoid even when you're not actively going after them. It also allows you to ambush Survivors from unusual angles that would otherwise be impossible with directional sound cues.
addons.desc: Survivors are unable to discern the distance and direction of the Wailing Bell.

addons.name: "Shadow Dance" - Blood
addons.comment: Increases your action speed when cloaked, greatly speeding up actions such as vaults or pallet breaks. If used correctly, the faster action speed can be quite oppressive by shredding through pallets or vaulting so fast that some structures become unsafe for Survivors. Also quite fun in gimmicky builds when stacked with other add-ons or perks that revolve around fast actions.
addons.desc: Increases the Action speeds for breaking Breakable Walls and Pallets, damaging Generators, and vaulting Windows by +60 % when Cloaked.

addons.name: "Shadow Dance" - White
addons.comment: Increases your action speed when cloaked, greatly speeding up actions such as vaults or pallet breaks. If used correctly, the faster action speed can be quite oppressive by shredding through pallets or vaulting so fast that some structures become unsafe for Survivors. Also quite fun in gimmicky builds when stacked with other add-ons or perks that revolve around fast actions.
addons.desc: Increases the Action speeds for breaking Breakable Walls and Pallets, damaging Generators, and vaulting Windows by +40 % while Cloaked.

addons.name: "Blind Warrior" - White
addons.comment: Apllies the Mangled and Haemorrhage status effects when hitting a Survivor shortly after an ambush. This is a powerful effect for a stealth Killer, but the limited duration and slightly inconsistent trigger condition makes it a bit less appealing. Can be easily replaced by the perk "Sloppy Butcher" if you don't want to use an add-on slot for this effect.
addons.desc: Survivors hit with a Surprise Attack suffer from the Haemorrhage and Mangled Status Effects for 70 seconds.

addons.name: "The Ghost" - Soot
addons.comment: Keeps you stealthy for a few extra seconds after uncloaking. Doesn't have much utility in chase, but it can be used to surprise players and even get grabs on unsuspecting Survivors. Pairs very well with the green Bone Clapper or the iridescent Coxcombed Clapper to keep things unpredictable.
addons.desc: Your Terror Radius and Red Stain are suppressed for another 6 seconds after uncloaking.

addons.name: "Blink" - White
addons.comment: Allows you to cloak sooner. Since cloaking is very fast and you don't really slow down during the animation, this effect is virtually useless outside of chase. Within chase, however, you might find it relatively useful if you cloak after a hit to catch up to the Survivor. Since the cloaking occurs slightly sooner, you begin to benefit from the increased speed a little bit sooner. Pairs well with the Windstorm family of add-ons.
addons.desc: Reduces the Cloaking time by -60 %.

addons.name: "Blink" - Mud
addons.comment: Allows you to cloak sooner. Since cloaking is very fast and you don't really slow down during the animation, this effect is virtually useless outside of chase. Within chase, however, you might find it relatively useful if you cloak after a hit to catch up to the Survivor. Since the cloaking occurs slightly sooner, you begin to benefit from the increased speed a little bit sooner. Pairs well with the Windstorm family of add-ons.
addons.desc: Reduces the Cloaking time by -40 %.

addons.name: "Blind Warrior" - Mud
addons.comment: Apllies the Blindness status effects when hitting a Survivor shortly after an ambush. Not a terrible effect, but also not consistent enough to be worth the add-on slot.
addons.desc: Survivors hit with a Surprise Attack suffer from the Blindness Status Effect for 60 seconds.

addons.name: "The Serpent" - Soot
addons.comment: Automatically uncloaks the Wraith after performing the break action on a pallet, wall or generator. This is slightly awkward and sometimes unnecesarry, but it can also be used as part of gimmick builds with the "Shadow Dance" add-ons. It has fun synergies with perks that can automatically "break" things for you such as "Turn Back The Clock", since it can allow you to automatically uncloak at unexpected times. Generally speaking, the "Swift Hunt" family of add-ons is simply a better alternative if you want reliability.
addons.desc: Breaking Breakable Walls or Pallets by any means, or performing the Damage Generator action on incomplete Generators, will cause you to automatically uncloak.

addons.name: "The Hound" - Soot
addons.comment: Increases the visibility of pools of blood when cloaked, making it even easier to track them. Not bad, especially for beginners, but there's simply better add-ons that help in more direct ways.
addons.desc: When Cloaked, Pools of Blood appear to you in bright red.

addons.name: "The Beast" - Soot
addons.comment: This add-on makes your terror radius stay even when cloaked, effectively reducing your ability to move around the map in stealth. This is ostensibly a really bad effect that should be avoided, but it does create some fun interactions and synergies with other add-ons and perks. Notably, it can be paired with perks like "Dissolution" and the brown Serpent add-on to instantly break pallets and automatically uncloak when this happens. It can also be paired with perks such as "Coulrophobia" to keep apply their affects quickly around the map. You can also catch Survivors by surprise by pairing it with the brown Ghost add-on, since you'll temporarily gain a brief period of having no terror radius.
addons.desc:
Your Terror Radius is no longer suppressed when Cloaked.
Grants +100 % bonus Bloodpoints for Stalking and Surprise Attack Score Events.

perks.desc:
Survivors hit with your vicious Basic Attack suffer from the following effects for 70/80/90 seconds:
Inflicts the Haemorrhage and Mangled Status Effects.
Modifies the potency of Haemorrhage:
Increases the Spawn frequency of Pools of Blood by 50/75/100 %.
Increases the Regression rate of partial Healing progression by +25 %.
perks.name: Sloppy Butcher

perks.desc:
You benefit from the following permanent effect:
Increases your Vaulting speed by 5/10/15 %.
Whenever you vault a Window, Bamboozle calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks it to all Survivors for 8/12/16 seconds.
Vaulting it again within that time resets the timer.
Vaulting a different one transfers the effect to it instead.
Bamboozle does not extend its effects to vaulting a dropped Pallet.
perks.name: Bamboozle

perks.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on Generators highlights their Auras in yellow.
Whenever a Survivor enters the Dying State by any means, Eruption triggers the following effects on all highlighted Generators:
Causes them to explode, damaging them.
Instantly regresses them by -10 % of their total Progression.
Causes them to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors currently repairing them to suffer from the following effects:
Causes them to scream.
Their Auras are revealed to you for 8/10/12 seconds.
Eruption has a cool-down of 30 seconds after triggering its effects, which also resets the highlighted Auras.
perks.name: Eruption

perks.desc:
Overwhelming pain reverberates outwards.
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Start the Trial with 4 Token.
Whenever a Survivor is hooked onto a Scourge Hook for the first time, Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance consumes -1 Token and applies the following effects:
Causes the Generator with the most progression to explode, damaging it.
Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by 10/15/20 % of its total Progression.
Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors repairing the Damaged Generator to scream.
This does not trigger a Loud Noise Notification.
Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance is disabled for the remainder of the Trial once all Tokens are consumed.
perks.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance

You benefit from the following permanent effect:

Vaulting a different one transfers the effect to it instead.

perks.desc: Identical to See How They Run.
perks.name: Play With Your Food

perks.desc:
Whenever the Obsession loses a Health State by any means, Remember Me gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 3/4/5 Tokens:
Increases the Opening time of both Exit Gates by a stack-able 6 seconds per Token, up to a maximum additional Opening time of 18/24/30 seconds.
This results in a maximum possible Opening time of 38/44/50 seconds for both Exit Gates.
Remember Me does not apply its penalty to the Obsession, allowing them to open both Exit Gates in the default time of 20 seconds.
You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.
perks.name: Remember Me

perks.desc:
Whenever a Generator is completed, Rancor triggers its primary effects:
Causes all Survivors to scream and trigger a Loud Noise Notification at their current location.
This effect lingers for 3 seconds.
Your Aura is revealed to the Obsession for 5/4/3 seconds.
Once the Exit Gates are powered, Rancor additionally triggers its secondary effects on the Obsession:
Inflicts the Exposed Status Effect for the remainder of the Trial.
Grants the ability to kill them when in close proximity.
You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.
perks.name: Rancor

perks.desc:
Whenever you hit the Survivor with currently the highest cumulative Chase time with a Basic Attack, Game Afoot triggers its primary effect:
Causes the Obsession Status to transfer to that Survivor.
While chasing the Obsession, performing the Break or Damage action causes Game Afoot to trigger its secondary effect:
Grants a +10 % Haste Status Effect for 8/9/10 seconds.
You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.
perks.name: Game Afoot

The Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.
Dead Man's Switch cannot activate if its effect is still active from a previous activation.
perks.name: Dead Man’s Switch

perks.desc:
Your act of servitude to The Entity has not gone unnoticed.
Each time a Survivor is hooked for the first time, Grim Embrace gains +1 Token and activates once you are at least 16 metres away from the Hook:
1-3 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 6/8/10 seconds.
4 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 40 seconds and the Aura of the Obsession is revealed to you for 6 seconds.
perks.name: Grim Embrace

perks.name: Brutal Strength

Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator applies Overcharge:
The next Survivor interacting with that Generator is faced with a difficult Skill Check.
Instantly regresses that Generator by 2/3/4 % of its maximum possible Progression in addition to the default Progression penalty.
After Overcharge is applied to a Generator, the following effect also applies:
Increases the Regression speed from 85 % to 130 % of its default value over the next 30 seconds.
perks.name: Overcharge

perks.name: Pop Goes the Weasel

perks.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator triggers Nowhere to Hide:
The Auras of all Survivors within 24 metres of the Generator's location are revealed to you for 3/4/5 seconds.
perks.name: Nowhere to Hide

killers.name: The Hillbilly
killers.otzComment:
The Hillbilly’s base ability gives him mobility, lethality and a tool to shred through pallets quickly. He is fairly accessible for beginners but his chainsaw also has a considerable skill ceiling for advanced players to master.
The Hillbilly is one of the harder free Killers to start using, but you can always play him as a basic Killer and slowly incorporate his chainsaw into your chases as you become more experienced with him. He unlocks some of the best perks among the free Killers, so leveling him can be very helpful. Enduring is a nice perk to help you deal with pallets in chase and Tinkerer is incredibly helpful to help you be aware of generator progress across the map and maybe even interrupt it.

teachables.name: Enduring
teachables.desc:
You benefit from the following effect:
Reduces the duration of Pallet Stuns by 40/45/50 %.
This effect does not apply when stunned while carrying a Survivor.

teachables.name: Lightborn
teachables.desc:
Unlike other beasts of The Fog, you have adapted to light.
The Auras of Survivors attempting to blind you by any means are revealed to you for 6/8/10 seconds.
Grants immunity from being blinded from Flashlights, Firecrackers, Flash Grenades, and Blast Mine.

teachables.name: Tinkerer
teachables.desc:
Whenever a Generator is repaired to 70 %, you benefit from the following effects:
Triggers a Loud Noise Notification for that Generator, revealing its location.
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect for the next 12/14/16 seconds.
Tinkerer can only trigger once per Generator per Trial.

notes: Reliable and well-rounded build; a good starting point until you find the ideal build for your playstyle.
Bamboozle helps you block strong windows in places like shack to force Survivors to drop pallets.
With Tinkerer (or similar), you keep an eye on the gens and use Turn Back The Clock to keep them damaged.

Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by a stack-able -10 % of its total Progression per Token, up to a maximum of 10/20/30 %.
Blocks the Damaged Generator for 10 seconds per Token, up to a maximum of 10/20/30 seconds.
Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing once it becomes unblocked.

perks.name: Hex: Two Can Play
perks.desc:
Anytime you are stunned or blinded by any Survivor a total of 4/3/2 times, and if there is not yet a Hex Totem already associated with Hex: Two Can Play and there is at least one Dull Totem remaining in the Trial Grounds, Hex: Two Can Play activates on a random Totem:
Blinds all Survivors who stun or blind you for 1.5 seconds.
This does not affect carried Survivors.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.desc:

When the Exit Gates are powered, you are granted Undetectable for the rest of the Trial.

builds.name: All-Hex Control Build
notes: Ruin and Hive Mind allow to passively monitor & regress generators across the map.
Crowd Control will also help with windows and keeping Survivors busy. Swap to Bamboozle if you prefer it.

perks.name: Hex: Ruin
perks.desc:
All Generators not currently being repaired experience the following effect:
Causes them to automatically regress at 100/125/150 % of the default Regression rate.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Hex: Hive Mind
perks.desc:
The first time you hook any Survivor, a random Dull Totem becomes a Hex Totem, provided that a Dull Totem remains in the Trial Grounds.
Generators are highlighted; the intensity of the generator's Auras reveals their repair progress.
As soon as a total of 4 generators have been completed in the Trial:
All remaining generators explode, lose 6/8/10 % progess, and start regressing.
The associated Hex Totem becomes dull, and this perk becomes disabled for the remainder of the trial.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Hex: Undying
perks.desc:
Whenever a Survivor is within 2/3/4 metres of a Dull Totem, Hex: Undying triggers its primary effect:
Their Aura is revealed to you for as long as they remain in that range.
Whenever a Hex Totem is cleansed, Hex: Undying triggers its secondary effect:
Transfers the cleansed Hex to the Hex Totem associated with Hex: Undying instead, replacing it.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Dominance
alts.desc:
The power you wield over the land strikes terror in the hearts of all who cross your path.
The first time each Totem are interacted with by a Survivor, Dominance triggers its effect:
Calls upon The Entity to block it for 25 seconds.
The Aura of the blocked Prop is revealed to you in white.
The Survivor screams.
The Survivor's aura is revealed to you for 3/4/5 seconds.

perks.name: Hex: Crowd Control
perks.desc:
Whenever a Survivors performs a Rushed Vault action at a Window, Hex: Crowd Control activates on a random Totem and triggers its effect:
Blocks that Window for all Survivors.
Increases basic-vault speed of blocked Windows by 15 %
Reveals auras of blocked Windows within 24 metres
Hex: Crowd Control has a limit of 4/5/6  Windows it can affect at a time.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Bamboozle
alts.desc:
You benefit from the following permanent effect:
Increases your Vaulting speed by 5/10/15 %.
Whenever you vault a Window, Bamboozle calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks it to all Survivors for 8/12/16 seconds.
Vaulting it again within that time resets the timer.
Vaulting a different one transfers the effect to it instead.
Bamboozle does not extend its effects to vaulting a dropped Pallet.

builds.name: Beginner Perks Only
notes: Only uses perks available to this Killer or global perks available to everyone. It might include some alternative perk ideas from one of the five free Killers too.
You can use your chainsaw mobility around the map and keep a close eye to see when Whispers activates to know that you're getting close to someone.

perks.name: No Holds Barred
perks.desc:
Each time a Generator is completed, No Holds Barred calls upon The Entity for the following effects:
Blocks the Generator with the most Progression for 15/20/25 seconds.
The Aura of the Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.

perks.name: Tinkerer
perks.desc:
Whenever a Generator is repaired to 70 %, you benefit from the following effects:
Triggers a Loud Noise Notification for that Generator, revealing its location.
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect for the next 12/14/16 seconds.
Tinkerer can only trigger once per Generator per Trial.

perks.name: Enduring
perks.desc:
You benefit from the following effect:
Reduces the duration of Pallet Stuns by 40/45/50 %.
This effect does not apply when stunned while carrying a Survivor.

alts.name: Hex: Fortune's Fool
alts.desc:
If there is still a Dull Totem in the environment, Hex: Fortune's Fool lights a Hex Totem whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, cursing them with its Hex Effects.
Inflicts the Oblivious Status Effect.
Blocks the Hex Totem for all other Survivors for 90 seconds.
Blocked Hex Totems cannot be cleansed or blessed by Survivors.
This does not affect the Cursed Survivor.
The Aura of the Hex Totem is revealed to the Cursed Survivor within 24/20/16 metres.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Whispers
perks.desc:
Whenever any Survivor is within 28/26/24 metres of your location:
Causes you to hear the sporadic whispers of The Entity, indicating a Survivor's presence.
Whenever any Survivor is outside 28/26/24 metres of your location:
Gain +5 % Haste Status Effect.

alts.name: Spies from the Shadows
alts.desc:
Whenever a Survivor startles a Crow within 36/38/40 metres of your location, Spies from the Shadows triggers its effect:
Alerts you with a unique Loud Noise Notification in the shape of a Crow.
Spies from the Shadows has a cool-down of 3 seconds between alerts.

alts.name: A Nurse's Calling
alts.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability:
The Auras of Survivors being healed or healing themselves are revealed to you within 28/30/32 metres.

addons.name: Iridescent Engravings
addons.comment: Slows the rate at which you charge you saw, but also increases its speed by a significant amount. This helps with map mobility (although it does make turning harder) and makes several loops even less safe to play around for Survivors. Particularly deadly in the hands of experienced players.
addons.desc:
Increases your Movement speed during a Chainsaw Sprint by +20 %.
Increases the Charge time of the Chainsaw by +12 %.

addons.name: Spiked Boots
addons.comment: Noticeably increases your turn rate during your chainsaw sprint. This doesn't affect the initial curve, but it starts helping out immediately after and can make it easier to land certain hits or navigate the map without having to bump into anything. This effect is almost universally useful and can make the extra speed from the Iridescent Engravings more manageable.
addons.desc: Increases the Turn speed during the Chainsaw Sprint by +30 %.

addons.name: Dad's Boots
addons.comment: Noticeably increases your turn rate during your chainsaw sprint. This doesn't affect the initial curve, but it starts helping out immediately after and can make it easier to land certain hits or navigate the map without having to bump into anything.
addons.desc: Increases the Turn speed during a Chainsaw Sprint by +20 %.

addons.name: LoPro Chains
addons.comment: Allows you to chainsaw through pallets without interrupting your sprint. This increases your mobility, speeds up your recovery and even allows you to damage a Survivor for a single health state, although it will inflict Deep Wound on injured Survivors instead of downing them.
addons.desc:
Grants the ability to continue a Chainsaw Sprint through Breakable Walls and dropped Pallets, breaking them in the process.
Healthy Survivors hit with the Chainsaw within 5 seconds of triggering the primary effect are only damaged for a single Health State.
Injured Survivors will suffer from the Deep Wound Status Effect instead.

addons.name: The Thompsons' Mix
addons.comment: Reduces your cooldown after using your chainsaw. Small effect itself, but quite useful still. Does not work during Overdrive mode.
addons.desc: Reduces the Cool-down time after using the Chainsaw by -10 %, when not in Overdrive.

addons.name: Greased Throttle
addons.comment: Reduces your cooldown after using your chainsaw. Small effect itself, but quite useful still. Does not work during Overdrive mode. Can be stacked with its blue counterpart.
addons.desc: Reduces the Cool-down time after using the Chainsaw by -5 %, when not in Overdrive.

addons.name: Tuned Carburettor
addons.comment: Permanently reduces your normal movement speed down to 110% (4.4m/s) but also greatly increases your charge speed, making it easier to use it at a moment's notice. Some players might find this tradeoff useful in specific situations, but be very careful when using this add-on since it might make some already difficult chases even harder. Can be quite deadly when paired with the Iridescent Engravings, but only in the hands of a seasoned player. Stay away from it unless you know what you're doing.
addons.desc:
Increases the Charge speed of the Chainsaw by +20 %.
Permanently reduces the default Movement speed to 4.4 m/s.

addons.name: Off-Brand Motor Oil
addons.comment: Makes it easier to reach Overdrive mode by using your chainsaw, allowing you to go into it sooner. Not a bad effect at all.
addons.desc: Increases the Charge rate of the Overdrive Meter by +15 %.

addons.name: Clogged Intake
addons.comment: Increases the duration of the Overdrive mode by 15%, which is normally only 20 seconds. Not a huge effect but still welcome.
addons.desc: Extends the duration of Overdrive by +15 %.

addons.name: Apex Muffler
addons.comment: Makes your chainsaw silent outside of your terror radius. This allows you to sneak up on Survivors more easily, especially if paired with other add-ons or perks that reduce or remove your terror radius entirely. Unfortunately, not every map lends itself to this type of strategy.
addons.desc: Silences the Chainsaw for all Survivors outside of the Terror Radius.

addons.name: Begrimed Chains
addons.comment: Applies the Mangled and Haemorrhage status effects with each chainsaw hit, discouraging Survivors from healing quickly after being unhooked. Not a bad effect, but keep in mind that it doesn't really help you to land the chainsaw hit in the first place.
addons.desc: Survivors hit with the Chainsaw suffer from the Haemorrhage and Mangled Status Effects for 70 seconds.

addons.name: Filthy Slippers
addons.comment: Gives the Undetectable status effect after performing the chainsaw sprint for a bit. Some maps are too small to trigger this effect consistently, and even then the chainsaw itself is still quite noisy so you won't be catching too many Survivors by surprise. Pairs well with the Apex Muffler so that the chainsaw also becomes silent.
addons.desc: Gain the Undetectable Status Effect until you stop sprinting after maintaining a Chainsaw Sprint for at least 2 seconds.

addons.name: High-Speed Idler Screw
addons.comment: One of several add-ons that reduce the loss of Overdrive meter over time. Not extremely impactful, but having at least one of these add-ons can mitigate the normal loss that occurs during periods such as the transporation of a downed Survivor to the nearest hook. In general, add-ons that delay the start of the dissipation are better than the ones that reduce the dissipation rate.
addons.desc: Increases the Decay delay for the Overdrive Meter by +30 %.

addons.name: Ragged Engine
addons.comment: One of several add-ons that reduce the loss of Overdrive meter over time. Not extremely impactful, but having at least one of these add-ons can mitigate the normal loss that occurs during periods such as the transporation of a downed Survivor to the nearest hook. In general, add-ons that delay the start of the dissipation are better than the ones that reduce the dissipation rate.
addons.desc: Reduces the Dissipation speed of the Overdrive Meter when not using the Chainsaw by -30 %.

addons.name: Discarded Air Filter
addons.comment: One of several add-ons that reduce the loss of Overdrive meter over time. Not extremely impactful, but having at least one of these add-ons can mitigate the normal loss that occurs during periods such as the transporation of a downed Survivor to the nearest hook. In general, add-ons that delay the start of the dissipation are better than the ones that reduce the dissipation rate.
addons.desc: Increases the Decay delay for the Overdrive Meter by +20 %.

addons.name: Thermal Casing
addons.comment: One of several add-ons that reduce the loss of Overdrive meter over time. Not extremely impactful, but having at least one of these add-ons can mitigate the normal loss that occurs during periods such as the transporation of a downed Survivor to the nearest hook. In general, add-ons that delay the start of the dissipation are better than the ones that reduce the dissipation rate.
addons.desc: Reduces the Dissipation speed of the Overdrive Meter when not using the Chainsaw by -20 %.

addons.name: Low Kickback Chains
addons.comment: Reduces the stun animation when bumping into an object. Not a terrible effect, especially for beginners that are still learning.
addons.desc: Reduces the Cool-down time after hitting an obstacle during a Chainsaw Sprint by -15 %.

addons.name: Steel Toe Boots
addons.comment: Reduces the stun animation when bumping into an object. Not a terrible effect, especially for beginners that are still learning.
addons.desc: Reduces the Cool-down time after hitting an obstacle during a Chainsaw Sprint by -10 %.

addons.name: Counterweight
addons.comment: This add-on removes the "curving" functionality of your chainsaw that allows you to sharply change direction at the start of your chainsaw sprint. Curving is an important part of the Hillbilly's kit and thus removing it is obviously a terrible idea. There's almost no reason to ever use this unless you really want to avoid this mechanic.
addons.desc: Reduces the initial Turn rate of the Chainsaw during a Chainsaw Sprint by -70 %.

addons.name: Cracked Primer Bulb
addons.comment: Removes your chainsaw's natural ability to instantly down Survivors, making it only damage one health state instead. Despite the small boost it provides to overdrive generation, this add-on's effect is obviously terrible and should only be used by players that want to challenge themselves.
addons.desc:
Increases the Charge rate of the Overdrive Meter by +15 %.
Survivors hit with the Chainsaw are only damaged for a single Health State.
