killers.name: The Nurse
killers.otzComment:
The Nurse’s ability ignores all basic gameplay elements and makes her a constant threat in chase. Without a perfect execution, however, you will find yourself struggling against smarter Survivors.
The Nurse is the only Killer in the roster that moves slower than a running Survivor, which means that you absolutely must use her teleportation powers in order to scout the map and chase Survivors. Since her abilities are so different from other Killers, she is quite difficult to learn at first. One of her perks, A Nurse's calling, is particularly worth unlocking, especially if you plan on playing stealth Killers.

teachables.name: Stridor
teachables.desc:
You are acutely sensitive to the breathing of your prey.
Increases the volume of Grunts of Pain of injured Survivors by 30/40/50 %.
Increases the volume of regular breathing of Survivors by 15/20/25 %.

teachables.name: Thanatophobia
teachables.desc:
Whenever at least one Survivor is either injured, dying, or hooked, Thanatophobia activates.
While active, all Survivors suffer from the following primary effect:
Incurs a stack-able 1/1.5/2 % Action-Speed penalty per injured, dying, or hooked Survivor for Cleansing, Repairing, and Sabotaging, up to a maximum of 4/6/8 %.
If all four Survivors are either injured, dying, or hooked, they suffer from the following secondary effect:
Increases the penalty by an additional +12 % to a total of 16/18/20 %.

teachables.name: A Nurse's Calling
teachables.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability:
The Auras of Survivors being healed or healing themselves are revealed to you within 28/30/32 metres.

builds.name: Generic Build
notes: Reliable and well-rounded build; a good starting point until you find the ideal build for your playstyle.
Focuses on damaging generators and inflicting very heavy regression after each hook.
Try the other builds if you want something more "automatic" with less gen kicking involved!

perks.name: Lethal Pursuer
perks.desc:
At the start of the Trial, the Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 7/8/9 seconds.
Extends the duration of all instances of a Survivor Aura being revealed to you by +2 seconds.
Lethal Pursuer benefits from its own effect.

alts.name: Corrupt Intervention
alts.desc:
Your prayers invoke a dark power that meddles with the Survivors' chances of survival.
At the start of the Trial, the 3 Generators located farthest from you are blocked by The Entity for 80/100/120 seconds.
Corrupt Intervention deactivates prematurely once the first Survivor is put into the Dying State.

alts.name: Unforeseen
alts.desc:
After performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator, you benefit from the following effects for 22/26/30 seconds:
Transfers your Terror Radius to the damaged Generator.
This Terror Radius is set to 32 metres.
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect.
Unforeseen has a cool-down of 30 seconds.

perks.name: Barbecue & Chilli
perks.desc:
A deep bond with The Entity unlocks potential in one's Aura-reading ability.
After hooking a Survivor, all Survivors who are at least 60/50/40 metres away from that Hook have their Aura revealed to you for 5 seconds.

alts.name: Alien Instinct
alts.desc:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, Alien Instinct activates:
The Aura of the farthest Survivor from your current location who is in the Injured State is revealed to you for 8 seconds.
Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect for 40/50/60 seconds.

alts.name: Tinkerer
alts.desc:
Whenever a Generator is repaired to 70 %, you benefit from the following effects:
Triggers a Loud Noise Notification for that Generator, revealing its location.
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect for the next 12/14/16 seconds.
Tinkerer can only trigger once per Generator per Trial.

perks.name: Pop Goes the Weasel
perks.desc:
After hooking a Survivor, Pop Goes the Weasel activates for 35/40/45 seconds.
While active, manually damaging a Generator triggers the following effect:
Increases the regression amount by +15 % resulting in 20 % regression.
Pop Goes the Weasel deactivates after use or once its timer elapses.

alts.name: Eruption
alts.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on Generators highlights their Auras in yellow.
Whenever a Survivor enters the Dying State by any means, Eruption triggers the following effects on all highlighted Generators:
Causes them to explode, damaging them.
Instantly regresses them by -10 % of their total Progression.
Causes them to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors currently repairing them to suffer from the following effects:
Causes them to scream.
Their Auras are revealed to you for 8/10/12 seconds.
Eruption has a cool-down of 30 seconds after triggering its effects, which also resets the highlighted Auras.

alts.name: Undone
alts.desc:
For every time you hook a Survivor, Undone gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 1/2/3 Token(s).
Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator consumes all accumulated Tokens and applies the following effects:
Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by a stack-able -10 % of its total Progression per Token, up to a maximum of 10/20/30 %.
Blocks the Damaged Generator for 10 seconds per Token, up to a maximum of 10/20/30 seconds.
Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing once it becomes unblocked.

perks.name: Lay Waste
perks.desc:
Damaging a Generator makes it regress +2 % faster for each Charge it has.
This perk has a cool-down of 55/50/45 seconds after damaging a Generator.

alts.name: Predator
alts.desc:
Whenever you lose a Survivor in a Chase, Predator triggers its effect:
Their Aura is revealed to you for 4 seconds.
Predator has a cool-down of 60/50/40 seconds.

alts.name: Nowhere to Hide
alts.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator triggers Nowhere to Hide:
The Auras of all Survivors within 24 metres of the Generator's location are revealed to you for 3/4/5 seconds.

builds.name: Scourge Build
notes: Trigger strong regression and powerful info when using Scourge Hooks.
Jagged Compass (or Agitation) can help make sure you always have a Scourge Hook available somewhere.
The final perk just helps slow things down further or to help you find people at the start (Lethal Pursuer).

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance
perks.desc:
Overwhelming pain reverberates outwards.
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Start the Trial with 4 Token.
Whenever a Survivor is hooked onto a Scourge Hook for the first time, Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance consumes -1 Token and applies the following effects:
Causes the Generator with the most progression to explode, damaging it.
Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by 10/15/20 % of its total Progression.
Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors repairing the Damaged Generator to scream.
This does not trigger a Loud Noise Notification.
Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance is disabled for the remainder of the Trial once all Tokens are consumed.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Floods of Rage
perks.desc:
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Each time a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook, the following effects apply:
The Auras of all other Survivors are revealed for 5/6/7 seconds.

alts.name: Scourge Hook: Hangman's Trick
alts.desc:
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
While carrying a Survivor, Scourge Hook: Hangman's Trick triggers its primary effect:
The Auras of all Survivors within 12/14/16 metres of a Scourge Hook are revealed to you.
Whenever a Survivor starts the Sabotage action on any Hook, Scourge Hook: Hangman's Trick triggers its secondary effect:
Triggers a Loud Noise Notification at the location of that Hook.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Jagged Compass
perks.desc:
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Whenever a Survivor is unhooked from a normal Hook, the following effect applies:
The Hook is converted into a Scourge Hook.
Whenever you hook a Survivor onto a Scourge Hook, the following effect applies:
The Aura of the Generator with the most progression is highlighted in yellow for 6/8/10 seconds.

alts.name: Agitation
alts.desc:
While carrying a Survivor, Agitation activates:
Increases your Carrying speed by 14/16/18 %.
Increases your Terror Radius by +12 metres.

perks.name: Grim Embrace
perks.desc:
Your act of servitude to The Entity has not gone unnoticed.
Each time a Survivor is hooked for the first time, Grim Embrace gains +1 Token and activates once you are at least 16 metres away from the Hook:
1-3 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 6/8/10 seconds.
4 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 40 seconds and the Aura of the Obsession is revealed to you for 6 seconds.

alts.name: Scourge Hook: Weeping Wounds
alts.desc:
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Each time a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook, the following effects apply:
Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Haemorrhage Status Effect for 90 seconds.
After the first time that Survivor is healed back to full health, they suffer from the following effect until they are injured again by any means:
Reduces their Action speeds for Healing and Repairing by 10/13/16 %.

alts.name: Dead Man's Switch
alts.desc:
After hooking a Survivor, Dead Man's Switch triggers its effect:
The first Generator any Survivor stops repairing for 2 seconds is blocked for 30/35/40 seconds
The Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.
Dead Man's Switch cannot activate if its effect is still active from a previous activation.

alts.name: Lethal Pursuer
alts.desc:
At the start of the Trial, the Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 7/8/9 seconds.
Extends the duration of all instances of a Survivor Aura being revealed to you by +2 seconds.
Lethal Pursuer benefits from its own effect.

builds.name: Hex Control Build
notes: Lethal guides you at the start and Hive Mind will keep you bothering the most progressed gens for a while.
Cleansing totems is time-consuming and dangerous but ignoring them can be deadly for Survivors.

perks.name: Lethal Pursuer
perks.desc:
At the start of the Trial, the Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 7/8/9 seconds.
Extends the duration of all instances of a Survivor Aura being revealed to you by +2 seconds.
Lethal Pursuer benefits from its own effect.

alts.name: Hex: Retribution
alts.desc:
Whenever a Survivor blesses or cleanses a Totem, Hex: Retribution triggers its primary effect:
Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect for 40/50/60 seconds.
Whenever a Hex Totem is removed by any means, including its own, Hex: Retribution triggers its secondary effect:
The Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 20 seconds.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Hex: Hive Mind
perks.desc:
The first time you hook any Survivor, a random Dull Totem becomes a Hex Totem, provided that a Dull Totem remains in the Trial Grounds.
Generators are highlighted; the intensity of the generator's Auras reveals their repair progress.
As soon as a total of 4 generators have been completed in the Trial:
All remaining generators explode, lose 6/8/10 % progess, and start regressing.
The associated Hex Totem becomes dull, and this perk becomes disabled for the remainder of the trial.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Hex: Ruin
perks.desc:
All Generators not currently being repaired experience the following effect:
Causes them to automatically regress at 100/125/150 % of the default Regression rate.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Thrilling Tremors
alts.desc:
After picking up a Survivor, Thrilling Tremors triggers its effects:
Blocks all Generators not currently being repaired by any Survivors for 16 seconds.
The Auras of Blocked Generators are highlighted to you in white.
Thrilling Tremors has a cool-down of 40/35/30 seconds.

alts.name: Discordance
alts.desc:
Any Generator within a range of 64/96/128 metres that is being repaired by 2 or more Survivors is marked by a yellow Aura.
When the Generator is first highlighted, Discordance triggers a Loud Noise Notification on the Generator.
After the Generator is no longer within range or is being repaired by just 1 Survivor, the highlighted Aura will linger for another 4 seconds.

perks.name: Hex: Undying
perks.desc:
Whenever a Survivor is within 2/3/4 metres of a Dull Totem, Hex: Undying triggers its primary effect:
Their Aura is revealed to you for as long as they remain in that range.
Whenever a Hex Totem is cleansed, Hex: Undying triggers its secondary effect:
Transfers the cleansed Hex to the Hex Totem associated with Hex: Undying instead, replacing it.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Dominance
alts.desc:
The power you wield over the land strikes terror in the hearts of all who cross your path.
The first time each Totem are interacted with by a Survivor, Dominance triggers its effect:
Calls upon The Entity to block it for 25 seconds.
The Aura of the blocked Prop is revealed to you in white.
The Survivor screams.
The Survivor's aura is revealed to you for 3/4/5 seconds.

builds.name: Beginner Perks Only
notes: Only uses perks available to this Killer or global perks available to everyone. It might include some alternative perk ideas from one of the five free Killers too.
Consider unlocking Predator from The Wraith as soon as possible, as it is a very powerful tool on Nurse. Tinkerer from The Hillbilly is also a great choice to keep an eye on generators.

perks.name: No Holds Barred
perks.desc:
Each time a Generator is completed, No Holds Barred calls upon The Entity for the following effects:
Blocks the Generator with the most Progression for 15/20/25 seconds.
The Aura of the Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.

perks.name: A Nurse's Calling
perks.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability:
The Auras of Survivors being healed or healing themselves are revealed to you within 28/30/32 metres.

perks.name: Spies from the Shadows
perks.desc:
Whenever a Survivor startles a Crow within 36/38/40 metres of your location, Spies from the Shadows triggers its effect:
Alerts you with a unique Loud Noise Notification in the shape of a Crow.
Spies from the Shadows has a cool-down of 3 seconds between alerts.

alts.name: Bitter Murmur
alts.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability.
Whenever a Generator is completed, Bitter Murmur triggers its primary effect:
The Auras of any Survivors within 20 metres of that Generator are revealed to you for 10 seconds.
Once the last Generator is completed, Bitter Murmur triggers its secondary effect:
The Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 16/18/20 seconds.

alts.name: Tinkerer
alts.desc:
Whenever a Generator is repaired to 70 %, you benefit from the following effects:
Triggers a Loud Noise Notification for that Generator, revealing its location.
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect for the next 12/14/16 seconds.
Tinkerer can only trigger once per Generator per Trial.

alts.name: Predator
alts.desc:
Whenever you lose a Survivor in a Chase, Predator triggers its effect:
Their Aura is revealed to you for 4 seconds.
Predator has a cool-down of 60/50/40 seconds.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Weeping Wounds
perks.desc:
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Each time a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook, the following effects apply:
Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Haemorrhage Status Effect for 90 seconds.
After the first time that Survivor is healed back to full health, they suffer from the following effect until they are injured again by any means:
Reduces their Action speeds for Healing and Repairing by 10/13/16 %.

addons.name: Torn Bookmark
addons.comment: Reduces your blink charge recovery speed, but provides 1 extra blink charge. The slower recovery can be very punishing when mistakes happen, but having 3 blinks makes it almost impossible for Survivors to last more than a few seconds in chase. The extra blink also allows you to perform 2-blink sequences with basically no downtime in between, which can be deadly and result in very quick downs. Overall, a very powerful effect with a manageable downside. Beginner players might want to avoid using this add-on if they don't want to rely on it too much.
addons.desc:
Increases the number of available Power Tokens by +1.
Increases the Power Recharge time to 130 %.

addons.name: Fragile Wheeze
addons.comment: A very simple add-on that is almost always universally useful. Despite the 70 second timer, the Nurse's fast paced gameplay can absolutely make the Mangled effect worth applying, especially when you consider how dangerous it is to remain injured against her.
addons.desc: Survivors hit with a Special Attack suffer from the Mangled Status Effect for 70 seconds.

addons.name: "Bad Man's" Last Breath
addons.comment: The occasional Undetectable status effects prevents your aura from being revealed to Survivors and allows you to catch them by surprise, especially in small maps. A simple add-on that can do a lot of damage and that doesn't require a lot of thinking from your part.
addons.desc:
Hitting Survivors with a Special Attack grants the Undetectable Status Effect for 25 seconds.
"Bad Man's" Last Breath" has a cool-down of 45 seconds.

addons.name: Heavy Panting
addons.comment: A simple but powerful add-on that increases the Nurse's lunge without any downside. Makes it even harder for Survivors to outplay you.
addons.desc:
Extends the Lunge duration of Special Attacks to 110 %, which increases your Attack range by +10 %.
This effect only applies after the second or third Blink.

addons.name: Jenner's Last Breath
addons.comment: A unique add-on that allows you to quickly teleport back to your previous blink location. Not particularly useful for beginners, but advanced players can find several ways to make this ability worth it. Among other things, it allows you to quickly scout an area before returning to the hook or hit a Survivor that runs back into you. Also very useful if you end up teleporting into a wrong floor and need a quick return.
addons.desc:
After exhausting all of your Blinks, but before succumbing to Fatigue, press the Active Ability button to immediately Blink back to your starting location.
Recharges your Power by +1 Charge.

addons.name: Campbell's Last Breath
addons.comment: A fairly complex add-on that allows you to sacrifice your second blink in favor of a shorter, almost instant blink. With a bit of practice, this add-on can help you to cover certain gaps much faster than usual and catch Survivors by surprise. If you don't need to use this effect, you can charge your blink to almost full capacity to avoid wasting it.
addons.desc:
Reappearing from a fully charged Blink, you automatically Blink at full charge in the direction you are facing.
This requires that you have at least 1 Charge left after the initial Blink.

addons.name: Catatonic Boy's Treasure
addons.comment: Reduces some of the extra fatigue that happens when you perform multiple blinks. A small but universally useful effect that can make a difference over the course of the game.
addons.desc: Reduces the additional Fatigue applied by Chain Blinks by -65 %.

addons.name: Ataxic Respiration
addons.comment: Slightly reduces the duration of all fatigues by 7%. The effect is small, but unlike other add-ons, it affects all types of fatigue regardless of circumstances.
addons.desc: Reduces the duration of Fatigue by -7 %.

addons.name: Wooden Horse
addons.comment: This add-on removes half of the fatigue penalty that occurs when you miss a blink attack, saving you half a second each time this happens. This is useful for anyone, but especially for beginner players that still struggle with being accurate.
addons.desc: Reduces the additional Fatigue applied by missed Special Attacks by -0.5 seconds.

addons.name: Bad Man Keepsake
addons.comment: Provides a miniature version of the effect from "A Nurse's Calling", allowing you to see healing Survivors for some time after being hit. Doesn't always come into play, but the effect itself is very useful when it does.
addons.desc: Survivors hit with a Special Attack have their Auras revealed to you, if they are healing or being healed within 28 metres of your location for 60 seconds.

addons.name: Metal Spoon
addons.comment: The increased grunt volume from this add-on is easy to apply and can often make tracking a bit easier. Very decent effect for an add-on of this rarity.
addons.desc: Survivors hit by a Special Attack have the volume of their Grunts of Pain increased by +50 % for the next 60 seconds.

addons.name: Kavanagh's Last Breath
addons.comment: Applies 40 seconds of Blindness to Survivors when you entire fatigue near them. Not a particularly strong or reliable effect, but it's better than nothing and might make a small difference over the course of the match.
addons.desc: When succumbing to Fatigue, all Survivors within 8 metres of your location suffer from the Blindness Status Effect for 60 seconds.

addons.name: Dark Cincture
addons.comment: Increases your movement speed during the period that occurs between blinks. The effect is small, but it can sometimes make a difference since it can allow you to maneuver around an obstacle to gain better visibility before it's too late.
addons.desc: Increases your Movement speed during the Chain Blink Window by +30 %.

addons.name: Anxious Gasp
addons.comment: This add-on can sometimes reveal Survivors that you would have otherwise missed, but overall the screaming effect is quite gimmicky and not very impactful.
addons.desc:
Coming within 1 metre of Survivors while teleporting causes them to scream and reveal their location.
Grants 200 Bloodpoints in the Deviousness Category.

addons.name: Plaid Flannel
addons.comment: This add-on displays a visual marker that roughly shows your landing spot. Some people that suffer from motion sickness while playing Nurse might find it useful as it gives you something to focus on visually. It can also be useful for beginners, especially if they take a bit of time to observe how their inputs affect the final teleporting spot. For non-beginners, this add-on offers no value whatsoever and can be really distracting.
addons.desc: Unlocks the ability to see the Landing zone of the Blink.

addons.name: Matchbox
addons.comment: Increases your movement speed to be almost comparable to the standard Killer, but at the cost of reducing your maximum blink charges by 1. This completely changes the way Nurse is played. Some players might find this appealing for their particular taste, but for the average person this is a downgrade from the normal Nurse.
addons.desc:
Increases your Movement speed to 4.4 m/s for the entire Trial.
Restricts your Power to just 1 Blink.
This cannot be altered by other Add-ons.

addons.name: Pocket Watch
addons.comment: Slightly increases the window of time between blinks, allowing you to have more time to make a decision or charge your next blink for longer. Unfortunately, this also means that if you want to do only one blink you'll be forced to wait even longer before you go into fatigue, wasting extra time. In most scenarios, this add-on will do more harm than good.
addons.desc: Increases the duration of the Chain Blink Window by +0.2 seconds.

addons.name: Spasmodic Breath
addons.comment: Turns the Nurse into a Killer with regular speed for a brief time after a successful blink attack. This can sometimes catch Survivors by surprise or lead to very unexpected situations, which is certainly fun. However, giving up your teleporting ability is a massive downside and there's no good reason to do this if you're playing seriously.
addons.desc:
Hitting a Survivor with a Special Attack causes the following effects for 60 seconds:
Increases your Movement speed to 4.6 m/s.
Disables your Power.

addons.name: White Nit Comb
addons.comment: Reduces the reach of your lunge after a blink, forcing you to be much more precise with them. This is a massive downside that should typically be avoided at all costs, but it can be a decent training tool if you want to challenge yourself.
addons.desc:
Grants +100 % bonus Bloodpoints for Blink Attack Score Events.
Reduces the Lunge duration of Special Attacks by -0.15 seconds, which reduces your Attack range by -50 %.

addons.name: Dull Bracelet
addons.comment: Reduces the maximum range of your blink teleports. This is a massive downside and doesn't even provide a fun challenge. Avoid at all costs unless you are a masochist.
addons.desc:
Grants +100 % bonus Bloodpoints for Precise Blink Score Events.
Reduces the maximum range of the Blink by -20 %.

killers.name: The Huntress
killers.otzComment:
The Huntress punishes careless Survivors with occasional long distance shots and her devastating ability to shred through health states from up close. Despite having low mobility and limited stealth options, her high skill ceiling shines in the hands of experienced players.
The Huntress is a really fun and relatively simple Killer for beginners to use, although her constant lullaby does make it significantly to find and track Survivors. Sadly, her unlockable perks are just not very useful across the board, although you might find some odd synergies with certain niche builds.

The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

addons.name: Oak Haft
addons.comment: Reduces your already short cooldown after throwing a hatchet by 0.2 seconds. This faster recovery is universally useful and allows to do anything sooner: begin to move at normal speed again, throw another hatchet or even follow-up with a basic attack. With this add-on, it becomes possible to consistently interrupt Survivors before they can even perform an unhook.
addons.desc: Reduces the Cool-down duration between successive Hatchet throws by -20 %.

addons.name: Flower Babushka
addons.comment: Increases your wind up speed, allowing you to throw a hatchet a bit earlier by 0.12s. A strong effect that can even be stacked with its green counterpart. Be sure not to get too used to the effect of this add-on, as it might hurt your muscle memory if you suddenly stop using it.
addons.desc: Reduces the Wind-up time of Hatchets by -0.1 seconds.

addons.name: Glowing Concoction
addons.comment: Highlights the aura of Survivors hit by a hatchet, allowing you to do follow-up shots from a distance or effortlessly mindgame them at loops since you can see their exact location. Very strong effect, but can still be countered by certain Survivor perks that conceal their aura.
addons.desc: Survivors hit by Hatchets have their Aura revealed to you for 5 seconds.

addons.name: Bandaged Haft
addons.comment: Reduces your already short cooldown after throwing a hatchet by 0.1 seconds. Not as useful as its green counterpart, but still incredibly powerful for an add-on of this rarity. Can be stacked together.
addons.desc: Reduces the Cool-down duration between successive Hatchet throws by -10 %.

addons.name: Shiny Pin
addons.comment: Provides a noticeable boost to your walking speed while holding a hatchet. This helps in almost every situation, allowing you to lose less distance when Survivors are running away from you. In some loops, the increased speed also allows you to put Survivors in lose-lose situations where you'll hit them before they reach the next corner.
addons.desc: Increases the Movement speed while winding Hatchets up by +5 %.

addons.name: Manna Grass Braid
addons.comment: Increases your wind up speed, allowing you to throw a hatchet a bit earlier by 0.08s. Not a bad effect at all, and can be stacked with its blue counterpart. Be sure not to get too used to the effect of this add-on, as it might hurt your muscle memory if you suddenly stop using it.
addons.desc: Reduces the Wind-up time of Hatchets by -8 %.

addons.name: Iridescent Head
addons.comment: Permanently reduces your maximum hatchet capacity to 1, but makes the hatchet insta-down Survivors. This effect is really powerful and can devastate unprepared teams that fail to play around it. Needless to say, it also makes hook rescues or altruism almost impossible. Overall, however, losing so many hatchets is not necessarily an upgrade against coordinated teams and you might find that this add-on doesn't perform as well against them.
addons.desc:
Survivors hit by Hatchets are automatically put into the Dying State.
Reduces the number of carried Hatchets to 1.

addons.name: Rose Root
addons.comment: Increases the flight speed of your hatchets, making them fly straighter and hit their targets a bit earlier. This is particularly noticeable for long distance shots, but keep in mind that you'll need to get used to the slightly different hatchet flight angle.
addons.desc: Increases the Projectile speed of Hatchets by +20 %.

addons.name: Venomous Concoction
addons.comment: Inflicts the Exhausted status effect, making Survivors much more predictable in chase and removing several common options for them to gain distance.
addons.desc: Survivors hit by Hatchets suffer from the Exhausted Status Effect for 5 seconds.

addons.name: Wooden Fox
addons.comment: Makes you Undetectable for a period of time after reloading from a locker. Despite not removing the permanent lullaby, losing your terror radius and being immune to aura reading can still catch many Survivors by surprise. Particularly useful in indoor maps where Survivors have no visibility from afar.
addons.desc: Grants the Undetectable Status Effect after reloading at Lockers for 30 seconds.

addons.name: Begrimed Head
addons.comment: Inflicts both Mangled and Haemorrhage with each hatchet attack, which is pretty useful given the Huntress' natural ability to injure several Survivors quickly and punish teams that do not heal. Should not be used together with its blue counterpart, since they share the same effects and they do not stack.
addons.desc: Survivors hit by Hatchets suffer from the Haemorrhage and Mangled Status Effects for 80 seconds.

addons.name: Rusty Head
addons.comment: Inflicts the Mangled status effect each hatchet attack, which is pretty useful given the Huntress' natural ability to injure several Survivors quickly and punish teams that do not heal.
addons.desc: Survivors hit by Hatchets suffer from the Mangled Status Effect for 70 seconds.

addons.name: Amanita Toxin
addons.comment: Inflicts the Blindness status effect on Survivors hit by a hatchet. Quite easy to apply, and lasts long enought to deny the natural aura reading that Survivors have while they're on the hook. Not super impactful, but not too bad either.
addons.desc: Survivors hit by Hatchets suffer from the Blindness Status Effect for 60 seconds.

addons.name: Coarse Stone
addons.comment: Increases the grunt volume of Survivors injured by hatchets, which helps with tracking. Notably, this effect does not have a timer and remains on indefinitely until the Survivor heals. Not bad at all for an add-on of this rarity.
addons.desc: Increases the volume of Grunts of Pain of injured Survivors hit by Hatchets by +50 %.

addons.name: Yellowed Cloth
addons.comment: Increases the flight speed of your hatchets, making them fly straighter and hit their targets a bit earlier. This is particularly noticeable for long distance shots, but keep in mind that you'll need to get used to the slightly different hatchet flight angle.
addons.desc: Increases the Projectile speed of Hatchets by +10 %.

addons.name: Weighted Head
addons.comment: Inflicts the rare Incapacitated status effect, making Survivors unable to do certain actions such as healing or repairing for a few seconds. In some rare situations, this add-on can have a massive impact by denying the ability to quickly finish a generator or preventing someone from quickly using an item during chase. Outside of these rare scenarios, this add-on doesn't have much impact at all since Survivors can still perform many important actions: vaulting, pallet dropping, opening gates, unhooking...
addons.desc: Survivors hit by Hatchets suffer from the Incapacitated Status Effect for 10 seconds.

addons.name: Infantry Belt
addons.comment: Provides a tiny increase of movement speed after landing a hatchet shot. Sadly this effect is simply too small to make a significant difference and you're almost always better off running one of the two hatchet throw cooldown add-ons instead.
addons.desc: Successfully hitting a Survivor with a Hatchet grants a +3 % Haste Status Effect for 5 seconds.

addons.name: Deerskin Gloves
addons.comment: Saves you approximately 0.6 seconds each time you reload at a locker. A nice and simple effect, but ideally you should not be reloading often enough to benefit too much from it. Can be stacked with the perk "Iron Maiden" for even faster reloading speed.
addons.desc: Reduces the Reload time of Hatchets at Lockersto 80 % of its default value.

addons.name: Soldier's Puttee
addons.comment: Increases your movement from 110% (4.4m/s) to 115% (4.6m/s) when completely out of hatchets, allowing you to chase as a standard Killer. Might sound appealing at first, but this is a situation that you almost always want to avoid in the first place. Even when used together with the Iridescent Head, you might find other add-ons to be better alternatives.
addons.desc: Increases the Movement speed of The Huntress to 4.6 m/s while out of Hatchets.

addons.name: Leather Loop
addons.comment: Provides a tiny increase of movement speed after landing a hatchet shot. Sadly this effect is simply too small to make a significant difference and you're almost always better off running one of the two hatchet throw cooldown add-ons instead.
addons.desc: Successfully hitting a Survivor with a Hatchet grants a +2 % Haste Status Effect for 5 seconds.

NOT AVAILABLE: As of January 2026, the Halloween Chapter is no longer available for purchase in Dead by Daylight unless you purchased it previously. The Shape's personal perks have now become global perks available to all Killers and are unlocked by default.
Myers is a versatile Killer that can sneak up on Survivors one moment and chase them loudly with an instadown ability the next. His perks are rather difficult to use and managing his different modes optimally can be a bit challenging for beginners, however.

teachables.name: Play with Your Food

teachables.name: Dying Light
teachables.desc: Identical to Cull the Weak.

builds.name: Generic Build
notes: Reliable and well-rounded build; a safe choice if you've got these perks unlocked.
With Lethal Pursuer, you'll have a really easy time stalking and/or ambushing your first target. Remember where everyone went and try to disrupt several of them when you activate Evil Within.
Ruin and Hive Mind allow to passively monitor & regress generators across the map.

perks.name: Lethal Pursuer
perks.desc:
At the start of the Trial, the Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 7/8/9 seconds.
Extends the duration of all instances of a Survivor Aura being revealed to you by +2 seconds.
Lethal Pursuer benefits from its own effect.

perks.name: Hex: Hive Mind
perks.desc:
The first time you hook any Survivor, a random Dull Totem becomes a Hex Totem, provided that a Dull Totem remains in the Trial Grounds.
Generators are highlighted; the intensity of the generator's Auras reveals their repair progress.
As soon as a total of 4 generators have been completed in the Trial:
All remaining generators explode, lose 6/8/10 % progess, and start regressing.
The associated Hex Totem becomes dull, and this perk becomes disabled for the remainder of the trial.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Hex: Retribution
alts.desc:
Whenever a Survivor blesses or cleanses a Totem, Hex: Retribution triggers its primary effect:
Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect for 40/50/60 seconds.
Whenever a Hex Totem is removed by any means, including its own, Hex: Retribution triggers its secondary effect:
The Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 20 seconds.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Tinkerer
alts.desc:
Whenever a Generator is repaired to 70 %, you benefit from the following effects:
Triggers a Loud Noise Notification for that Generator, revealing its location.
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect for the next 12/14/16 seconds.
Tinkerer can only trigger once per Generator per Trial.

alts.name: Barbecue & Chilli
alts.desc:
A deep bond with The Entity unlocks potential in one's Aura-reading ability.
After hooking a Survivor, all Survivors who are at least 60/50/40 metres away from that Hook have their Aura revealed to you for 5 seconds.

perks.name: Hex: Ruin
perks.desc:
All Generators not currently being repaired experience the following effect:
Causes them to automatically regress at 100/125/150 % of the default Regression rate.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Hex: Undying
perks.desc:
Whenever a Survivor is within 2/3/4 metres of a Dull Totem, Hex: Undying triggers its primary effect:
Their Aura is revealed to you for as long as they remain in that range.
Whenever a Hex Totem is cleansed, Hex: Undying triggers its secondary effect:
Transfers the cleansed Hex to the Hex Totem associated with Hex: Undying instead, replacing it.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Dominance
alts.desc:
The power you wield over the land strikes terror in the hearts of all who cross your path.
The first time each Totem are interacted with by a Survivor, Dominance triggers its effect:
Calls upon The Entity to block it for 25 seconds.
The Aura of the blocked Prop is revealed to you in white.
The Survivor screams.
The Survivor's aura is revealed to you for 3/4/5 seconds.

builds.name: Gen Surveillance Build
notes: Your first two perks passively damage and regress generators, while Surveillance highlights them for you.
Don't forget to check which generator changes color after each trigger of Pain Resonance!
Your final perk is a flexible pick, use whatever you like!

perks.name: Turn Back the Clock
perks.desc: After hooking a Survivor, for 40/50/60 seconds, press the Active Ability button to make a target generator within 20 meters explode, lose -10 % progress, and start regressing.

perks.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability:
The Auras of damaged Generators are highlighted based on their current state:
White Aura: The Generator is currently regressing.
Yellow Aura: The Generator stopped regressing due to Survivor-intervention.
This effect lasts for 8/12/16 seconds, after which the Generator Aura returns to its default colour.
While Survivors are repairing Generators, they suffer from the following effect:
Increases the audible range of all noises related to the Repair interaction by +8 metres.

perks.name: Bamboozle
perks.desc:
You benefit from the following permanent effect:
Increases your Vaulting speed by 5/10/15 %.
Whenever you vault a Window, Bamboozle calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks it to all Survivors for 8/12/16 seconds.
Vaulting it again within that time resets the timer.
Vaulting a different one transfers the effect to it instead.
Bamboozle does not extend its effects to vaulting a dropped Pallet.

alts.name: Agitation
alts.desc:
While carrying a Survivor, Agitation activates:
Increases your Carrying speed by 14/16/18 %.
Increases your Terror Radius by +12 metres.

alts.name: A Nurse's Calling
alts.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability:
The Auras of Survivors being healed or healing themselves are revealed to you within 28/30/32 metres.

alts.name: No Way Out
alts.desc:
Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, No Way Out gains +1 Token.
Once the Exit Gates are powered, No Way Out activates:
Causes the first Survivor to interact with either Exit Gate Switch to trigger a Loud Noise Notification at their location.
Upon triggering the Loud Noise Notification, No Way Out calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks both Exit Gate Switches for 12 seconds.
This time is extended by an additional 6/9/12 seconds per accumulated Token, up to a combined maximum of 36/48/60 seconds.

builds.name: Obsession Roulette
notes: Hooking a Survivor highlights the Obsession (or switches it), debuffs them, and gives you haste to possibly down them very fast.
Spirit Fury is easy to activate (since your EW attack breaks pallets) and works great with Myers' basekit shorter stun time (outside of Stalker mode).
This build is best used with the iridescent Judith's Tombstone to constantly reset the EW mode's timer.

perks.name: Friends 'til the End
perks.desc:
When you hook any Survivors that is not the Obsession, the following effects apply to the Obsession:
Their Aura is revealed for 6/8/10 seconds.
They suffer from the Exposed Status Effect for 20 seconds.
When you hook the Obsession, the following effects apply to a random Survivor:
Causes the Survivor to scream and reveal their location to the Killer.
They become the new Obsession.
You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

perks.name: Furtive Chase
perks.desc:
After hooking the Obsession, you benefit from the following effects for 14/16/18 seconds:
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect.
Grants a +10 % Haste Status Effect.
Whenever the Obsession is unhooked by another Survivor, the Obsession Status transfers to their Rescuer.
You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

perks.name: Nemesis
perks.desc:
Whenever a Survivor other than your Obsession blinds you by any means or stuns you with a Pallet or a Locker, Nemesis triggers its primary effect:
Causes that Survivor to become your current Obsession.
Whenever your Obsession switches to a different Survivor by any means, Nemesis triggers its secondary effects:
Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect for 40/50/60 seconds.
Their Aura is revealed to you for 8 seconds.
You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

perks.name: Spirit Fury
perks.desc:
After manually breaking a total of 4/3/2  dropped Pallets by any means, Spirit Fury activates:
Instantly breaks the next Pallet used by a Survivor to stun you.
Spirit Fury deactivates after use and does not affect the duration of the Pallet Stun.

alts.name: No Way Out
alts.desc:
Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, No Way Out gains +1 Token.
Once the Exit Gates are powered, No Way Out activates:
Causes the first Survivor to interact with either Exit Gate Switch to trigger a Loud Noise Notification at their location.
Upon triggering the Loud Noise Notification, No Way Out calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks both Exit Gate Switches for 12 seconds.
This time is extended by an additional 6/9/12 seconds per accumulated Token, up to a combined maximum of 36/48/60 seconds.

builds.name: Beginner Perks Only
notes: Only uses perks available to this Killer or global perks available to everyone. It might include some alternative perk ideas from one of the five free Killers too.

Move around the map quickly in Pursuer mode and quickly switch to Stalker mode when you notice your perk "Whispers" activates. This is a really efficient way to find Survivors and only use the slower stealth form when necessary!
If you'd prefer a simpler info perk, "Spies from the Shadows" is also a good alternative!

perks.name: No Holds Barred
perks.desc:
Each time a Generator is completed, No Holds Barred calls upon The Entity for the following effects:
Blocks the Generator with the most Progression for 15/20/25 seconds.
The Aura of the Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.

After the first time that Survivor is healed back to full health, they suffer from the following effect until they are injured again by any means:
Reduces their Action speeds for Healing and Repairing by 10/13/16 %.

alts.name: Brutal Strength
alts.desc:
While performing the Break or Damage action on Breakable Walls, Pallets, or Generators, Brutal Strength triggers its effect:
Increases the Action speed by 10/15/20 %.

perks.name: Whispers
perks.desc:
Whenever any Survivor is within 28/26/24 metres of your location:
Causes you to hear the sporadic whispers of The Entity, indicating a Survivor's presence.
Whenever any Survivor is outside 28/26/24 metres of your location:
Gain +5 % Haste Status Effect.

alts.name: Spies from the Shadows
alts.desc:
Whenever a Survivor startles a Crow within 36/38/40 metres of your location, Spies from the Shadows triggers its effect:
Alerts you with a unique Loud Noise Notification in the shape of a Crow.
Spies from the Shadows has a cool-down of 3 seconds between alerts.

perks.name: Hex: Fortune's Fool
perks.desc:
If there is still a Dull Totem in the environment, Hex: Fortune's Fool lights a Hex Totem whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, cursing them with its Hex Effects.
Inflicts the Oblivious Status Effect.
Blocks the Hex Totem for all other Survivors for 90 seconds.
Blocked Hex Totems cannot be cleansed or blessed by Survivors.
This does not affect the Cursed Survivor.
The Aura of the Hex Totem is revealed to the Cursed Survivor within 24/20/16 metres.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

addons.name: Judith's Tombstone
addons.comment: Resets the timer of the Evil Within mode after hooking a Survivor, making it easier to keep the pressure up if there are still Survivors nearby (although its duration can never be extended with other add-ons now). This effect can be particularly devastating if you also bring specific perks to make you stealthy or keep the momentum going after each hook (such as the combo of "Friends til' the End" + "Furtive Chase"). This add-on can also be paired with the purple Lock of Hair in case you want to immediately end your power and keep 50% of it as stalk progress. Keep in mind that this add-on has the downside of locking the duration of Evil Within to 40 seconds, making it not work with certain other add-ons.
addons.desc:
Modifies Evil Incarnate with the following effects:
Hooking a Survivor while in Evil Incarnate will refresh its duration.
Caps the maximum duration of Evil Incarnate at 40 seconds.

addons.name: Hair Brush
addons.comment: When activating Evil Within mode, your next pallet break is much faster, an effect that can be further stacked with perks of similar nature. Sounds somewhat redundant when you remember that the Evil Within special attack already shred through pallets pretty quickly, but doing this slows you down and makes your strike go on cooldown. Being able to shred through a pallet very fast can speed up chases very significantly (especially if you trick a Survivor into positioning themselves badly right before you do it). Since it's an add-on, it does not suffer from the effects of diminishing returns so you can pair it with perks like Brutal Strength for even faster pallet breaks. Keep in mind that this one-time pallet breaking bonus does not remain after Evil Within ends, so you cannot save it for later.
addons.desc:
When Evil Incarnate activates, Hair Brush triggers its effect:
Increases the Action speed of the next Pallet break action by +50 %.

addons.name: Mirror Shard
addons.comment: Increases the duration of your slaughtering strike by 0.25 seconds, making it last a total of 1.75 seconds at full charge. Interestingly, it gives you this extra duration on your strike even if you don't fully charge it. It's a strong effect that will generally make you even deadlier in small loops where a Survivor has to make a play and can't afford to just walk away. However, it comes with a small downside of a slightly longer charge time that could mess with your muscle memory if you're still not used to it. Keep this in mind when using it. Needless to say, this add-on is not useful at all if you're doing some kind of gimmick where the slaughtering strike ability is not used (such as Scratched Mirror builds).
addons.desc:
Modifies Slaughtering Strike with the following effects:
Increases the base duration of Slaughtering Strike by +0.25 seconds.
Decreases the charge speed of Slaughtering Strike by -25 %.

addons.name: Tombstone Piece
addons.comment: Provides a decent 20 seconds of Undetectable status effect when activating the Evil Within mode, which can be used strategically in a variety of ways to catch Survivors by surprise (who might be expecting a huge terror radius instead). Keep in mind that the iridescent Judith's Tombstone does not re-trigger this add-on's effect when hooking someone. If you're running this, try using other add-ons that allow you to re-enter Evil Within mode often rather than extending it.
addons.desc:
Activating Evil Incarnate triggers the following effect:
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect for 20 seconds.

addons.name: Vanity Mirror
addons.comment: Shows you the auras of all Survivors when Evil Within mode ends, allowing you to plan out your next chase and possibly ambush someone with the Stalker mode. This obviously doesn't help you in chase but the information can be invaluable. A really useful effect in general but particularly so if you're ending the mode manually with the purple Lock of Hair, since you can choose when to benefit from the aura read.
addons.desc:
Modifies Evil Incarnate with the following effect:
When Evil Incarnate ends, the Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 4 seconds.

addons.name: Lock of Hair
addons.comment: Unlocks the ability to manually end the Evil Within mode and keep the remaining gauge as stalk progress which makes it easier to return to Evil Within mode again sooner. A useful effect that pairs well with a variety of other add-ons that revolve around entering or leaving Evil Within mode.
addons.desc:
Unlocks the following ability while in Evil Incarnate:
Hold the Active Ability button to end Evil Incarnate prematurely.
This converts 50 % of the remaining duration into Stalk progress.

addons.name: Hair Bow
addons.comment: Increases the duration of Evil Within mode by 20 seconds (bringing it to a total of 60 seconds) but also increases the stalk time required to reach it. Potentially outclassed by the iridescent Judith's Tombstone if you plan on hooking a Survivor that you've downed, but it's still a decent effect. You can try to mitigate the downside of this add-on by pairing with something like the blue Jewelry Box.
addons.desc:
Modifies Evil Incarnate with the following effects:
Increases the duration of Evil Incarnate by +20 seconds.
Reduces the Power speed of Stalking by -20 %.

addons.name: Jewellery Box
addons.comment: Significantly improves your overall stalking rate at the cost of reducing your stalk range from 32 to 16 meters, effectively halving it. This seems like a harsh penalty that removes some stalking opportunities in large open maps, but in practice you will still be able to stalk Survivors in most situations perfectly fine, even with just a 16 meter range stalk.
addons.desc:
Modifies the Stalk ability with the following effect:
Increases the Power speed of Stalking by +30 %.
Decreases the range of Stalking by -16 metres.

addons.name: Dead Rabbit
addons.comment: Decreases your terror radius while in Pursuer mode (making it 16m instead of 24m) and increases it during Evil Wihin mode (making it 50m instead of 40m). The extra stealth during Pursuer mode isn't terrible but it might not be very necessary if you're switching to the Stalker mode when attempting to ambush. However, it's still quite useful since the game locks you into Pursuer mode when your stalk meter is full. The bigger terror radius during Evil Within mode could be used to trigger the effects of some perks but it's otherwise not very valuable on its own.
addons.desc:
Adjusts the Terror Radius, depending on the current Mode of Evil Within:
Pursuer Mode: Reduces it by -25 %.
Evil Incarnate: Increases it by +25 %.

addons.name: Judith's Journal
addons.comment: Significantly improves your stalking rate when stalking the Obsession. Not the most reliable by itself but it can pair well with perks that change or reveal the Obsession, especially with a build centered around it.
addons.desc:
While Stalking the Obsession, you benefit from the following effect:
Increases the Power speed of Stalking by +40 %.

addons.name: Tacky Earrings
addons.comment: Increases your movement speed while actively stalking. A noticeable effect that makes the process feel quite smoother. Not very strong by any means but a decent choice considering its rarity. Just remember that stalking while moving gains less progress than stalking while standing still. This add-on is for those situations where standing still isn't an option.
addons.desc:
Modifies Evil Within with the following effect:
Increases your Movement speed while Stalking by +20 %.

addons.name: J. Myers Memorial
addons.comment: Massively speeds up the pick-up and hook actions during Evil Within mode. This saves a bit of time but doesn't even come close to the extra time that you'd get from the iridescent Judith's Tombstone or the blue Hair Bow. The real value from this add-on comes from the fact that it makes flashlight and pallet rescues much harder to pull off. The quicker hook animation might also occasionally catch Survivors by surprise.
addons.desc:
While in Evil Incarnate, the following effect applies:
Increases the speed of Picking up and Hooking Survivors by +40 %.

addons.name: Boyfriend's Memo
addons.comment: Extends the maximum stalk range by 8 meters, making it 40 meters in total. Mostly unnecessary unless you're in a huge map with very long lines of sight. It can be used to mitigate the downside of the blue Jewelry Box.
addons.desc:
Modifies the Stalk ability with the following effect:
Increases the range of Stalking by +8 metres.

addons.name: Memorial Flower
addons.comment: Increases your movement speed to 4.4m/s while in Stalker mode, making you move at 110% of the normal Survivor speed instead of 105%. Ideally, you shouldn't be using the stalker mode unnecessarily to the point where this add-on is constantly in play, but it's obviously really good with the iridescent Scratched Mirror that permanently locks you into Stalker mode.
addons.desc:
Modifies Stalker Mode with the following effect:
Increases your Movement speed by +0.2 m/s to 4.4 m/s.

addons.name: Jewellery
addons.comment: Increases the stalk rate by 10% on stationary, non-moving Survivors. This can help you activate Evil Within mode a bit faster if Survivors fail to notice you stalking them when working on a generator, for example. However, the extra 10% is not that noticeable and you're probably better off using something else.
addons.desc:
When Stalking stationary Survivors, you benefit from the following effect:
Increases the Power speed of Stalking by +10 %.

addons.name: Glass Fragment
addons.comment: Increases the movement speed of the slaughtering strike by 5%, but at the cost of longer charge time. This effect should theoretically make your power harder to avoid in situations where a Survivor is already cornered and you have plenty of time to fully charge it. However, in practice, the slightly faster speed is rarely worth the add-on slot and the downside of 10% slower charge.
addons.desc:
Modifies Slaughtering Strike with the following effects:
Increases the Movement speed of Slaughtering Strike by +5 %.
Decreases the Charge speed of Slaughtering Strike by -10 %.

addons.name: Blond Hair
addons.comment: Doubles the duration of scratchmarks and blood left on the environment by Survivors when you're in Stalker mode. It's a considerable effect but one that you generally don't need as much as you'd think. Keep in mind that seeing extremely old scratchmarks could make you start chasing a Survivor that is already extremely far away and lead to unproductive chases.
addons.desc:
While in Stalker Mode, you benefit from the following effect:
Increases the duration of Scratch Marks and Pools of Blood by +100 %.

addons.name: Fragrant Tuft of Hair
addons.comment: Removes Myers' new slaughtering strike and replaces it with a longer lunge Basic Attack that automatically applies the Exposed status effect to all Survivors, essentially reenabling his old power kit. This add-on gives you a more immediate instadown (although you still have to go through the mode transition animation) and can help you have better synergy with certain perks that would only trigger with basic attacks and that would normally not work with his special slaughtering strike. Losing the slaughtering strike ability makes your power worse in certain loops and also removes your ability to break pallets quickly with it. Use it only if you really know what you're doing or if you want to have a simplified version of his power for some reason.
addons.desc:
During Evil Incarnate, the following effects apply:
Survivors suffer from the Exposed Status Effect.
Increases the Lunge Range by +50 %.
Disables the Slaughtering Strike ability.

addons.name: Scratched Mirror
addons.comment: Gives the Stalker mode a very significant aura read on Survivors when stalking, but it permanently locks you into it. This effect can be absolutely terrifying in certain maps (mostly the indoor ones) but will often not be nearly as impactful in more open maps with good visibility for Survivors. You'll most likely want to pair this with the brown Memorial Flower add-on to benefit from the increased 4.4m/s movement speed. Against prepared teams, the downsides of this add-on might be too much but it can certainly be strong if you know what you're doing and fully lean into a stealthy hit and run playstyle. Just be sure to understand the risks of this add-on before you use it.
addons.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability while Stalking:
The Auras of all Survivors within 32 metres of your location are revealed to you.
Hitting Survivors with your Basic Attack grants the following bonus Bloodpoints:
Brutality Scoring Category: +100 %
Deviousness Scoring Category: +200 %
Evil Within loses the ability to exit Stalker Mode.

addons.name: Reflective Fragment
addons.comment: Extends the duration of your Evil Within mode each time you land a hit by 20 seconds (making it easier to keep it going for a long time) but at the cost of making your slaughtering strike not instadown Survivors. This downside is absolutely crippling and makes this add-on generally not worth running, especially when you consider that there are other add-ons to extend the Evil Within duration without compromising its lethality.
addons.desc:
Modifies Slaughtering Strike with the following effects:
Survivors hit by Slaughtering Strike are only damaged for a single Health State.
Successful hits with Slaughtering Strike instantly add +20 seconds to the duration of Evil Incarnate.

perks.desc:
You benefit from the following permanent effect:
Increases your Vaulting speed by 5/10/15 %.
Whenever you vault a Window, Bamboozle calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks it to all Survivors for 8/12/16 seconds.
Vaulting it again within that time resets the timer.
Vaulting a different one transfers the effect to it instead.
Bamboozle does not extend its effects to vaulting a dropped Pallet.
perks.name: Bamboozle

perks.desc:
Your prayers invoke a dark power that meddles with the Survivors' chances of survival.
At the start of the Trial, the 3 Generators located farthest from you are blocked by The Entity for 80/100/120 seconds.
Corrupt Intervention deactivates prematurely once the first Survivor is put into the Dying State.
perks.name: Corrupt Intervention

perks.desc:
Overwhelming pain reverberates outwards.
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Start the Trial with 4 Token.
Whenever a Survivor is hooked onto a Scourge Hook for the first time, Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance consumes -1 Token and applies the following effects:
Causes the Generator with the most progression to explode, damaging it.
Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by 10/15/20 % of its total Progression.
Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors repairing the Damaged Generator to scream.
This does not trigger a Loud Noise Notification.
Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance is disabled for the remainder of the Trial once all Tokens are consumed.
perks.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance

perks.name: Turn Back The Clock

perks.desc:
After hooking a Survivor, Pop Goes the Weasel activates for 35/40/45 seconds.
While active, manually damaging a Generator triggers the following effect:
Increases the regression amount by +15 % resulting in 20 % regression.
Pop Goes the Weasel deactivates after use or once its timer elapses.
perks.name: Pop Goes the Weasel

Causes them to explode, damaging them.
Instantly regresses them by -10 % of their total Progression.
Causes them to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors currently repairing them to suffer from the following effects:
Causes them to scream.
Their Auras are revealed to you for 8/10/12 seconds.
Eruption has a cool-down of 30 seconds after triggering its effects, which also resets the highlighted Auras.
perks.name: Eruption

perks.desc:
While performing the Break or Damage action on Breakable Walls, Pallets, or Generators, Brutal Strength triggers its effect:
Increases the Action speed by 10/15/20 %.
perks.name: Brutal Strength

perks.desc:
You benefit from the following effect:
Reduces the duration of Pallet Stuns by 40/45/50 %.
This effect does not apply when stunned while carrying a Survivor.
perks.name: Enduring

perks.desc:
You benefit from the following permanent effect:
Increases your Vaulting speed by 5/10/15 %.
Whenever you vault a Window, Bamboozle calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks it to all Survivors for 8/12/16 seconds.
Vaulting it again within that time resets the timer.
Vaulting a different one transfers the effect to it instead.
Bamboozle does not extend its effects to vaulting a dropped Pallet.
perks.name: Bamboozle

perks.desc:
After manually breaking a total of 4/3/2  dropped Pallets by any means, Spirit Fury activates:
Instantly breaks the next Pallet used by a Survivor to stun you.
Spirit Fury deactivates after use and does not affect the duration of the Pallet Stun.
perks.name: Spirit Fury

perks.desc:
While carrying a Survivor, Agitation activates:
Increases your Carrying speed by 14/16/18 %.
Increases your Terror Radius by +12 metres.
perks.name: Agitation

perks.desc:
After hooking the Obsession, you benefit from the following effects for 14/16/18 seconds:
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect.
Grants a +10 % Haste Status Effect.
Whenever the Obsession is unhooked by another Survivor, the Obsession Status transfers to their Rescuer.
You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.
perks.name: Furtive Chase

perks.desc:
Whenever a Survivor other than your Obsession blinds you by any means or stuns you with a Pallet or a Locker, Nemesis triggers its primary effect:
Causes that Survivor to become your current Obsession.
Whenever your Obsession switches to a different Survivor by any means, Nemesis triggers its secondary effects:
Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect for 40/50/60 seconds.
Their Aura is revealed to you for 8 seconds.
You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.
perks.name: Nemesis

perks.desc:
When you hook any Survivors that is not the Obsession, the following effects apply to the Obsession:
Their Aura is revealed for 6/8/10 seconds.
They suffer from the Exposed Status Effect for 20 seconds.
When you hook the Obsession, the following effects apply to a random Survivor:
Causes the Survivor to scream and reveal their location to the Killer.
They become the new Obsession.
You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.
perks.name: Friends ‘Til the End

perks.desc:
While performing the Break or Damage action on Breakable Walls, Pallets, or Generators, Brutal Strength triggers its effect:
Increases the Action speed by 10/15/20 %.
perks.name: Brutal Strength

perks.desc:
The increased pressure of losing your preys fills you with anger and gives you unsuspected motivation.
For each completed Generator, Fire Up gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 5 Tokens:
Increases the Action speeds for the following interactions by a stack-able 6/7/8 % per Token, up to a maximum of 30/35/40 %:
Picking up and dropping Survivors.
Breaking Breakable Walls and dropped Pallets.
Damaging Generators.
Vaulting Windows.
perks.name: Fire Up

perks.desc:
You benefit from the following permanent effect:
Increases your Vaulting speed by 5/10/15 %.
Whenever you vault a Window, Bamboozle calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks it to all Survivors for 8/12/16 seconds.
Vaulting it again within that time resets the timer.
Vaulting a different one transfers the effect to it instead.
Bamboozle does not extend its effects to vaulting a dropped Pallet.
perks.name: Bamboozle

perks.desc:
Whenever a Survivor performs a Rush Vault action within 12 metres of your location, Superior Anatomy activates for 10 seconds:
Increases your Vaulting speed by 30/35/40 %.
Superior Anatomy has a cool-down of 20 seconds.
perks.name: Superior Anatomy

Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect for 40/50/60 seconds.
Their Aura is revealed to you for 8 seconds.
You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.
perks.name: Nemesis

perks.desc:
Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, No Way Out gains +1 Token.
Once the Exit Gates are powered, No Way Out activates:
Causes the first Survivor to interact with either Exit Gate Switch to trigger a Loud Noise Notification at their location.
Upon triggering the Loud Noise Notification, No Way Out calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks both Exit Gate Switches for 12 seconds.
This time is extended by an additional 6/9/12 seconds per accumulated Token, up to a combined maximum of 36/48/60 seconds.
perks.name: No Way Out

When you hook the Obsession, the following effects apply to a random Survivor:

They become the new Obsession.
You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.
perks.name: Friends ‘Til the End

perks.desc:
While carrying a Survivor, they suffer from the following effects:
Reduces the strength of the Involuntary Strafing caused by their wiggling by -75 %.
Increases the time required to break free from your grasp by 10/11/12 %.
perks.name: Iron Grasp

perks.desc:
While carrying a Survivor, Agitation activates:
Increases your Carrying speed by 14/16/18 %.
Increases your Terror Radius by +12 metres.
perks.name: Agitation

perks.desc:
Whenever you are carrying a Survivor, Mad Grit activates:
Removes the Cool-down of missed Basic Attacks.
Pauses the Wiggle Progression of the carried Survivor for 2/3/4 seconds each time you successfully hit another Survivor.
perks.name: Mad Grit

perks.desc:
While carrying a Survivor, you benefit from the following effect:
The Auras of other Survivors within 16/18/20 metres of your location are revealed to you.
perks.name: Awakened Awareness

killers.name: The Hag
killers.otzComment:
The Hag is mostly a defensive Killer, relying on careful trap placement and anticipating Survivor movements ahead of time. If they fail to harass you during your preparation, they will often find themselves in unwinnable scenarios.
The Hag is an incredibly unique Killer that does not rely on conventional chase and instead requires you to set up a perimeter ahead of time. Despite being quite difficult for some players, beginners might still want to level her up to unlock her incredibly valuable hex perks, especially Hex: Ruin which can provide some of the best generator slowdown available. Using her iridescent add-on (Waterlogged Shoe) turns her into a much simpler Killer, which can be another way to enjoy her if you don't feel like learning her unique playstyle.

teachables.name: Hex: The Third Seal
teachables.desc:
The last 2/3/4  Survivors you hit with a Basic or Special Attack suffer permanently from the Blindness Status Effect.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

teachables.name: Hex: Ruin
teachables.desc:
All Generators not currently being repaired experience the following effect:
Causes them to automatically regress at 100/125/150 % of the default Regression rate.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

teachables.name: Hex: Devour Hope
teachables.desc:
Hex: Devour Hope lights a Hex Totem at the start of the Trial, cursing Survivors with its Hex Effects.
Whenever a Survivor is unhooked at least 24 metres from your location, Hex: Devour Hope gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 5 Tokens:
At 2 Tokens: 10 seconds after hooking a Survivor, you are granted a 3/4/5 % Haste Status Effect for 10 seconds.
At 3 Tokens: Afflicts all Survivors with the Exposed Status Effect.
At 5 Tokens: Unlocks the Kill ability, allowing you to kill dying Survivors by your own hands.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

builds.name: Generic Build
notes: Reliable and well-rounded build; a good starting point until you find the ideal build for your playstyle.

alts.name: Grim Embrace
alts.desc:
Your act of servitude to The Entity has not gone unnoticed.
Each time a Survivor is hooked for the first time, Grim Embrace gains +1 Token and activates once you are at least 16 metres away from the Hook:
1-3 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 6/8/10 seconds.
4 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 40 seconds and the Aura of the Obsession is revealed to you for 6 seconds.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc:
Basic Attacks benefit from the following effect:
Increases the recovery speed of missed basic-attacks by 30/35/40 %.
Increases the recovery speed of successful basic-attacks by 10 %.

alts.name: Sloppy Butcher
alts.desc:
Survivors hit with your vicious Basic Attack suffer from the following effects for 70/80/90 seconds:
Inflicts the Haemorrhage and Mangled Status Effects.

Increases the Spawn frequency of Pools of Blood by 50/75/100 %.
Increases the Regression rate of partial Healing progression by +25 %.

perks.name: Hex: No One Escapes Death
perks.desc:
Once the Exit Gates are powered, if there is still a Dull Totem remaining in the environment, Hex: No One Escapes Death activates and lights it:
Grants a 2/3/4 % Haste Status Effect.
Causes all Survivors to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect.
Once the Status Effect is revealed to Survivors, Hex: No One Escapes Death triggers the following effect:
The Aura of its Hex Totem is revealed to all Survivors within 4 metres.
This range gradually expands to 24 metres over the course of 30 seconds.
Hex: No One Escapes Death remains inactive if no Dull Totems are available.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Hex: Ruin
perks.desc:
All Generators not currently being repaired experience the following effect:
Causes them to automatically regress at 100/125/150 % of the default Regression rate.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Hex: Wretched Fate
alts.desc:
You see your victim from afar and resolve to prolong their suffering.
After a Generator is completed, Hex: Wretched Fate activates and lights a random Dull Totem, cursing the Obsession:
Reduces their Repair speed by 27/30/33 %.
The Aura of the Hex Totem is revealed to them within 12 metres.

perks.name: Hex: Blood Favour
perks.desc:
Hex: Blood Favour lights a Hex Totem at the start of the Trial, cursing Survivors with its Hex Effects.
Whenever a Survivor loses a Health State by a basic-attack, Hex: Blood Favour triggers its effect for 13/14/15 seconds:
Blocks all upright Pallets within 32 metres of that Survivor.
Blocked Pallets cannot be dropped by any Survivor.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Hex: Undying
perks.desc:
Whenever a Survivor is within 2/3/4 metres of a Dull Totem, Hex: Undying triggers its primary effect:
Their Aura is revealed to you for as long as they remain in that range.
Whenever a Hex Totem is cleansed, Hex: Undying triggers its secondary effect:
Transfers the cleansed Hex to the Hex Totem associated with Hex: Undying instead, replacing it.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Hex: Haunted Ground
alts.desc:
Hex: Haunted Ground lights 2 Hex Totems at the start of the Trial, laying a trap for Survivors.
Blessing or cleansing either Hex Totem trips the trap and triggers the following effect:
Causes all Survivors to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect for 40/50/60 seconds.
Hex: Haunted Ground extinguishes the second Hex Totem after tripping its trap.
Hex: Haunted Ground is disabled for the remainder of the Trial after triggering its effect.

Increases the Spawn frequency of Pools of Blood by 50/75/100 %.
Increases the Regression rate of partial Healing progression by +25 %.

Whenever you put a Survivor into the Dying State with your Basic Attack, Surge triggers its effect:
Causes all Generators within 32 metres of your location to instantly explode and start regressing.
Instantly regresses all affected Generators by 6/7/8 %.

alts.name: Dominance
alts.desc:
The power you wield over the land strikes terror in the hearts of all who cross your path.
The first time each Totem are interacted with by a Survivor, Dominance triggers its effect:
Calls upon The Entity to block it for 25 seconds.
The Aura of the blocked Prop is revealed to you in white.
The Survivor screams.
The Survivor's aura is revealed to you for 3/4/5 seconds.

Grants +4 % Haste Status Effect while carrying a Survivor.

Overwhelming pain reverberates outwards.
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Start the Trial with 4 Token.

Causes the Generator with the most progression to explode, damaging it.

perks.name: Grim Embrace
perks.desc:
Your act of servitude to The Entity has not gone unnoticed.
Each time a Survivor is hooked for the first time, Grim Embrace gains +1 Token and activates once you are at least 16 metres away from the Hook:
1-3 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 6/8/10 seconds.
4 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 40 seconds and the Aura of the Obsession is revealed to you for 6 seconds.

alts.name: Coup de Grâce

As the end nears, you go in for the kill.
Whenever a Generator is completed, Coup de Grâce gains +2 Tokens, up to a maximum of 10 Tokens per Trial:
Increases the range of your next Lunge Attack by 70/75/80 %, while consuming -1 Token.
Coup de Grâce can only hold a maximum of 5 Tokens at a time.

addons.name: Rusty Shackles
addons.comment: Triggered traps no longer spawn a fake mud clone and instead remain completely stealthy. This effect has several implications. First, it makes Survivors more likely to get hit or even grabbed out of a generator if they fail to notice that they triggered a trap. Secondly, the removal of the teleport animation indirectly makes you able to hit or move even sooner than normal. That being said, it also comes with a small downside. Since the mud phantasm no longer appears, the traps won't affect the Survivor's camera so it is impossible to use that to your advantage anymore. You also cannot rely on the aura of the fake phantasm to see which direction a Survivor is going after they trigger it. Despite these things, this add-on is very easy to use and can be quite devastating against an unprepared team.
addons.desc:
Suppresses any indication to Survivors that they tripped Phantasm Traps.
Suppresses the creation of Mud Phantasms.

addons.name: Mint Rag
addons.comment: Enables the ability to manually teleport to any trap with a short cooldown. During this cooldown, your normal teleporting abilities remain the same. When it's not on cooldown, this add-on comes with a heavy downside, since it effectively removes your ability to spam the teleport button to quickly react to a trap that was just triggered. If you press the teleport button at the wrong time you can end up teleporting to the wrong trap across the entire map. That being said, this add-on holds immense utility if you specialize in its use. The map-wide teleport enables a lot of powerful builds and strategies and can even be somewhat useful in chase when you learn its quirks. Unlike traps triggered by Survivors, the manual teleport keeps your camera direction the same, so it requires a bit of adjusting. Definitely not suited for beginners or anyone still learning the basics of Hag.
addons.desc:
Press the Active Ability button to teleport to any untripped Phantasm Trap anywhere in the environment.
Mint Rag has a cool-down of 10 seconds.

addons.name: Willow Wreath
addons.comment: Shows a Survivor's aura when they trigger a trap, with a longer duration than its green counterpart. Seeing this aura is helpful in almost every possible scenario. It can help you keep track of a Survivor after a successful teleport hit, keep an eye on aggressive Survivors that try to disrupt your traps, give an early warning that someone has a perk to hide their aura, and much more.
addons.desc: The Auras of Survivors tripping Phantasm Traps are revealed to you for 5 seconds.

addons.name: Swamp Orchid Necklet
addons.comment: Increases the trap setting speed.This saves quite a bit of time and also allows you to teleport to a trap sooner if it's triggered during your trap setting animation. This family of add-ons also helps with the common strategy of teleporting, attacking and immediately resetting an important trap. The effects can also be stacked together, but one is typically good enough.
addons.desc: Increases the Setting speed of Phantasm Traps by +20 %.
