perks.name: Thrilling Tremors

perks.desc:
While performing the Break or Damage action on Breakable Walls, Pallets, or Generators, Brutal Strength triggers its effect:
Increases the Action speed by 10/15/20 %.
perks.name: Brutal Strength

perks.desc: Identical to Keep Them Waiting.
perks.name: Save the best for last

perks.desc:
Whenever you put a Survivor into the Dying State with your Basic Attack, Surge triggers its effect:
Causes all Generators within 32 metres of your location to instantly explode and start regressing.
Instantly regresses all affected Generators by 6/7/8 %.
perks.name: Surge

perks.desc:
You move with a speed and fury that makes blood run cold.
You can no longer gain the Bloodlust Status Effect.
Successfully hitting a Survivor with a Basic Attack grants you a +5 % Haste Status Effect for 8/9/10 seconds.
perks.name: Rapid Brutality

perks.desc: Identical to See How They Run.
perks.name: Play With Your Food

perks.desc:
Overwhelming pain reverberates outwards.
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Start the Trial with 4 Token.
Whenever a Survivor is hooked onto a Scourge Hook for the first time, Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance consumes -1 Token and applies the following effects:
Causes the Generator with the most progression to explode, damaging it.
Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by 10/15/20 % of its total Progression.
Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors repairing the Damaged Generator to scream.
This does not trigger a Loud Noise Notification.
Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance is disabled for the remainder of the Trial once all Tokens are consumed.
perks.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance

perks.desc:
When you hook any Survivors that is not the Obsession, the following effects apply to the Obsession:
Their Aura is revealed for 6/8/10 seconds.
They suffer from the Exposed Status Effect for 20 seconds.
When you hook the Obsession, the following effects apply to a random Survivor:
Causes the Survivor to scream and reveal their location to the Killer.
They become the new Obsession.
You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.
perks.name: Friends ‘Til the End

perks.desc: After hooking a Survivor, for 40/50/60 seconds, press the Active Ability button to make a target generator within 20 meters explode, lose -10 % progress, and start regressing.
perks.name: Turn Back The Clock

killers.name: The Demogorgon
killers.otzComment:
The Demogorgon is a well-rounded Killer with a complex set of useful abilities and a repertoire of add-ons to enhance each of them. His chasing potential can be quite oppressive in the right hands, but he's generally a jack of all trades and master of none.
Demogorgon is a fairly accessible Killer for newer players. His main appeal for beginners is the very powerful set of perks that he unlocks when leveled up. Surge and Mindbreaker are almost universally useful perks that will help greatly in your Killer journey.

teachables.name: Surge
teachables.desc:
Whenever you put a Survivor into the Dying State with your Basic Attack, Surge triggers its effect:
Causes all Generators within 32 metres of your location to instantly explode and start regressing.
Instantly regresses all affected Generators by 6/7/8 %.

teachables.name: Mindbreaker
teachables.desc:
While repairing a Generator, Survivors suffer from the following effects:
Incurs the Blindness and Exhausted Status Effects.
Both Status Effects linger for 3/4/5 seconds after ending the interaction.
Mindbreaker cannot be used to override an existing Exhausted Status Effect, but pauses its timer instead.

teachables.name: Cruel Limits
teachables.desc:
Whenever a Generator is completed, Cruel Limits triggers its effect for 20/25/30 seconds:
Blocks all Windows for all Survivors.
The Auras of the Blocked Windows are revealed to you and highlighted in yellow.

builds.name: Generic Build
notes: Reliable and well-rounded build; a good starting point until you find the ideal build for your playstyle.

Coup de Grâce seems like a counter-intuitive choice, but it's a great tool for newer players to deal with round loops where the Demogorgon's shred is typically useless. Advanced players might want to swap it for something else.
You can activate portals nearby if you want to make sure that a generator keeps regressing after kicking it with your gen-related perks.

perks.name: Corrupt Intervention
perks.desc:
Your prayers invoke a dark power that meddles with the Survivors' chances of survival.
At the start of the Trial, the 3 Generators located farthest from you are blocked by The Entity for 80/100/120 seconds.
Corrupt Intervention deactivates prematurely once the first Survivor is put into the Dying State.

alts.name: Lethal Pursuer
alts.desc:
At the start of the Trial, the Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 7/8/9 seconds.
Extends the duration of all instances of a Survivor Aura being revealed to you by +2 seconds.
Lethal Pursuer benefits from its own effect.

perks.name: Lay Waste
perks.desc:
Damaging a Generator makes it regress +2 % faster for each Charge it has.
This perk has a cool-down of 55/50/45 seconds after damaging a Generator.

alts.name: Pop Goes the Weasel
alts.desc:
After hooking a Survivor, Pop Goes the Weasel activates for 35/40/45 seconds.
While active, manually damaging a Generator triggers the following effect:
Increases the regression amount by +15 % resulting in 20 % regression.
Pop Goes the Weasel deactivates after use or once its timer elapses.

perks.name: Machine Learning
perks.desc:
After performing the Damage Generator action, Machine Learning activates:
Causes that Generator to become a Compromised Generator.
Up to 3 Generators can be Compromised at a time.
The Auras of all Compromised Generators are highlighted to you in yellow.
Once a Compromised Generator is completed, you benefit from the following effects for 40/50/60 seconds:
Undetectable Status Effect
+8 % Haste Status Effect
Additionally, all other Generators are no longer Compromised.

alts.name: Nowhere to Hide
alts.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator triggers Nowhere to Hide:
The Auras of all Survivors within 24 metres of the Generator's location are revealed to you for 3/4/5 seconds.

alts.name: Eruption
alts.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on Generators highlights their Auras in yellow.
Whenever a Survivor enters the Dying State by any means, Eruption triggers the following effects on all highlighted Generators:
Causes them to explode, damaging them.
Instantly regresses them by -10 % of their total Progression.
Causes them to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors currently repairing them to suffer from the following effects:
Causes them to scream.
Their Auras are revealed to you for 8/10/12 seconds.
Eruption has a cool-down of 30 seconds after triggering its effects, which also resets the highlighted Auras.

perks.name: Coup de Grâce
perks.desc:
As the end nears, you go in for the kill.
Whenever a Generator is completed, Coup de Grâce gains +2 Tokens, up to a maximum of 10 Tokens per Trial:
Increases the range of your next Lunge Attack by 70/75/80 %, while consuming -1 Token.
Coup de Grâce can only hold a maximum of 5 Tokens at a time.

alts.name: Bamboozle
alts.desc:
You benefit from the following permanent effect:
Increases your Vaulting speed by 5/10/15 %.
Whenever you vault a Window, Bamboozle calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks it to all Survivors for 8/12/16 seconds.
Vaulting it again within that time resets the timer.
Vaulting a different one transfers the effect to it instead.
Bamboozle does not extend its effects to vaulting a dropped Pallet.

alts.name: Enduring
alts.desc:
You benefit from the following effect:
Reduces the duration of Pallet Stuns by 40/45/50 %.
This effect does not apply when stunned while carrying a Survivor.

perks.name: Corrupt Intervention
perks.desc:
Your prayers invoke a dark power that meddles with the Survivors' chances of survival.
At the start of the Trial, the 3 Generators located farthest from you are blocked by The Entity for 80/100/120 seconds.
Corrupt Intervention deactivates prematurely once the first Survivor is put into the Dying State.

alts.name: Lethal Pursuer
alts.desc:
At the start of the Trial, the Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 7/8/9 seconds.
Extends the duration of all instances of a Survivor Aura being revealed to you by +2 seconds.
Lethal Pursuer benefits from its own effect.

alts.name: Discordance
alts.desc:
Any Generator within a range of 64/96/128 metres that is being repaired by 2 or more Survivors is marked by a yellow Aura.
When the Generator is first highlighted, Discordance triggers a Loud Noise Notification on the Generator.
After the Generator is no longer within range or is being repaired by just 1 Survivor, the highlighted Aura will linger for another 4 seconds.

perks.name: Barbecue & Chilli
perks.desc:
A deep bond with The Entity unlocks potential in one's Aura-reading ability.
After hooking a Survivor, all Survivors who are at least 60/50/40 metres away from that Hook have their Aura revealed to you for 5 seconds.

alts.name: Thrilling Tremors
alts.desc:
After picking up a Survivor, Thrilling Tremors triggers its effects:
Blocks all Generators not currently being repaired by any Survivors for 16 seconds.
The Auras of Blocked Generators are highlighted to you in white.
Thrilling Tremors has a cool-down of 40/35/30 seconds.

alts.name: Grim Embrace
alts.desc:
Your act of servitude to The Entity has not gone unnoticed.
Each time a Survivor is hooked for the first time, Grim Embrace gains +1 Token and activates once you are at least 16 metres away from the Hook:
1-3 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 6/8/10 seconds.
4 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 40 seconds and the Aura of the Obsession is revealed to you for 6 seconds.

perks.name: Enduring
perks.desc:
You benefit from the following effect:
Reduces the duration of Pallet Stuns by 40/45/50 %.
This effect does not apply when stunned while carrying a Survivor.

alts.name: Superior Anatomy
alts.desc:
Whenever a Survivor performs a Rush Vault action within 12 metres of your location, Superior Anatomy activates for 10 seconds:
Increases your Vaulting speed by 30/35/40 %.
Superior Anatomy has a cool-down of 20 seconds.

perks.name: Turn Back the Clock
perks.desc: After hooking a Survivor, for 40/50/60 seconds, press the Active Ability button to make a target generator within 20 meters explode, lose -10 % progress, and start regressing.

alts.name: No Way Out
alts.desc:
Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, No Way Out gains +1 Token.
Once the Exit Gates are powered, No Way Out activates:
Causes the first Survivor to interact with either Exit Gate Switch to trigger a Loud Noise Notification at their location.
Upon triggering the Loud Noise Notification, No Way Out calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks both Exit Gate Switches for 12 seconds.
This time is extended by an additional 6/9/12 seconds per accumulated Token, up to a combined maximum of 36/48/60 seconds.

perks.name: Hex: Hive Mind
perks.desc:
The first time you hook any Survivor, a random Dull Totem becomes a Hex Totem, provided that a Dull Totem remains in the Trial Grounds.
Generators are highlighted; the intensity of the generator's Auras reveals their repair progress.
As soon as a total of 4 generators have been completed in the Trial:
All remaining generators explode, lose 6/8/10 % progess, and start regressing.
The associated Hex Totem becomes dull, and this perk becomes disabled for the remainder of the trial.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Tinkerer
alts.desc:
Whenever a Generator is repaired to 70 %, you benefit from the following effects:
Triggers a Loud Noise Notification for that Generator, revealing its location.
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect for the next 12/14/16 seconds.
Tinkerer can only trigger once per Generator per Trial.

alts.name: Barbecue & Chilli
alts.desc:
A deep bond with The Entity unlocks potential in one's Aura-reading ability.
After hooking a Survivor, all Survivors who are at least 60/50/40 metres away from that Hook have their Aura revealed to you for 5 seconds.

alts.name: Thrilling Tremors
alts.desc:
After picking up a Survivor, Thrilling Tremors triggers its effects:
Blocks all Generators not currently being repaired by any Survivors for 16 seconds.
The Auras of Blocked Generators are highlighted to you in white.
Thrilling Tremors has a cool-down of 40/35/30 seconds.

perks.name: Turn Back the Clock
perks.desc: After hooking a Survivor, for 40/50/60 seconds, press the Active Ability button to make a target generator within 20 meters explode, lose -10 % progress, and start regressing.

perks.name: Hex: Devour Hope
perks.desc:
Hex: Devour Hope lights a Hex Totem at the start of the Trial, cursing Survivors with its Hex Effects.
Whenever a Survivor is unhooked at least 24 metres from your location, Hex: Devour Hope gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 5 Tokens:
At 2 Tokens: 10 seconds after hooking a Survivor, you are granted a 3/4/5 % Haste Status Effect for 10 seconds.
At 3 Tokens: Afflicts all Survivors with the Exposed Status Effect.
At 5 Tokens: Unlocks the Kill ability, allowing you to kill dying Survivors by your own hands.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Hex: Undying
perks.desc:
Whenever a Survivor is within 2/3/4 metres of a Dull Totem, Hex: Undying triggers its primary effect:
Their Aura is revealed to you for as long as they remain in that range.
Whenever a Hex Totem is cleansed, Hex: Undying triggers its secondary effect:
Transfers the cleansed Hex to the Hex Totem associated with Hex: Undying instead, replacing it.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Dominance
alts.desc:
The power you wield over the land strikes terror in the hearts of all who cross your path.
The first time each Totem are interacted with by a Survivor, Dominance triggers its effect:
Calls upon The Entity to block it for 25 seconds.
The Aura of the blocked Prop is revealed to you in white.
The Survivor screams.
The Survivor's aura is revealed to you for 3/4/5 seconds.

builds.name: Beginner Perks Only
notes: Only uses perks available to this Killer or global perks available to everyone. It might include some alternative perk ideas from one of the five free Killers too.
Surge does not work when you down someone with a special attack, but it's still worth bringing. If near gens, prioritize downing with a basic attack if the situation allows it.
Learning to use Whispers can be really worth it on this Killer. You'll quickly figure out when you're getting close to a Survivor and it even works while using your portals!

perks.name: No Holds Barred
perks.desc:
Each time a Generator is completed, No Holds Barred calls upon The Entity for the following effects:
Blocks the Generator with the most Progression for 15/20/25 seconds.
The Aura of the Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.

perks.name: Surge
perks.desc:
Whenever you put a Survivor into the Dying State with your Basic Attack, Surge triggers its effect:
Causes all Generators within 32 metres of your location to instantly explode and start regressing.
Instantly regresses all affected Generators by 6/7/8 %.

alts.name: A Nurse's Calling
alts.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability:
The Auras of Survivors being healed or healing themselves are revealed to you within 28/30/32 metres.

perks.name: Hex: Fortune's Fool
perks.desc:
If there is still a Dull Totem in the environment, Hex: Fortune's Fool lights a Hex Totem whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, cursing them with its Hex Effects.
Inflicts the Oblivious Status Effect.
Blocks the Hex Totem for all other Survivors for 90 seconds.
Blocked Hex Totems cannot be cleansed or blessed by Survivors.
This does not affect the Cursed Survivor.
The Aura of the Hex Totem is revealed to the Cursed Survivor within 24/20/16 metres.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Whispers
perks.desc:
Whenever any Survivor is within 28/26/24 metres of your location:
Causes you to hear the sporadic whispers of The Entity, indicating a Survivor's presence.
Whenever any Survivor is outside 28/26/24 metres of your location:
Gain +5 % Haste Status Effect.

alts.name: Sloppy Butcher
alts.desc:
Survivors hit with your vicious Basic Attack suffer from the following effects for 70/80/90 seconds:
Inflicts the Haemorrhage and Mangled Status Effects.
Modifies the potency of Haemorrhage:
Increases the Spawn frequency of Pools of Blood by 50/75/100 %.
Increases the Regression rate of partial Healing progression by +25 %.

alts.name: Spies from the Shadows
alts.desc:
Whenever a Survivor startles a Crow within 36/38/40 metres of your location, Spies from the Shadows triggers its effect:
Alerts you with a unique Loud Noise Notification in the shape of a Crow.
Spies from the Shadows has a cool-down of 3 seconds between alerts.

addons.name: Barb's Glasses
addons.comment: The Demogorgon is already very good at zoning Survivors into unfavorable corners, and this add-on allows you to capitalize on this strength even further. The quicker recovery after breaking pallets or walls makes it harder for Survivors to reach the next loop without being hit.
addons.desc: Reduces the Attack cool-down of successful Shred Attacks used to break Breakable Walls or Pallets by -10 %.

addons.name: Black Heart
addons.comment: The slightly faster recovery after a successful shred attack isn't always game-changing, but it is a very consistently useful effect. Also makes it much easier to deal with bodyblocks from altruistic Survivors and similar situations.
addons.desc: Reduces the Attack cool-down of successful Shred Attacks used to hit Survivors by -10 %.

addons.name: Leprose Lichen
addons.comment: Allows you to quickly gather information about the location of Survivors, potentially revealing all of them if you're lucky enough. This information isn't always consistent, but it's still a very decent effect compared to the rest of the add-ons available.
addons.desc:
The Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you while traversing the Upside Down.
This effect lingers for 3 seconds for all Survivors within 16 metres of an active Portal.

addons.name: Red Moss
addons.comment: The very long extra Undetectable duration allows you to cover a large portion of the map while trying to catch Survivors off-guard. Keep in mind that this add-on makes your animation coming out of a portal quieter, but Survivors still hear a map-wide sound. Alert Survivors won't always get caught off-guard even with this add-on.
addons.desc:
After traversing the Upside Down, the following effects apply:
Extends the Undetectable Status Effect gained after emerging from a Portal by +8 seconds to 13 seconds.
Suppresses all noises related to emerging from a Portal.
Increases the time required to emerge from a Portal by +15 %.

addons.name: Mews' Guts
addons.comment: Allows you to recover faster after a missed shred attack. This helps you when Survivors crouch under your shred, and also allows you to recover even faster when launching yourself with a shred from an elevated area. Keep in mind that the cooldown after hitting an obstacle does not count as a missed attack and won't benefit from this add-on. The extra portal is also a nice bonus, especially considering the fact that portals cannot be easily removed or replaced.
addons.desc:
Reduces the Attack cool-down of missed Shred Attacks by -11 %.
Increases the number of available Portals by +1.

addons.name: Lifeguard Whistle
addons.comment: Increases your portal count by two. This gives you a bit more room for mistakes and allows you to control more areas of the map if that's your preferred playstyle. Just keep in mind that the green Mews' Guts does something similar but also gives another useful effect.
addons.desc:
You benefit from the following effect:
Increases the number of available Portals by +2.

addons.name: Vermilion Webcap
addons.comment: The extra stealth that this add-on provides stacks nicely with the default Undetectable duration, allowing you to sometimes catch Survivors off-guard. Not too impactful otherwise.
addons.desc:
After traversing the Upside Down, the following effect applies:
Extends the Undetectable Status Effect gained after emerging from a Portal by +3 seconds to 8 seconds.

addons.name: Rat Liver
addons.comment: The slight increase to your movement speed while charging your shred is not too noticeable in most scenarios, but can sometimes make a difference in chase.
addons.desc: Increases your Movement speed while holding Of the Abyss by +3.5 %.

addons.name: Rat Tail
addons.comment: Simple effect, but saves you quite a bit of time when placing a portal, allowing to reposition faster after you hook someone or if you need to return to a certain area.
addons.desc: Increases the Opening speed of Portals by +50 %.

addons.name: Upside Down Resin
addons.comment: A simple effect, but pairs well with other add-ons to increase the defensive and tracking utility of portals. Still, not extremely worth bringing over the other add-ons that have more impactful effects.
addons.desc: Increases the Sealing time of Portals by +20 %.

addons.name: Eleven's Soda
addons.comment: Gives you occasional information about which generators are being repaired, although you can't always rely on it.
addons.desc: The Auras of Generators actively being repaired by Survivors are highlighted to you in yellow while traversing the Upside Down.

addons.name: Rotten Green Tripe
addons.comment: Provides a noticeable boost to your portal traversing speed. Not as strong as the Deer Lung, but this one has no downsides.
addons.desc: Increases your Teleportation speed by +15 %.

addons.name: Violet Waxcap
addons.comment: Increasing the undetectable period after a teleport is relatively useful, but this add-on only does it for 1 extra second. It's completely outclassed by its purple counterpart, the Vermillion Webcap.
addons.desc:
After traversing the Upside Down, the following effect applies:
Extends the Undetectable Status Effect gained after emerging from a Portal by +1 second to 6 seconds.

addons.name: Sticky Lining
addons.comment: The extra detection radius is actually fairly useful and pairs well with other add-ons that revolve around portals. This add-on allows to reliably detect Survivors near generators even when the portal is a bit far away.
addons.desc: Increases the Area of Effect of active Portals by +2.5 metres.

addons.name: Thorny Vines
addons.comment: Increases the utility of active portals and pairs well with other add-ons geared towards defensive portal strategies.
addons.desc:
Increases the Area of Effect of active Portals by +1 metre.
Increases the Sealing time of Portals by +8 %.

addons.name: Brass Case Lighter
addons.comment: The 60 seconds of Blindness is a decent effect, but it is very difficult to ensure that it will affect Survivors consistently. To increase its effectiveness, try placing it at chokepoints that Survivors must pass to reach their objective. The portal must be active for this effect to trigger at all.
addons.desc:
Survivors suffer from the Blindness Status Effect while closing Portals.
This effect lingers for 60 seconds.

addons.name: Unknown Egg
addons.comment: This add-on shortens the cooldown between teleports, allowing you to use a portal again much faster. However, it's very rare to find yourself in a situation where you need to teleport twice in a row quickly. For that reason, the effect of this add-on is almost entirely unnecessary.
addons.desc: Reduces the Recovery time of Of the Abyss by -2.5 seconds.

addons.name: Viscous Webbing
addons.comment: This add-on has a very minimal effect on the portal destruction speed from Survivors, and obviously has no effect at all if Survivors choose to ignore them or you don't set that many portals up in the first place. Its effects are also completely outclassed by the superior purple Upside Down Resin.
addons.desc: Increases the Sealing time of Portals by +10 %.

addons.name: Deer Lung
addons.comment: Provides a noticeable boost to your portal traversing speed but has the unfortunate downside of limiting your portal amount. You don't always use all of your portals, but in some situations you will find that only having four portals can be highly detrimental. Using the green Rotten Green Tripe  a similar effect can be achieved without any downsides.
addons.desc:
Increases your Teleportation speed by +30 %.
Reduces the number of available Portals by -2.

addons.name: Rotten Pumpkin
addons.comment: This add-on destroys a portal as you use it, which gives you the ability to remove portals that you no longer want around. However, since placing portals is already a time consuming action, this add-on forces you to spend even more time doing so. Could be paired with the Deer Lung to offset its downside, but even then, it's not generally worth it.
addons.desc:
Causes the Portal from which you start your Teleport to seal automatically.
Grants +200 bonus Bloodpoints for Interdimensional Travel Score Events.

Increases your Vaulting speed by 5/10/15 %.

killers.name: The Oni
killers.otzComment:
When powered up, the Oni gains a temporary but significant burst of speed and lethality that can quickly give him a decisive advantage. However, he must be played very efficiently until his power is ready to be used. His powerful add-ons can help in a number of different areas.
The Oni can be played as a standard Killer when not using his power and is not too inaccessible for beginners, although his demon form is quite tricky and will require some practice. His perks are generally quite weak, although Zanshin Tactics is a genuinely useful information perk that's really helpful for newer players. The aura reading it provides after a pallet is dropped is works particularly well for Killers such as Nurse or Huntress.
\n

addons.name: Lion Fang
addons.comment: Extends the maximum duration of Blood Fury by an additional 10 seconds (with the default duration being ~45 seconds). The longer duration is particularly useful in situations where you down multiple Survivors, since each down typically causes a penalty to your remaining Blood Fury timer. Additionally, since your overall timer is longer, exiting your power early will result in having more charges left over. This makes it easier to quickly regain it again. Stacks with other add-ons of its type.
addons.desc: Increases the duration of Blood Fury by +10 seconds.

addons.name: Splintered Hull
addons.comment: Increases the frequency at which Survivors passively drop orbs when injured and also makes them drop one additional orb every time they perform certain actions. Can be stacked with its blue counterpart, but it's generally not necessary as the effects of a single add-on are strong enough on their own. The increased blood spawn is incredibly helpful and makes it much easier to gain your power during your first chase or after finding a spot where a Survivor has healed or repaired while they were injured. Keep in mind that orbs temporarily disappear during Blood Fury mode, so this add-on has no effect during its duration.
addons.desc:
Increases the Spawn frequency of Blood Orbs from injured Survivors by +33 %.
Increases the number of Blood Orbs spawned when Survivors perform specific interactions by +1.

addons.name: Wooden Oni Mask
addons.comment: Increases the frequency at which Survivors passively drop orbs when injured and also makes them drop one additional orb every time they perform certain actions. Can be stacked with its purple counterpart, but it's generally not advised as the effects of a single add-on are strong enough on their own. The increased blood spawn is incredibly helpful and makes it much easier to gain your power during your first chase or after finding a spot where a Survivor has healed or repaired while they were injured. Keep in mind that orbs temporarily disappear during Blood Fury mode, so this add-on has no effect during its duration.
addons.desc:

addons.name: Akito's Crutch
addons.comment: Increases the movement speed when dashing during Blood Fury. This makes the power slightly harder to control but also provides a boost to map mobility and makes you harder to predict during chase. The main benefit of having this additional speed is the fact that you can become lethal in certain smaller loops that would be playable for Survivors with your default movement speed. At higher levels of play, this add-on can arguably become one of Oni's best.
addons.desc: Increases your Movement speed during a Demon Dash by +1 m/s.

The longer duration is particularly useful in situations where you down multiple Survivors, since each down typically causes a penalty to your remaining Blood Fury timer. Additionally, since your overall timer is longer, exiting your power early will result in having more charges left over. This makes it easier to quickly regain it again. addons.desc: Increases the duration of Blood Fury by +8 seconds.

addons.name: Chipped Saihai
addons.comment: Extends the maximum duration of Blood Fury by an additional 6 seconds (with the default duration being ~45 seconds). The longer duration is particularly useful in situations where you down multiple Survivors, since each down typically causes a penalty to your remaining Blood Fury timer. Additionally, since your overall timer is longer, exiting your power early will result in having more charges left over. This makes it easier to quickly regain it again. Stacks with other add-ons of its type.
addons.desc: Increases the duration of Blood Fury by +6 seconds.

addons.name: Kanai-Anzen Talisman
addons.comment: Increases the movement speed when dashing during Blood Fury. This makes the power slightly harder to control but also provides a boost to map mobility and makes you harder to predict during chase. The main benefit of having this additional speed is the fact that you can become lethal in certain smaller loops that would be playable for Survivors with your default movement speed.
addons.desc: Increases your Movement speed during a Demon Dash by +0.64 m/s.

addons.name: Scalped Topknot
addons.comment: Reduces the charge time of your dash during Blood Fury, allowing you to begin your sprint a bit sooner. The effect is very small to make a difference when it comes to map mobility but it does help a lot in chase, since it gives Survivors less time to react to an incoming dash. A pretty comfortable add-on to use, although high-level Oni players typically favor other add-ons.
addons.desc: Reduces the Charge time of Demon Dash by -0.5 seconds.

addons.name: Renjiro's Bloody Glove
addons.comment: This add-on makes the blood orbs turn into a source of information. Survivors near them will automatically absorb them and reveal their aura for a brief moment. Not a terrible effect, but not extremely reliable either. Keep in mind that all orbs are gone while you're in Blood Fury mode, so this add-on does absolutely nothing once you start using your power and only starts working again when Blood Fury ends.
addons.desc:
The glove Renjiro held to his sternum following the strike dealt by his son Kazan.Whenever a Survivor comes into a contact with a Blood Orb, the following effects apply:
The Blood Orb is absorbed by the Survivor.
Their Aura is revealed to you for 2 seconds per absorbed Blood Orb.
Renjiro's Bloody Glove grants Survivors the ability to see Blood Orbs at the same distance as you.

addons.name: Iridescent Family Crest
addons.comment: Allows to quickly check if anyone is near by missing an attack during Blood Fury. Quite a useful effect, but the range is quite limited and you should generally not use your power if you're not already aware of Survivor locations.
addons.desc: Causes Survivors within 24 metres of your location to scream and reveal their location to you after hitting the ground with a missed Demon Strike.

addons.name: Tear-Soaked Tenugui
addons.comment: This add-on decreases the penalty that you incur every time you down a Survivor with your power. If you down several Survivors, the effects will be more noticeable and your power will last longer than it would otherwise. However, this add-on is completely outclassed by all three duration add-ons, which also result in more power duration but without any conditions. Additionally, if you grab a Survivor (for example, out of a locker) the penalty to your power gauge is zero, which means that this add-on will have no effect whatsoever.
addons.desc: Reduces the Power Gauge penalty for downing Survivors during Blood Fury by -4 seconds.

addons.name: Ink Lion
addons.comment: Very similar to the brown add-on Cracked Sakazuki, but with a small extra effect. Not too bad.
addons.desc:
Reduces the Transition time into Blood Fury by -0.5 seconds.
Reduces the Transition time out of Blood Fury by -0.5 seconds.
Reduces the Power Gauge penalty for downing Survivors during Blood Fury by -2 seconds.

addons.name: Cracked Sakazuki
addons.comment: Slightly speeds up the animation of entering and leaving Blood Fury. Not a hugely impactful effect, but not too bad for its rarity. Keep in mind that if you grab a Survivor during your power, you'll completely skip the animation and not benefit from the faster exiting animation.
addons.desc:
Reduces the Transition time into Blood Fury by -0.5 seconds.
Reduces the Transition time out of Blood Fury by -0.5 seconds.

addons.name: Bloody Sash
addons.comment: This add-on and its brown counterpart provide a noticeable boost to your movement speed while gathering blood orbs. However, you don't typically do this for very long so the effect is not very impactful.
addons.desc: Increases your Movement speed while in Absorption Mode by 0.7 m/s.

addons.name: Blackened Toenail
addons.comment: This add-on and its green counterpart provide a noticeable boost to your movement speed while gathering blood orbs. However, you don't typically do this for very long so the effect is not very impactful.
addons.desc: Increases your Movement speed while in Absorption Mode by 0.4 m/s.

addons.name: Child's Wooden Sword
addons.comment: This add-on only helps you find orbs that are hidden behind obstacles. Orbs in the open are still visible from afar.
addons.desc: Increases the Aura-reading range on Blood Orbs in the environment by +3 metres.

addons.name: Rotting Rope
addons.comment: This add-on only helps you find orbs that are hidden behind obstacles. Orbs in the open are still visible from afar.
addons.desc: Increases the Aura-reading range on Blood Orbs in the environment by +2 metres.

addons.name: Shattered Wakizashi
addons.comment: This add-on increases your passive gain of power over time. Even though the numbers look pretty high, the speed at which you obtain your power is still painfully slow even if you stack both of these add-ons. On top of that, this add-on doesn't help you if your power is almost complete, since it doesn't go past the 98% cap.
addons.desc: Increases the passive Charge rate of Blood Fury by +0.2 c/s.

addons.name: Polished Maedate
addons.comment: This add-on increases your passive gain of power over time. Even though the numbers look pretty high, the speed at which you obtain your power is still painfully slow even if you stack both of these add-ons. On top of that, this add-on doesn't help you if your power is almost complete, since it doesn't go past the 98% cap.
addons.desc: Increases the passive Charge rate of Blood Fury by +0.1 c/s.

addons.name: Paper Lantern
addons.comment: Accelerates the rate at which blood orbs are dragged to you when you hold your power button. This effect is almost entirely useless, as they're already pretty fast and you typically absorb orbs from a very short distance anyway.
addons.desc: Increases the Floating speed of Blood Orbs towards you when in Absorption Mode by +4 m/s.

perks.desc:
After hooking a Survivor, Pop Goes the Weasel activates for 35/40/45 seconds.
While active, manually damaging a Generator triggers the following effect:
Increases the regression amount by +15 % resulting in 20 % regression.
Pop Goes the Weasel deactivates after use or once its timer elapses.
perks.name: Pop Goes the Weasel

perks.desc:
Your prayers invoke a dark power that meddles with the Survivors' chances of survival.
At the start of the Trial, the 3 Generators located farthest from you are blocked by The Entity for 80/100/120 seconds.
Corrupt Intervention deactivates prematurely once the first Survivor is put into the Dying State.
perks.name: Corrupt Intervention

perks.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on Generators highlights their Auras in yellow.
Whenever a Survivor enters the Dying State by any means, Eruption triggers the following effects on all highlighted Generators:
Causes them to explode, damaging them.
Instantly regresses them by -10 % of their total Progression.
Causes them to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors currently repairing them to suffer from the following effects:
Causes them to scream.
Their Auras are revealed to you for 8/10/12 seconds.
Eruption has a cool-down of 30 seconds after triggering its effects, which also resets the highlighted Auras.
perks.name: Eruption

perks.desc:
Overwhelming pain reverberates outwards.
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Start the Trial with 4 Token.
Whenever a Survivor is hooked onto a Scourge Hook for the first time, Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance consumes -1 Token and applies the following effects:
Causes the Generator with the most progression to explode, damaging it.
Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by 10/15/20 % of its total Progression.
Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors repairing the Damaged Generator to scream.
This does not trigger a Loud Noise Notification.
Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance is disabled for the remainder of the Trial once all Tokens are consumed.
perks.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance

perks.desc:
While performing the Break or Damage action on Breakable Walls, Pallets, or Generators, Brutal Strength triggers its effect:
Increases the Action speed by 10/15/20 %.

killers.name: The Deathslinger
killers.otzComment:
The Deathslinger has the remarkable ability to injure (and sometimes down) Survivors in most areas, provided that his accuracy is on point. Finding the right combination of perks and add-ons to fit your playstyle is particularly helpful and mitigates many of his shortcomings.
The Deathslinger is possibly the simplest and most accessible ranged Killer in the game for newer players. He also unlocks a few useful perks that help with stalling and tracking (namely, Gearhead and Dead Man's Switch). His hex perk is quite strong when paired with several other hexes, but not too useful on its own.

teachables.name: Gearhead
teachables.desc:
After a Survivor loses a Health State, Gearhead activates for 30 seconds:
While Gearhead is active, a Survivor succeeding a Good Skill Check while repairing reveals their Aura to you for 6/7/8 seconds.

teachables.name: Dead Man's Switch
teachables.desc:
After hooking a Survivor, Dead Man's Switch triggers its effect:
The first Generator any Survivor stops repairing for 2 seconds is blocked for 30/35/40 seconds
The Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.
Dead Man's Switch cannot activate if its effect is still active from a previous activation.

teachables.name: Hex: Retribution
teachables.desc:
Whenever a Survivor blesses or cleanses a Totem, Hex: Retribution triggers its primary effect:
Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect for 40/50/60 seconds.
Whenever a Hex Totem is removed by any means, including its own, Hex: Retribution triggers its secondary effect:
The Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 20 seconds.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

builds.name: Generic Build
notes: Reliable and well-rounded build; a good starting point until you find the ideal build for your playstyle.

perks.name: Corrupt Intervention
perks.desc:
Your prayers invoke a dark power that meddles with the Survivors' chances of survival.
At the start of the Trial, the 3 Generators located farthest from you are blocked by The Entity for 80/100/120 seconds.
Corrupt Intervention deactivates prematurely once the first Survivor is put into the Dying State.

perks.name: Lay Waste
perks.desc:
Damaging a Generator makes it regress +2 % faster for each Charge it has.
This perk has a cool-down of 55/50/45 seconds after damaging a Generator.

alts.name: Nowhere to Hide
alts.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator triggers Nowhere to Hide:
The Auras of all Survivors within 24 metres of the Generator's location are revealed to you for 3/4/5 seconds.

perks.name: Help Wanted
perks.desc:
After performing the Damage Generator action, Help Wanted activates:
Causes that Generator to become a Compromised Generator.
Up to 3 Generators can be Compromised at a time.
The Auras of all Compromised Generators are highlighted to you in yellow.
Once a Compromised Generator is completed, Help Wanted triggers its effects for 70/80/90 seconds:
Increases the Recovery speed of successful Basic Attacks by +25 %.
All Generators not being repaired will automatically regress at 150 % of the default Regression rate.
Additionally, all other Generators are no longer Compromised.

alts.name: Pop Goes the Weasel
alts.desc:
After hooking a Survivor, Pop Goes the Weasel activates for 35/40/45 seconds.
While active, manually damaging a Generator triggers the following effect:
Increases the regression amount by +15 % resulting in 20 % regression.
Pop Goes the Weasel deactivates after use or once its timer elapses.

alts.name: Surge
alts.desc:
Whenever you put a Survivor into the Dying State with your Basic Attack, Surge triggers its effect:
Causes all Generators within 32 metres of your location to instantly explode and start regressing.
Instantly regresses all affected Generators by 6/7/8 %.

perks.name: No Way Out
perks.desc:
Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, No Way Out gains +1 Token.
Once the Exit Gates are powered, No Way Out activates:
Causes the first Survivor to interact with either Exit Gate Switch to trigger a Loud Noise Notification at their location.
Upon triggering the Loud Noise Notification, No Way Out calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks both Exit Gate Switches for 12 seconds.
This time is extended by an additional 6/9/12 seconds per accumulated Token, up to a combined maximum of 36/48/60 seconds.

alts.name: Hex: No One Escapes Death
alts.desc:
Once the Exit Gates are powered, if there is still a Dull Totem remaining in the environment, Hex: No One Escapes Death activates and lights it:
Grants a 2/3/4 % Haste Status Effect.
Causes all Survivors to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect.
Once the Status Effect is revealed to Survivors, Hex: No One Escapes Death triggers the following effect:
The Aura of its Hex Totem is revealed to all Survivors within 4 metres.
This range gradually expands to 24 metres over the course of 30 seconds.
Hex: No One Escapes Death remains inactive if no Dull Totems are available.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

builds.name: Disruption Build
notes: A build based on disrupting Survivors and forcing them to waste time and move around the map thanks to the different effects from your perks.
Even if you notice your perks reveal someone from far away, you don't always have to act immediately. If you have a better option nearby for a quick chase, go for it instead.

perks.name: Friends 'til the End
perks.desc:
When you hook any Survivors that is not the Obsession, the following effects apply to the Obsession:
Their Aura is revealed for 6/8/10 seconds.
They suffer from the Exposed Status Effect for 20 seconds.
When you hook the Obsession, the following effects apply to a random Survivor:
Causes the Survivor to scream and reveal their location to the Killer.
They become the new Obsession.
You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

alts.name: Barbecue & Chilli
alts.desc:
A deep bond with The Entity unlocks potential in one's Aura-reading ability.
After hooking a Survivor, all Survivors who are at least 60/50/40 metres away from that Hook have their Aura revealed to you for 5 seconds.

alts.name: Gearhead
alts.desc:
After a Survivor loses a Health State, Gearhead activates for 30 seconds:
While Gearhead is active, a Survivor succeeding a Good Skill Check while repairing reveals their Aura to you for 6/7/8 seconds.

perks.name: Grim Embrace
perks.desc:
Your act of servitude to The Entity has not gone unnoticed.
Each time a Survivor is hooked for the first time, Grim Embrace gains +1 Token and activates once you are at least 16 metres away from the Hook:
1-3 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 6/8/10 seconds.
4 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 40 seconds and the Aura of the Obsession is revealed to you for 6 seconds.

perks.name: Dead Man's Switch
perks.desc:
After hooking a Survivor, Dead Man's Switch triggers its effect:
The first Generator any Survivor stops repairing for 2 seconds is blocked for 30/35/40 seconds
The Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.
Dead Man's Switch cannot activate if its effect is still active from a previous activation.

perks.name: Secret Project
perks.desc:
Whenever a Totem is blessed or cleansed, a random unblocked generator becomes blocked for  20/25/30 seconds.
Whenever any number of Generators become blocked, you gain Undetectable Status Effect for 30 seconds.

alts.name: Surge
alts.desc:
Whenever you put a Survivor into the Dying State with your Basic Attack, Surge triggers its effect:
Causes all Generators within 32 metres of your location to instantly explode and start regressing.
Instantly regresses all affected Generators by 6/7/8 %.

alts.name: No Holds Barred
alts.desc:
Each time a Generator is completed, No Holds Barred calls upon The Entity for the following effects:
Blocks the Generator with the most Progression for 15/20/25 seconds.
The Aura of the Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.

alts.name: Whispers
alts.desc:
Whenever any Survivor is within 28/26/24 metres of your location:
Causes you to hear the sporadic whispers of The Entity, indicating a Survivor's presence.
Whenever any Survivor is outside 28/26/24 metres of your location:
Gain +5 % Haste Status Effect.

builds.name: Instadown Build
notes: Pick up a Survivor and aim for a Scourge Hook (or near a generator that's not blocked by Thrilling Tremors).
Starstruck will expose nearby Survivors. Keep in mind that they'll often try to make distance or hide, so be aggressive and confident in your patrol after each hook.

perks.name: Agitation
perks.desc:
While carrying a Survivor, Agitation activates:
Increases your Carrying speed by 14/16/18 %.
Increases your Terror Radius by +12 metres.

alts.name: Ravenous
alts.desc:
Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, Ravenous gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 4 Tokens.
For each Token:
Grants +4 % Haste Status Effect while carrying a Survivor.
Increases your hooking speed by +4 %.
Once you accumulate 4 Tokens, all Survivors suffer from the following effects:
Causes them to scream.
Inflicts the Exposed Status Effect for 80/85/90 seconds.

perks.name: Starstruck
perks.desc:
Whenever you are carrying a Survivor, Starstruck activates:
Causes all other Survivors in your Terror Radius to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect.
This effect lingers for 26/28/30 seconds after affected Survivors leave the Terror Radius or Starstruck deactivates.
Starstruck deactivates after hooking or dropping the carried Survivor and has a cool-down of 60 seconds.

perks.name: Thrilling Tremors
perks.desc:
After picking up a Survivor, Thrilling Tremors triggers its effects:
Blocks all Generators not currently being repaired by any Survivors for 16 seconds.
The Auras of Blocked Generators are highlighted to you in white.
Thrilling Tremors has a cool-down of 40/35/30 seconds.

alts.name: Surge
alts.desc:
Whenever you put a Survivor into the Dying State with your Basic Attack, Surge triggers its effect:
Causes all Generators within 32 metres of your location to instantly explode and start regressing.
Instantly regresses all affected Generators by 6/7/8 %.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance
perks.desc:
Overwhelming pain reverberates outwards.
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Start the Trial with 4 Token.
Whenever a Survivor is hooked onto a Scourge Hook for the first time, Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance consumes -1 Token and applies the following effects:
Causes the Generator with the most progression to explode, damaging it.
Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by 10/15/20 % of its total Progression.
Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors repairing the Damaged Generator to scream.
This does not trigger a Loud Noise Notification.
Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance is disabled for the remainder of the Trial once all Tokens are consumed.

alts.name: Nowhere to Hide
alts.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator triggers Nowhere to Hide:
The Auras of all Survivors within 24 metres of the Generator's location are revealed to you for 3/4/5 seconds.

builds.name: Beginner Perks Only
notes: Only uses perks available to this Killer or global perks available to everyone. It might include some alternative perk ideas from one of the five free Killers too.

perks.name: No Holds Barred
perks.desc:
Each time a Generator is completed, No Holds Barred calls upon The Entity for the following effects:
Blocks the Generator with the most Progression for 15/20/25 seconds.
The Aura of the Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.

perks.name: Dead Man's Switch
perks.desc:
After hooking a Survivor, Dead Man's Switch triggers its effect:
The first Generator any Survivor stops repairing for 2 seconds is blocked for 30/35/40 seconds
The Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.
Dead Man's Switch cannot activate if its effect is still active from a previous activation.

perks.name: Gearhead
perks.desc:
After a Survivor loses a Health State, Gearhead activates for 30 seconds:
While Gearhead is active, a Survivor succeeding a Good Skill Check while repairing reveals their Aura to you for 6/7/8 seconds.

alts.name: Tinkerer
alts.desc:
Whenever a Generator is repaired to 70 %, you benefit from the following effects:
Triggers a Loud Noise Notification for that Generator, revealing its location.
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect for the next 12/14/16 seconds.
Tinkerer can only trigger once per Generator per Trial.

perks.name: Hex: No One Escapes Death
perks.desc:
Once the Exit Gates are powered, if there is still a Dull Totem remaining in the environment, Hex: No One Escapes Death activates and lights it:
Grants a 2/3/4 % Haste Status Effect.
Causes all Survivors to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect.
Once the Status Effect is revealed to Survivors, Hex: No One Escapes Death triggers the following effect:
The Aura of its Hex Totem is revealed to all Survivors within 4 metres.
This range gradually expands to 24 metres over the course of 30 seconds.
Hex: No One Escapes Death remains inactive if no Dull Totems are available.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Sloppy Butcher
alts.desc:
Survivors hit with your vicious Basic Attack suffer from the following effects for 70/80/90 seconds:
Inflicts the Haemorrhage and Mangled Status Effects.
Modifies the potency of Haemorrhage:
Increases the Spawn frequency of Pools of Blood by 50/75/100 %.
Increases the Regression rate of partial Healing progression by +25 %.

alts.name: Unrelenting
alts.desc:
Basic Attacks benefit from the following effect:
Increases the recovery speed of missed basic-attacks by 30/35/40 %.
Increases the recovery speed of successful basic-attacks by 10 %.

addons.name: Iridescent Coin
addons.comment: The ability to occasionally instadown Survivors is extremely game-changing and should never be ignored. Even after Survivors become aware of its presence, this add-on will continue to exert pressure on them since they'll never be safe whenever they are in the open. To know if a Survivor has been affected by this add-on, look at the Bloodpoint score event; if it's "Sharpshooter" (400) you will be able to instadown them. If it's "Speared" (200) you were too close.
addons.desc: Survivors suffer from the Exposed Status Effect while speared by The Redeemer, if shot from at least 12 metres away.

addons.name: Warden's Keys
addons.comment: Increases your reload speed, which is universally useful. During chase, a faster reload can sometimes allow you to shoot a Survivor again before they reach safety.
addons.desc: Reduces the Reload time of The Redeemer by -0.35 seconds.

addons.name: Bayshore's Cigar
addons.comment: Reduces the stun that occurs when injuring a Survivor via chain break by 0.75 seconds. This super fast recover sometimes allows you to catch a Survivor again almost immediately before they can reach safety. Can be stacked with its green counterpart.
addons.desc: Reduces the Stun duration when Survivors break free from The Redeemer by -0.75 seconds.

addons.name: Modified Ammo Belt
addons.comment: Increases your reload speed, which is universally useful. During chase, a faster reload can sometimes allow you to shoot a Survivor again before they reach safety.
addons.desc: Reduces the Reload time of The Redeemer by -0.25 seconds.

addons.name: Tin Oil Can
addons.comment: Reduces the cooldown that happens after a missed shot by 0.5 seconds, which allows you to get back into the chase sooner. A deceivingly strong effect, even for advanced players that don't miss very often. This add-on is often overlooked in favor of the simpler and more universally useful reload add-ons.
addons.desc: Reduces the Cool-down time of missed shots with The Redeemer by -0.5 seconds.

addons.name: Rusted Spike
addons.comment: Applies a Mangled effect upon hitting speared Survivors, which lasts 60 seconds. A simple and useful effect, although the Deathslinger's gameplay isn't always fast-paced enough to really make the Mangled effect a huge deal.
addons.desc: Speared Survivors hit with the The Redeemer suffer from the Mangled Status Effect for 60 seconds.

addons.name: Chewing Tobacco
addons.comment: Reduces the stun that occurs when injuring a Survivor via chain break by 0.25 seconds. Can be stacked with its purple counterpart, though you're typically better off with a reload add-on instead.
addons.desc: Reduces the Stun duration when Survivors break free from The Redeemer by -0.25 seconds.

addons.name: Honey Locust Thorn
addons.comment: Applies a Mangled effect upon breaking a chain, which lasts 70 seconds. Not terrible but also not always impactful enough to be worth running.
addons.desc: Speared Survivors breaking free from the The Redeemer suffer from the Mangled Status Effect for 70 seconds.

addons.name: Gold Creek Whiskey
addons.comment: Reduces your terror radius by a significant amount (-8 meters) when holding your aim. Unlike its green counterpart, this one's effect are strong enough to be used on their own. This add-on can be paired with the perk "Monitor & Abuse" to temporarily achieve a 16 meter TR and make it easier to sneak up on Survivors, which is very effective with the insta-down capabilities of the Iridescent Coin. Keep in mind that the Deathslinger maximum range is 18 meters, so you can manage to spear a Survivor that doesn't even hear your terror radius. Needless to say, this strategy is much stronger on certain maps.
addons.desc: Reduces your Terror Radius by -8 metres during Aim Down Sights.

addons.name: Barbed Wire
addons.comment: The longer mending timer is also applied to any other instances that cause Deep Wound, such as being hit immediately upon being unhooked.
addons.desc: Increases the Mending time of Survivors by +3.5 seconds.

addons.name: Hellshire Iron
addons.comment: Provides a very brief Undetectable Status effect that lingers for a few seconds after spearing a Survivor. It might catch Survivors by surprise sometimes, but the effect itself isn't particularly consistent or powerful.
addons.desc:
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect while a Survivor is speared by The Redeemer.
This effect lingers for 10 seconds.

addons.name: Prison Chain
addons.comment: Increases your chain's durability by 10%, making it easier to pull and hit Survivors before they break out. Sounds powerful, but the effect is surprisingly unnecessary in almost every scenario and the longer durability makes it more time consuming to break your own chain on purpose if you plan to use Bayshore's Cigar or other similar add-ons.
addons.desc: Increases the Break-Free time of Survivors from The Redeemer by +10 %.

addons.name: Poison Oak Leaves
addons.comment: The longer mending timer is also applied to any other instances that cause Deep Wound, such as being hit immediately upon being unhooked.
addons.desc: Increases the Mending time of Survivors by +1.5 seconds.

addons.name: Spit Polish Rag
addons.comment: Reduces the cooldown that happens after a missed shot by 0.25 seconds, which allows you to get back into the chase sooner. A small effect, but still quite useful especially for beginners.
addons.desc: Reduces the Cool-down time of missed shots with The Redeemer by -0.25 seconds.

addons.name: Marshal's Badge
addons.comment: Reduces your terror radius by a small amount (-4 meters) when holding your aim. Although it can be stacked with its purple counterpart for a decent combined effect, there's almost never a reason to use this add-on. Read the commentary of the purple Gold Creek Whiskey for more information.
addons.desc: Reduces your Terror Radius by -4 metres during Aim Down Sights.

addons.name: Wanted Poster
addons.comment: Slightly increases your movement speed while holding up your rifle. This effect is completely unnecessary since you are already pretty fast and you almost never want to hold your aim for extended periods of time anyway. Almost never worth running over other add-ons.
addons.desc: Increases your Movement speed by +3 % during Aim Down Sights.

addons.name: Jaw Smasher
addons.comment: Slightly increases your movement speed while holding up your rifle. This effect is completely unnecessary since you are already pretty fast and you almost never want to hold your aim for extended periods of time anyway. Almost never worth running over other add-ons.
addons.desc: Increases your Movement speed by +1.5 % during Aim Down Sights.

addons.name: Bayshore's Gold Tooth
addons.comment: Increase the speed at which speared Survivors are reeled when you pull them towards you. Unfortunately, the effect itself is almost insignificant and doesn't make a real difference in almost any situation. This add-on and its brown counterpart also indirectly speed up the movement of a Survivor's struggle, making them slightly harder to control in some critical situations.
addons.desc: Increases the Reeling speed of The Redeemer by +5 %.

addons.name: Snake Oil
addons.comment: Increase the speed at which speared Survivors are reeled when you pull them towards you. Unfortunately, the effect itself is almost insignificant and doesn't make a real difference in almost any situation. This add-on and its blue counterpart also indirectly speed up the movement of a Survivor's struggle, making them slightly harder to control in some critical situations.
addons.desc: Increases the Reeling speed of The Redeemer by +2.5 %.

addons.name: Rickety Chain
addons.comment: Your chain breaks at a much faster rate when spearing a Survivor. This is a terrible downside and should generally be avoided. In the best case scenario, this add-on will do nothing at all or even save you a bit of time when you purposefully want to break your chain to injure someone. Even considering this, there are better alternative add-ons for this purpose, such as the purple Bayshore's Cigar.
addons.desc:
Grants +50 % bonus Bloodpoints for Speared Score Events.
Increases the Break-Free speed of Survivors from The Redeemer by +33 %.

killers.name: The Executioner
killers.otzComment:
While the Executioner is mostly unable to use hook-related perks himself, he can often counter many of the strongest hook-related perks that Survivors bring. His ranged attack is difficult to master but provides a constant threat to Survivors in chase if used correctly.
The Executioner is one of the hardest hybrid-ranged Killers in the game, with his punishment attack requiring both precision and prediction. Many beginners also struggle with the clumsy tank-like camera control that occurs while dragging his sword on the ground. On top of that, his perks are generally not very useful and not a high priority for newer players to unlock, especially when you consider that most of them are outclassed by other perks.

teachables.name: Forced Penance
teachables.desc:
Whenever a Survivor triggers a Protection Hit, they suffer from the following effect:
Inflicts the Broken Status Effect for 60/70/80 seconds.

teachables.name: Trail of Torment
teachables.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator activates Trail of Torment:
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect.
The Aura of the Damaged Generator is revealed to all Survivors and highlighted in yellow.
Trail of Torment deactivates after the Damaged Generator stops regressing by any means and has a cool-down of 60/45/30 seconds between activations.

teachables.name: Deathbound
teachables.desc:
Whenever a Survivor finishes healing another Survivor for the equivalent of 1 Health State, Deathbound activates:
Causes the Healer to scream and reveal their location.
Causes the Healer to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect whenever they are farther than 12/8/4 metres from the other Survivor.
The Healer sees the Aura of the Healed Survivor while Deathbound is active.
Deathbound deactivates after the Healer loses a Health State.

builds.name: Generic Build
notes: Reliable and well-rounded build; a good starting point until you find the ideal build for your playstyle.
Nowhere to Hide will reveal nearby Survivors after each generator kick. If there's nobody around, Lay Waste is almost guaranteed to regress it quite significantly.

perks.name: Corrupt Intervention
perks.desc:
Your prayers invoke a dark power that meddles with the Survivors' chances of survival.
At the start of the Trial, the 3 Generators located farthest from you are blocked by The Entity for 80/100/120 seconds.
Corrupt Intervention deactivates prematurely once the first Survivor is put into the Dying State.

perks.name: Lay Waste
perks.desc:
Damaging a Generator makes it regress +2 % faster for each Charge it has.
This perk has a cool-down of 55/50/45 seconds after damaging a Generator.

alts.name: Call of Brine
alts.desc:
After performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator, Call of Brine applies its effects to it for 90 seconds:
Increases its Regression speed to 130/140/150 % of the default value.
Highlights its Aura to you in yellow.
Triggers a Loud Noise Notification whenever a Survivor succeeds a Good Skill Check while repairing it.

alts.name: Trail of Torment
alts.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator activates Trail of Torment:
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect.
The Aura of the Damaged Generator is revealed to all Survivors and highlighted in yellow.
Trail of Torment deactivates after the Damaged Generator stops regressing by any means and has a cool-down of 60/45/30 seconds between activations.

alts.name: Unforeseen
alts.desc:
After performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator, you benefit from the following effects for 22/26/30 seconds:
Transfers your Terror Radius to the damaged Generator.
This Terror Radius is set to 32 metres.
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect.
Unforeseen has a cool-down of 30 seconds.

perks.name: Nowhere to Hide
perks.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator triggers Nowhere to Hide:
The Auras of all Survivors within 24 metres of the Generator's location are revealed to you for 3/4/5 seconds.

alts.name: Eruption
alts.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on Generators highlights their Auras in yellow.
Whenever a Survivor enters the Dying State by any means, Eruption triggers the following effects on all highlighted Generators:
Causes them to explode, damaging them.
Instantly regresses them by -10 % of their total Progression.
Causes them to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors currently repairing them to suffer from the following effects:
Causes them to scream.
Their Auras are revealed to you for 8/10/12 seconds.
Eruption has a cool-down of 30 seconds after triggering its effects, which also resets the highlighted Auras.

perks.name: No Way Out
perks.desc:
Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, No Way Out gains +1 Token.
Once the Exit Gates are powered, No Way Out activates:
Causes the first Survivor to interact with either Exit Gate Switch to trigger a Loud Noise Notification at their location.
Upon triggering the Loud Noise Notification, No Way Out calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks both Exit Gate Switches for 12 seconds.
This time is extended by an additional 6/9/12 seconds per accumulated Token, up to a combined maximum of 36/48/60 seconds.

alts.name: Hex: Wretched Fate
alts.desc:
You see your victim from afar and resolve to prolong their suffering.
After a Generator is completed, Hex: Wretched Fate activates and lights a random Dull Totem, cursing the Obsession:
Reduces their Repair speed by 27/30/33 %.
The Aura of the Hex Totem is revealed to them within 12 metres.

alts.name: Hex: No One Escapes Death
alts.desc:
Once the Exit Gates are powered, if there is still a Dull Totem remaining in the environment, Hex: No One Escapes Death activates and lights it:
Grants a 2/3/4 % Haste Status Effect.
Causes all Survivors to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect.
Once the Status Effect is revealed to Survivors, Hex: No One Escapes Death triggers the following effect:
The Aura of its Hex Totem is revealed to all Survivors within 4 metres.
This range gradually expands to 24 metres over the course of 30 seconds.
Hex: No One Escapes Death remains inactive if no Dull Totems are available.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Whispers
alts.desc:
Whenever any Survivor is within 28/26/24 metres of your location:
Causes you to hear the sporadic whispers of The Entity, indicating a Survivor's presence.
Whenever any Survivor is outside 28/26/24 metres of your location:
Gain +5 % Haste Status Effect.

builds.name: Hex & Aura Build
notes: Don't forget that you can quickly cover the space next to a totem with your trails. Any Survivor that attempts to cleanse will be immediately tormented, even if they were crouching before starting the animation.

perks.name: Hex: Ruin
perks.desc:
All Generators not currently being repaired experience the following effect:
Causes them to automatically regress at 100/125/150 % of the default Regression rate.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Hex: Undying
perks.desc:
Whenever a Survivor is within 2/3/4 metres of a Dull Totem, Hex: Undying triggers its primary effect:
Their Aura is revealed to you for as long as they remain in that range.
Whenever a Hex Totem is cleansed, Hex: Undying triggers its secondary effect:
Transfers the cleansed Hex to the Hex Totem associated with Hex: Undying instead, replacing it.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Hex: Retribution
perks.desc:
Whenever a Survivor blesses or cleanses a Totem, Hex: Retribution triggers its primary effect:
Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect for 40/50/60 seconds.
Whenever a Hex Totem is removed by any means, including its own, Hex: Retribution triggers its secondary effect:
The Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 20 seconds.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Dominance
alts.desc:
The power you wield over the land strikes terror in the hearts of all who cross your path.
The first time each Totem are interacted with by a Survivor, Dominance triggers its effect:
Calls upon The Entity to block it for 25 seconds.
The Aura of the blocked Prop is revealed to you in white.
The Survivor screams.
The Survivor's aura is revealed to you for 3/4/5 seconds.

perks.name: Lethal Pursuer
perks.desc:
At the start of the Trial, the Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 7/8/9 seconds.
Extends the duration of all instances of a Survivor Aura being revealed to you by +2 seconds.
Lethal Pursuer benefits from its own effect.

alts.name: No Way Out
alts.desc:
Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, No Way Out gains +1 Token.
Once the Exit Gates are powered, No Way Out activates:
Causes the first Survivor to interact with either Exit Gate Switch to trigger a Loud Noise Notification at their location.
Upon triggering the Loud Noise Notification, No Way Out calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks both Exit Gate Switches for 12 seconds.
This time is extended by an additional 6/9/12 seconds per accumulated Token, up to a combined maximum of 36/48/60 seconds.

alts.name: No Holds Barred
alts.desc:
Each time a Generator is completed, No Holds Barred calls upon The Entity for the following effects:
Blocks the Generator with the most Progression for 15/20/25 seconds.
The Aura of the Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.

alts.name: Trail of Torment
alts.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator activates Trail of Torment:
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect.
The Aura of the Damaged Generator is revealed to all Survivors and highlighted in yellow.
Trail of Torment deactivates after the Damaged Generator stops regressing by any means and has a cool-down of 60/45/30 seconds between activations.

Their Aura is revealed to you for 3/4/5 seconds.

alts.name: I'm All Ears
alts.desc:
Whenever a Survivor performs a Rushed Vault action within 48 metres of your location, you benefit from the following effect:
The Aura of the Survivor is revealed to you for 8 seconds.
I'm All Ears has a cool-down of 60/45/30 seconds.

alts.name: Predator
alts.desc:
Whenever you lose a Survivor in a Chase, Predator triggers its effect:
Their Aura is revealed to you for 4 seconds.
Predator has a cool-down of 60/50/40 seconds.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance
perks.desc:
Overwhelming pain reverberates outwards.
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Start the Trial with 4 Token.
Whenever a Survivor is hooked onto a Scourge Hook for the first time, Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance consumes -1 Token and applies the following effects:
Causes the Generator with the most progression to explode, damaging it.
Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by 10/15/20 % of its total Progression.
Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors repairing the Damaged Generator to scream.
This does not trigger a Loud Noise Notification.
Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance is disabled for the remainder of the Trial once all Tokens are consumed.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Floods of Rage
perks.desc:
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Each time a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook, the following effects apply:
The Auras of all other Survivors are revealed for 5/6/7 seconds.

alts.name: Bitter Murmur
alts.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability.
Whenever a Generator is completed, Bitter Murmur triggers its primary effect:
The Auras of any Survivors within 20 metres of that Generator are revealed to you for 10 seconds.
Once the last Generator is completed, Bitter Murmur triggers its secondary effect:
The Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 16/18/20 seconds.

Alerts you with a unique Loud Noise Notification in the shape of a Crow.
Spies from the Shadows has a cool-down of 3 seconds between alerts.

alts.name: Tinkerer
alts.desc:
Whenever a Generator is repaired to 70 %, you benefit from the following effects:
Triggers a Loud Noise Notification for that Generator, revealing its location.
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect for the next 12/14/16 seconds.
Tinkerer can only trigger once per Generator per Trial.

perks.desc:

Grants a 2/3/4 % Haste Status Effect.
