Ultimate Weapon has a cool-down of 55/50/45 seconds.

alts.name: Discordance
alts.desc:
Any Generator within a range of 64/96/128 metres that is being repaired by 2 or more Survivors is marked by a yellow Aura.
When the Generator is first highlighted, Discordance triggers a Loud Noise Notification on the Generator.
After the Generator is no longer within range or is being repaired by just 1 Survivor, the highlighted Aura will linger for another 4 seconds.

builds.name: Beginner Perks Only
notes: Only uses perks available to this Killer or global perks available to everyone. It might include some alternative perk ideas from one of the five free Killers too.
Dominance will protect both your Wretched Fate and NOED hexes for a few extra seconds! Alternatively, you could bring some useful info perk if you're struggling to locate Survivors.
Whispers can be a great perk start using; it will tell you when you're getting close to someone, even in bat form.

perks.name: No Holds Barred
perks.desc:
Each time a Generator is completed, No Holds Barred calls upon The Entity for the following effects:
Blocks the Generator with the most Progression for 15/20/25 seconds.
The Aura of the Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.

perks.name: Hex: Wretched Fate
perks.desc:
You see your victim from afar and resolve to prolong their suffering.
After a Generator is completed, Hex: Wretched Fate activates and lights a random Dull Totem, cursing the Obsession:
Reduces their Repair speed by 27/30/33 %.
The Aura of the Hex Totem is revealed to them within 12 metres.

perks.name: Dominance
perks.desc:
The power you wield over the land strikes terror in the hearts of all who cross your path.
The first time each Totem are interacted with by a Survivor, Dominance triggers its effect:
Calls upon The Entity to block it for 25 seconds.
The Aura of the blocked Prop is revealed to you in white.
The Survivor screams.
The Survivor's aura is revealed to you for 3/4/5 seconds.

alts.name: Spies from the Shadows
alts.desc:
Whenever a Survivor startles a Crow within 36/38/40 metres of your location, Spies from the Shadows triggers its effect:
Alerts you with a unique Loud Noise Notification in the shape of a Crow.
Spies from the Shadows has a cool-down of 3 seconds between alerts.

perks.name: Hex: No One Escapes Death
perks.desc:
Once the Exit Gates are powered, if there is still a Dull Totem remaining in the environment, Hex: No One Escapes Death activates and lights it:
Grants a 2/3/4 % Haste Status Effect.
Causes all Survivors to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect.
Once the Status Effect is revealed to Survivors, Hex: No One Escapes Death triggers the following effect:
The Aura of its Hex Totem is revealed to all Survivors within 4 metres.
This range gradually expands to 24 metres over the course of 30 seconds.
Hex: No One Escapes Death remains inactive if no Dull Totems are available.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Whispers
alts.desc:
Whenever any Survivor is within 28/26/24 metres of your location:
Causes you to hear the sporadic whispers of The Entity, indicating a Survivor's presence.
Whenever any Survivor is outside 28/26/24 metres of your location:
Gain +5 % Haste Status Effect.

addons.name: Warg's Fang
addons.comment: Briefly reveals the auras of Survivors whose scent orbs you have collected when your pounce attack is ready in Wolf form. This effect starts out slow but it becomes very oppressive later since it allows you to track basically the entire team once the match has progressed enough and you've collected everyone's orbs at least once. This effect can be further enhanced with the passive ability of the perk Lethal Pursuer.
addons.desc:
While in Wolf Form , whenever the Pounce attack becomes available, you benefit from the following effect:
The Auras of all Survivors whose Scent Orbs you have collected are revealed to you for 5 seconds.

addons.name: Lapis Lazuli
addons.comment: Blocks window vaults when you teleport to them during Bat form. A very decent way to deal with strong windows or preemptively disable them when starting a chase in places like the shack. If you have sharp ears, you can immediately determine the direction of the Survivor and make sure that you fly through the window into the appropiate side. Not extremely impactful in certain maps like Gideon that revolve mostly around pallets, but it can single-handedly deny certain windows that would otherwise give you some trouble.
addons.desc:
After teleporting to a Window, Lapis Lazuli triggers its effect:
Calls upon The Entity to block it to all Survivors for 8 seconds.

addons.name: Killer Doll
addons.comment: Increases the pounce cooldown recovery that you normally obtain from collecting scent orbs during Wolf form. For reference, the normal pounce cooldown is 20 seconds. Each orb scent saves approximately ~6 seconds, and with this add-on they'll save 30% more or roughly ~8 seconds. A decent effect if you plan to stay on Wolf form for a while. Sometimes you will get your pounce back after collecting two orbs regardless of add-ons, however, making this add-on slightly redundant on some occasions.
addons.desc:
Modifies the Pounce attack with the following effect:
Increases the Cool-down bonus from collecting Scent Orbs by +30 %.

addons.name: Force of Echo
addons.comment: Increases the rate at which Survivors drop scent orbs, which you can see and collect during Wolf form. This provides information but also a short haste effect (non-stackable) that can really make a difference over time. It also helps you regain the ability to perform a pounce in Wolf form, although the blue Killer Doll add-on is possibly better in that regard. Either way, neither of these add-ons increase the value of these orbs by an extreme amount.
addons.desc:
Modifies the Scent Orbs with the following effect:
Increases their Spawn rate by +10 %.

addons.name: Iridescent Ring of Vlad
addons.comment: Changes the behaviour of your Hellfire pillars by introducing a slight tracking, making Hellfire sometimes land a hit that would otherwise miss. This effect is most noticeable towards the furthest pillars, but the curving can help you land hits around obstacles even from relatively close distances. It's best to try it once you already have a solid understanding of the hellfire mechanic so it doesn't mess with your muscle memory while you're still learning.
addons.desc:
Modifies the Hellfire attack with the following effect:
Causes the Pillars of Flame to home-in on nearby Survivors.

addons.name: Cerberus Talon
addons.comment: Doubles the range at which you can see the auras of scent orbs. A fairly noticeable effect that can allow you to detect orbs from much further, which is a great way to gather information. Do keep in mind that going out of your way to pick up orbs might not be always worth it however, especially if you aren't using other add-ons (such as the purple Warg's Fang). Survivors only leave orbs when sprinting, so teams that move around the map carefully will definitely be harder to track even with this add-on.
addons.desc:
Modifies the Scent Orbs with the following effect:
Increases their Aura-Reveal distance by +100 %.

addons.name: Medusa's Hair
addons.comment: Inflicts a brief Hindered effect on Survivors near spots that you've teleported to as a Bat. Due to its limited range, this effect is not very useful if you're just generally moving around the map or if you're not using the ability much in the first place. However, it can make a significant difference when using it aggressively in chase and teleporting right on top of a dropped pallet/window that Survivors are using, since their reduced movement speed will let you catch up a bit easier. Lapis Lazuli and Medusa's Hair can work great when paired together.
addons.desc:
Causes all Survivors within 8 metres of your Teleport destination to suffer from the following effect:
Inflicts a -8 % Hindered Status Effect for 4 seconds.

addons.name: Moonstone Necklace
addons.comment: Permanently reduces the terror radius by -8 meters while in Vampire or Wolf form, making it 24 meters in total. Obviously does not apply during Bat form, since you're undetectable anyway. This reduction gives Survivors approximately two fewer seconds of reaction time when you approach them in a straight line and is not a bad effect at all. This add-on is a great and safe choice for anyone, but especially for newer players that are not extremely confident in their ability to track during Bat form yet.
addons.desc:
Modifies the Vampire Form and the Wolf Form with the following effect:
Reduces the Terror Radius by -8 metres.

addons.name: Winged Boots
addons.comment: Increases the maximum Bat teleportation distance by 20%, bringing it from 32 meters to 38.4 meters, also allowing you to see vaults from further. Increases your overall awareness of vaults around the map and can save some time, but not extremely impactful, especially if you're not using the ability much in the first place. Keep in mind that Survivors see your bat as it teleports to a vault point, so they'll often start running away from it.
addons.desc:
Modifies the Teleport ability with the following effect:
Increases its Teleportation range by +20 %.

addons.name: Magical Ticket
addons.comment: Increases the maximum speed of Bat teleportation by 10%. Can save some time when traversing the map, but not extremely impactful, especially if you're not using the ability much in the first place. Since Survivors can see you perform this action, this add-on can sometimes reduce their ability to react and create distance away from you by a small margin, which might make a difference if you're using it alongside the purple Lapis Lazuli add-on.
addons.desc:
Modifies the Teleport ability with the following effect:
Increases the Teleporation speed by +10 %.

addons.name: Pocket Watch
addons.comment: Completely resets the Bat teleport ability when performing the break action on a pallet or breakable wall, which normally has a fixed cooldown of 15 seconds. Many beginner players don't use the teleport ability often, let alone two times in a row, so this effect will be wasted on them. However, this add-on does enable a particular strategy which can save you a bit of time; teleport to a dropped pallet or near a breakable wall, destroy it, and then immediately teleport again to keep the pressure up. Leaving weak pallets as teleport points for later becomes an even more viable strategy. Particularly useful in pallet-dense maps where you might need to do a lot of cleanup after a chase.
addons.desc:
Modifies the Teleport ability with the following effect:
Instantly recharges it after breaking a Pallet.

addons.name: Blood-Filled Goblet
addons.comment: Makes scent orbs, which are visible during Wolf form, last an extra 6 seconds (bringing it from 10 to 16s). Not a terrible effect, since it might allow you to find more of them when you transform and makes it harder for Survivors to stay in one location without feeding several orbs that boost your movement speed. Keep in mind that the boost from these orbs does not stack multiple times, however. The only unfortunate downside of this add-on is that it indirectly makes it harder to guess where the Survivor who left the orb will be (since they could literally be across the map by the time 16 seconds have passed).
addons.desc:
Modifies the Scent Orbs with the following effect:
Extends their Lifetime by +60 %.

addons.name: Sylph Feather
addons.comment: Decreases the cooldown of Hellfire for each pallet broken by -5%, resulting in a noticeably shorter cooldown after you've broken several pallets which stacks until it's approximately two seconds shorter. Not a terrible option if you're very good at using Hellfire and you expect a match to last a while, but Dracula is so good at playing around dropped pallets that you don't always want to break them mindlessly. As explained in the description of the brown Ruby Circlet, Dracula is not a Killer that necessarily wants to focus on the same ability repeatedly anyway.
addons.desc:
Whenever you break a Pallet, Sylph Feather gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 5 Tokens:
Reduces the Cool-down duration of the Hellfire attack by a stack-able -5 % per Token, up to a limit of -25 %.

addons.name: Alucard's Shield
addons.comment: Produces a constant barrage of fire pillars at exit gates when they are open. Not much of a threat by themselves, but they can make a tricky endgame situation even more difficult for Survivors.
addons.desc:
Whenever an Exit Gate is opened, Alucard's Shield triggers its effect:
Causes the area inside the Exit Gate to continuously spawn Pillars of Flame.

addons.name: Ruby Circlet
addons.comment: Decreases the cooldown of Hellfire (normally 9.5 seconds) by 5%, saving you about half a second of recovery time until you can use it again. This is a small effect and not incredibly impactful, as Hellfire requires precise timing and is not typically an ability that you want to use as soon as possible anyway. Generally speaking, it's best to time your abilities carefully and cycle through them during your cooldowns instead of focusing entirely on just one of them. You can combine it with the blue Sylph Feather if you want to have an even shorter recovery period.
addons.desc:
Modifies the Hellfire attack with the following effect:
Reduces its Cool-down duration by -5 %.

addons.name: Cube of Zoe
addons.comment: Creates random fire pillars around you for a brief duration each time a generator gets completed. Their location is random and they are generally not much of a threat unless several Survivors are currently swarming you, but they can occasionally give you a hit here and there. It's certainly a fun and chaotic effect, but it's extremely unreliable and generally not worth the add-on slot, especially compared to other add-ons of this rarity and below.
addons.desc:
Whenever a Generator is completed, Cube of Zoe triggers its effect for 10 seconds:
Causes the immediate area around The Dark Lord to continuously spawn Pillars of Flame.

addons.name: Clock Tower Gear
addons.comment: Allows you to change forms more frequently, reducing the Shapeshift cooldown of 3.5 seconds by approximately 0.18s. Shortening this cooldown is quite useful, but the effect itself is very tiny and rarely enough to make a critical difference. That being said, it's a safe choice if you want a simple add-on and plan on switching forms very often.
addons.desc:
Modifies the Shapeshift ability with the following effect:
Reduces its Cool-down time by -5 %.

addons.name: Traveller's Hat
addons.comment: Makes the transitions from one form to another very slightly faster. This transition is usually 1 second (or 1.5 if switching from Bat form) so the 5% is practically almost unnoticeable. The effect itself isn't bad, but it's too small to justify the add-on slot in almost every scenario.
addons.desc:
Modifies the Shapeshift ability with the following effect:
Reduces the Transition time between Forms by -5 %.

addons.name: White Wolf Medallion
addons.comment: Increases the duration of the Killer Instinct that triggers anytime Survivors perform a rushed action during Wolf form. Killer Instinct provides a heartbeat-like effect and hightlights the Survivors in a certain color and is notably uncounterable by any Survivor perk or item. This can make it easier to track a sneaky Survivors that could otherwise get away with a stealth perk such as "Quick and Quiet" but the extended duration from this add-on is very minimal and does not really help in any significant way.
addons.desc:
Modifies Wolf Form with the following effect:
Increases its Killer Instinct duration by +1 second.

addons.name: Sunglasses
addons.comment: Increases the range of Hellfire pillars in Vampire form, but at the cost of longer charge time. Might allow you to catch some Survivors off-guard with this extra range, but it's generally not a worthy trade-off. Feel free to try it out for fun if you know what you're doing, but perhaps stay away from it if you're still learning this Killer.
addons.desc:
Modifies the Hellfire attack with the following effects:
Increases the number of Pillars of Flame by 1.
Increases its Charge time by +25 %.

perks.desc:
After hooking a Survivor, Pop Goes the Weasel activates for 35/40/45 seconds.
While active, manually damaging a Generator triggers the following effect:
Increases the regression amount by +15 % resulting in 20 % regression.
Pop Goes the Weasel deactivates after use or once its timer elapses.
perks.name: Pop Goes the Weasel

perks.desc:
Your prayers invoke a dark power that meddles with the Survivors' chances of survival.
At the start of the Trial, the 3 Generators located farthest from you are blocked by The Entity for 80/100/120 seconds.
Corrupt Intervention deactivates prematurely once the first Survivor is put into the Dying State.
perks.name: Corrupt Intervention

perks.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on Generators highlights their Auras in yellow.
Whenever a Survivor enters the Dying State by any means, Eruption triggers the following effects on all highlighted Generators:
Causes them to explode, damaging them.
Instantly regresses them by -10 % of their total Progression.
Causes them to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors currently repairing them to suffer from the following effects:
Causes them to scream.
Their Auras are revealed to you for 8/10/12 seconds.
Eruption has a cool-down of 30 seconds after triggering its effects, which also resets the highlighted Auras.
perks.name: Eruption

perks.desc:
Overwhelming pain reverberates outwards.
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Start the Trial with 4 Token.
Whenever a Survivor is hooked onto a Scourge Hook for the first time, Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance consumes -1 Token and applies the following effects:
Causes the Generator with the most progression to explode, damaging it.
Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by 10/15/20 % of its total Progression.
Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors repairing the Damaged Generator to scream.
This does not trigger a Loud Noise Notification.
Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance is disabled for the remainder of the Trial once all Tokens are consumed.
perks.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance

perks.desc:
Whenever a Survivor startles a Crow within 36/38/40 metres of your location, Spies from the Shadows triggers its effect:
Alerts you with a unique Loud Noise Notification in the shape of a Crow.
Spies from the Shadows has a cool-down of 3 seconds between alerts.
perks.name: Spies from the Shadows

Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance is disabled for the remainder of the Trial once all Tokens are consumed.
perks.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance

perks.desc:
When a Survivor scares off a Crow within 36 metres of your location, Languid Touch activates:
Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Exhausted Status Effect for 6/8/10 seconds.
Languid Touch has a cool-down of 5 seconds.
perks.name: Languid Touch

perks.desc: After hooking a Survivor, for 40/50/60 seconds, press the Active Ability button to make a target generator within 20 meters explode, lose -10 % progress, and start regressing.
perks.name: Turn Back The Clock

perks.desc:
A deep bond with The Entity unlocks potential in one's Aura-reading ability.
After hooking a Survivor, all Survivors who are at least 60/50/40 metres away from that Hook have their Aura revealed to you for 5 seconds.
perks.name: Barbecue & Chili

perks.desc:
After hooking a Survivor, Dead Man's Switch triggers its effect:
The first Generator any Survivor stops repairing for 2 seconds is blocked for 30/35/40 seconds
The Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.
Dead Man's Switch cannot activate if its effect is still active from a previous activation.
perks.name: Dead Man’s Switch

perks.desc:
Your act of servitude to The Entity has not gone unnoticed.
Each time a Survivor is hooked for the first time, Grim Embrace gains +1 Token and activates once you are at least 16 metres away from the Hook:
1-3 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 6/8/10 seconds.
4 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 40 seconds and the Aura of the Obsession is revealed to you for 6 seconds.
perks.name: Grim Embrace

Whenever a Survivors takes damage, Forever Entwined gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 6/7/8 Tokens:
Increases the Action speeds for Dropping, Hooking, and Picking up a Survivor by a stack-able +4 % per Token, up to a maximum of 24/28/32 %.
perks.name: Forever Entwined

Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors repairing the Damaged Generator to scream.
This does not trigger a Loud Noise Notification.
Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance is disabled for the remainder of the Trial once all Tokens are consumed.
perks.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance

killers.name: The Houndmaster
killers.otzComment:
The Houndmaster is a Killer with average stats but a very complex power that relies on her dog companion and requires you to multitask. She has the potential to outplay Survivors on a wide variety of structures, but only if accuracy (and a bit of luck) are on her side.
The Houndmaster is not a beginner-friendly Killer. Her two different powers (chasing & searching) both require precision and great strategic thinking to truly shine. Her perks are also, generally speaking, very niche. All-Shaking Thunder increases your lunge distance, but only does so consistently in maps where you can constantly find places to drop from. No Quarter can help make self-healing more difficult for Survivors, but will typically give mediocre results against experienced players unless used on very specific skill-check builds. Scourge Hook: Jagged Compass, however, is a very solid addition to builds with other Scourge Hooks.

teachables.name: All-Shaking Thunder
teachables.desc:
After falling from a height, All-Shaking Thunder activates for 15/20/25 seconds:
Increases the range of your Lunge Attack by +75 %.
All-Shaking Thunder has a cool-down of 5 seconds.

teachables.name: Scourge Hook: Jagged Compass
teachables.desc:
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Whenever a Survivor is unhooked from a normal Hook, the following effect applies:
The Hook is converted into a Scourge Hook.
Whenever you hook a Survivor onto a Scourge Hook, the following effect applies:
The Aura of the Generator with the most progression is highlighted in yellow for 6/8/10 seconds.

teachables.name: No Quarter
teachables.desc:
Whenever a Survivor healing themselves by any means reaches 75 % Healing Progress, No Quarter triggers its effect:
The Survivor is faced with a continuous stream of Skill Checks until the Self-Heal is completed.
If they fail a Skill Check or interrupt the action by any means, they suffer from the Broken Status Effect for 20/25/30 seconds.

builds.name: Generic Build
notes: Reliable and well-rounded build; a good starting point until you find the ideal build for your playstyle.

perks.name: Lethal Pursuer
perks.desc:
At the start of the Trial, the Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 7/8/9 seconds.
Extends the duration of all instances of a Survivor Aura being revealed to you by +2 seconds.
Lethal Pursuer benefits from its own effect.

alts.name: Corrupt Intervention
alts.desc:
Your prayers invoke a dark power that meddles with the Survivors' chances of survival.
At the start of the Trial, the 3 Generators located farthest from you are blocked by The Entity for 80/100/120 seconds.
Corrupt Intervention deactivates prematurely once the first Survivor is put into the Dying State.

alts.name: Discordance
alts.desc:
Any Generator within a range of 64/96/128 metres that is being repaired by 2 or more Survivors is marked by a yellow Aura.
When the Generator is first highlighted, Discordance triggers a Loud Noise Notification on the Generator.
After the Generator is no longer within range or is being repaired by just 1 Survivor, the highlighted Aura will linger for another 4 seconds.

perks.name: Barbecue & Chilli
perks.desc:
A deep bond with The Entity unlocks potential in one's Aura-reading ability.
After hooking a Survivor, all Survivors who are at least 60/50/40 metres away from that Hook have their Aura revealed to you for 5 seconds.

alts.name: Thrilling Tremors
alts.desc:
After picking up a Survivor, Thrilling Tremors triggers its effects:
Blocks all Generators not currently being repaired by any Survivors for 16 seconds.
The Auras of Blocked Generators are highlighted to you in white.
Thrilling Tremors has a cool-down of 40/35/30 seconds.

alts.name: A Nurse's Calling
alts.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability:
The Auras of Survivors being healed or healing themselves are revealed to you within 28/30/32 metres.

perks.name: Surge
perks.desc:
Whenever you put a Survivor into the Dying State with your Basic Attack, Surge triggers its effect:
Causes all Generators within 32 metres of your location to instantly explode and start regressing.
Instantly regresses all affected Generators by 6/7/8 %.

perks.name: Turn Back the Clock
perks.desc: After hooking a Survivor, for 40/50/60 seconds, press the Active Ability button to make a target generator within 20 meters explode, lose -10 % progress, and start regressing.

alts.name: Hex: Ruin
alts.desc:
All Generators not currently being repaired experience the following effect:
Causes them to automatically regress at 100/125/150 % of the default Regression rate.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Start the Trial with 4 Token.
Whenever a Survivor is hooked onto a Scourge Hook for the first time, Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance consumes -1 Token and applies the following effects:
Causes the Generator with the most progression to explode, damaging it.
Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by 10/15/20 % of its total Progression.

Causes all Survivors repairing the Damaged Generator to scream.
This does not trigger a Loud Noise Notification.
Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance is disabled for the remainder of the Trial once all Tokens are consumed.

Extends the duration of all instances of a Survivor Aura being revealed to you by +2 seconds.
Lethal Pursuer benefits from its own effect.

alts.name: Scourge Hook: Weeping Wounds
alts.desc:
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Each time a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook, the following effects apply:
Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Haemorrhage Status Effect for 90 seconds.
After the first time that Survivor is healed back to full health, they suffer from the following effect until they are injured again by any means:
Reduces their Action speeds for Healing and Repairing by 10/13/16 %.

builds.name: Instadown Build
notes: Agitation extends your Terror Radius, applying Starstruck to possibly even more Survivors. The extra speed also allows you to reliably reach a Pain Res Scourge Hook.
Early on, prioritize triggering Pain Res unless you have a golden opportunity to go for instadowns. Later on, with fewer gens on the board, Starstruck will become harder and harder to avoid.

perks.name: Starstruck
perks.desc:
Whenever you are carrying a Survivor, Starstruck activates:
Causes all other Survivors in your Terror Radius to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect.
This effect lingers for 26/28/30 seconds after affected Survivors leave the Terror Radius or Starstruck deactivates.
Starstruck deactivates after hooking or dropping the carried Survivor and has a cool-down of 60 seconds.

alts.name: Ravenous
alts.desc:
Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, Ravenous gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 4 Tokens.
For each Token:
Grants +4 % Haste Status Effect while carrying a Survivor.
Increases your hooking speed by +4 %.
Once you accumulate 4 Tokens, all Survivors suffer from the following effects:
Causes them to scream.
Inflicts the Exposed Status Effect for 80/85/90 seconds.

perks.name: Agitation
perks.desc:
While carrying a Survivor, Agitation activates:
Increases your Carrying speed by 14/16/18 %.
Increases your Terror Radius by +12 metres.

alts.name: Fire Up
alts.desc:
The increased pressure of losing your preys fills you with anger and gives you unsuspected motivation.
For each completed Generator, Fire Up gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 5 Tokens:
Increases the Action speeds for the following interactions by a stack-able 6/7/8 % per Token, up to a maximum of 30/35/40 %:
Picking up and dropping Survivors.
Breaking Breakable Walls and dropped Pallets.
Damaging Generators.
Vaulting Windows.

alts.name: Spies from the Shadows
alts.desc:
Whenever a Survivor startles a Crow within 36/38/40 metres of your location, Spies from the Shadows triggers its effect:
Alerts you with a unique Loud Noise Notification in the shape of a Crow.
Spies from the Shadows has a cool-down of 3 seconds between alerts.

builds.name: Beginner Perks Only
notes: Only uses perks available to this Killer or global perks available to everyone. It might include some alternative perk ideas from one of the five free Killers too.

perks.name: No Holds Barred
perks.desc:
Each time a Generator is completed, No Holds Barred calls upon The Entity for the following effects:
Blocks the Generator with the most Progression for 15/20/25 seconds.
The Aura of the Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.

perks.name: Sloppy Butcher
perks.desc:
Survivors hit with your vicious Basic Attack suffer from the following effects for 70/80/90 seconds:
Inflicts the Haemorrhage and Mangled Status Effects.
Modifies the potency of Haemorrhage:
Increases the Spawn frequency of Pools of Blood by 50/75/100 %.
Increases the Regression rate of partial Healing progression by +25 %.

perks.name: Hex: No One Escapes Death
perks.desc:
Once the Exit Gates are powered, if there is still a Dull Totem remaining in the environment, Hex: No One Escapes Death activates and lights it:
Grants a 2/3/4 % Haste Status Effect.
Causes all Survivors to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect.
Once the Status Effect is revealed to Survivors, Hex: No One Escapes Death triggers the following effect:
The Aura of its Hex Totem is revealed to all Survivors within 4 metres.
This range gradually expands to 24 metres over the course of 30 seconds.
Hex: No One Escapes Death remains inactive if no Dull Totems are available.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

addons.name: Torn Novel
addons.comment: Gives useful aura reading abilities, increasing your chances to outplay a Survivor when manually redirecting your dog. The lingering aura afterwards is very useful to help keep track of them during chase.
addons.desc:
While possessing The Dog during the Chase Command to access the Redirect Chase ability, the following effect applies:
The Auras of Survivors within 10 metres of The Dog are revealed to you.
This effect lingers for 2 seconds after exiting the ability by any means.

addons.name: Barley Meal
addons.comment: Increasing the dog's initial chase range is unnecessary in most chase scenarios, but it can occasionally become useful when you're trying to interrupt a distant Survivor or send the dog around a distant corner. It also allows you to place the dog further in order to take control of it briefly and check if anyone is nearby with the built-in Killer Instinct detection, although this is something that can also be done without this add-on, albeit with reduced range. Do not underestimate how useful it is to use the dog this way.
addons.desc: Increases the distance of the Initial Chase Path by +20 %.

addons.name: Spiked Collar
addons.comment: Classic type of add-on that inflicts Mangled & Hemorrhage. Not bad, but the limited duration and inconsistent trigger condition means you won't benefit from it every single time.
addons.desc: Causes Survivors becoming injured while they were grabbed by The Dog to suffer from the Haemorrhage and Mangled Status Effects for 60 seconds.

addons.name: Iridescent Wheel Handle
addons.comment: Become undetectable whenever you send the dog out to search, making it possible to ambush Survivors throughout the match. Not a bad effect, especially if you have information perks to know where to strike. Keep in mind that it also makes the dog linger for longer at its target destination, which will slightly delay his return and availability.
addons.desc:
Increases the Linger duration of The Dog at the Target Location of the Search Command by +20 %.
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect while The Dog fulfils the Search Command.
Touching the Search Path as The Houndmaster immediately removes the Status Effect.

addons.name: Fatty Meat
addons.comment: Forces Survivors to scream, then scream again for a while. Extremely useful to trigger perks like Dead Man's Switch or interrupt Survivors from doing totems. Keep in mind that these screams do not reveal their location like usual.
addons.desc: Survivors affected by Houndsense periodically scream every 15 seconds, but without revealing their location to The Houndmaster.

addons.name: Unfinished Map
addons.comment: Allows you to chase Survivors with the certainty that their exhaustion perks won't come into play. Can even be triggered by performing a short distance search near a Survivor during chase. Not a bad effect at all.
addons.desc: Causes Survivors affected by Houndsense to also suffer from the Exhausted Status Effect for 15 seconds.

addons.name: Smoked Snapper
addons.comment: Reduces the short cooldown of the dog. Unfortunately, the cooldown is still largely variable based on how quickly the dog returns to you after certain actions.
addons.desc: Reduces the Power Recharge time by -5 %.

addons.name: Belaying Pins
addons.comment: Making Survivors oblivious to your terror radius is a neat effect but it will yield very inconsistent results depending on how coordinated their team is.
addons.desc: Causes Survivors affected by Houndsense to also suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect for 20 seconds.

addons.name: Ship Figurehead
addons.comment: Increases your terror radius when the dog is with you and decreases it when he's not. Can be used as part of a "big terror radius" type of build or to become extra sneaky with a smaller than usual terror radius. Just be sure to use your dog often if you're doing this, otherwise the larger terror radius will be a downside.
addons.desc:
The Terror Radius of The Houndmaster changes based on the proximity of The Dog:
Increases the Terror Radius by +8 metres while it is following.
Reduces the Terror Radius by -8 metres while it is away.

addons.name: Gunpowder Tin
addons.comment: Gives a small but noticeable boost to the action speed of breaking pallets, walls and generators. Not a bad effect, but the short duration makes it quite situational. Smart Survivors often don't drop pallets immediately against Houndmaster, so sometimes this add-on can really not do much at all.
addons.desc:
Increases the Action speeds for the following interactions by +30 % for 20 seconds after a Survivor becomes affected by Houndsense:
Breaking Breakable Walls.
Breaking Pallets.
Damaging Generators.

addons.name: Marlinspike
addons.comment: Applies the Houndsense debuff to other Survivors nearby when you catch someone with the dog. Not very useful by itself, but it can sometimes help reveal nearby targets and apply debuffs from other add-ons like the blue Unfinished Map if Survivors are being altruistic.
addons.desc:
Causes all Survivors within 20 metres of The Dog grabbing a Survivor to become affected by Houndsense.
Marlinspike does not affect the Grabbed Survivor.

addons.name: Sticky Pitch
addons.comment: This add-on only increases your speed by 2% when walking on the path left by the search command. This is a pretty minor effect when traversing the map, but experienced Houndmaster players can take advantage of it to help catch people in chase.
addons.desc: Increases the bonus Movement speed of The Houndmaster while walking along the Search Path by +2 %.

addons.name: Spyglass
addons.comment: Shows you the auras of Survivors when their Houndsense timer expires (but not if you make it go away by hitting them). Attentive players can use this to keep track of the team's general location or track down an elusive target. However, it's not a very proactive strategy and many times the Survivor with Houndsense will lose it by getting hit anyway.
addons.desc: The Auras of Survivors affected by Houndsense are revealed for 3 seconds after it ends.

addons.name: Trainer's Book
addons.comment: Increasing the duration of Houndsense provides a bigger window to put Survivors into the mending state and increases the effects of a few other add-ons. However, Houndsense simply doesn't do enough on its own to justify this add-on slot. You're better off with two add-ons that have actual powerful effects on their own.
addons.desc: Increases the duration of Houndsense by +35 %.

addons.name: Training Bell
addons.comment: Revealing a Survivor's aura for 5 seconds is a sweet effect, which could be enhanced further with Lethal Pursuer. However, you will rarely have a match where the dog gets stunned often enough to justify bringing this add-on.
addons.desc: The Aura of the Survivor responsible for stunning The Dog is revealed to you for 8 seconds.

addons.name: Creature's Bone
addons.comment: This add-on can help you bounce back from a mistake by allowing your dog to be used sooner after it gets stunned by a pallet. That being said, stuns are rare during normal gameplay or often happen in situations where the shorter cooldown does not really come into play. It's a safe choice for beginners due to its availability, but you might want to run something a bit more impactful.
addons.desc: Reduces the Stun duration of The Dog by -50 %.

addons.name: Knotted Rope
addons.comment: The reduction of your main attack's cooldown is a universally useful effect, however this add-on was nerfed very severely until a future rework. Right now it only has a 2% effect which is completely negligible. Do not bother using it.
addons.desc: Reduces the Attack cool-down of successful Basic Attacks on Survivors caught in the grasp of The Dog by -2 %.

addons.name: Young Coconut
addons.comment: THIS ADD-ON IS CURRENTLY BUGGED and doesn't seem to work at all. Slightly increases the dog's speed when chasing, making you have an easier time catching up to Survivors before they reach safety. Not a bad effect at all for an add-on of this rarity.
addons.desc: Increases the Chase speed of The Dog by +5 %.

addons.name: Leather Harness
addons.comment: THIS ADD-ON IS CURRENTLY BUGGED and doesn't seem to work at all. Gives a large boost to the dog's speed after a gen is completed (for a short time) and after all gens are completed (permanently). Best used on endgame builds that can extend the duration of this part of the match.
addons.desc:
Whenever a Generator is completed, Leather Harness triggers its effect for 30 seconds:
Increases the Chase speed of The Dog by +20 %.
Leather Harness applies its effect permanently after all Generators are completed.

addons.name: Waterskin
addons.comment: Increases the maximum distance the dog will travel when manually redirected during chase. There's almost zero situations where this distance will make a real difference, and sending the dog further might end up costing you since his cooldown only resets when he has returned to you. Unless you really know what you're doing, you're better off without this add-on.
addons.desc: Increases the distance of the Redirected Chase Path by +20 %.

Blocks all upright Pallets within 32 metres of that Survivor.

The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

Whenever a Survivor is hooked onto a Scourge Hook for the first time, Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance consumes -1 Token and applies the following effects:
Causes the Generator with the most progression to explode, damaging it.
Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by 10/15/20 % of its total Progression.
Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors repairing the Damaged Generator to scream.
This does not trigger a Loud Noise Notification.
Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance is disabled for the remainder of the Trial once all Tokens are consumed.
perks.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance

perks.desc:
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Each time a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook, the following effects apply:
The Auras of all other Survivors are revealed for 5/6/7 seconds.
perks.name: Scourge Hook: Floods of Rage

perks.desc:
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Whenever a Survivor is unhooked from a normal Hook, the following effect applies:
The Hook is converted into a Scourge Hook.
Whenever you hook a Survivor onto a Scourge Hook, the following effect applies:
The Aura of the Generator with the most progression is highlighted in yellow for 6/8/10 seconds.
perks.name: Scourge Hook: Jagged Compass

perks.desc:
A deep bond with The Entity unlocks potential in one's Aura-reading ability.
After hooking a Survivor, all Survivors who are at least 60/50/40 metres away from that Hook have their Aura revealed to you for 5 seconds.
perks.name: Barbecue & Chili

perks.desc:
As soon as at least one Exit Gate is opened, Blood Warden activates:
The Auras of Survivors are revealed to you, whenever they are inside the Exit Gate.
Once per Trial, hooking a Survivor while Blood Warden is active calls upon The Entity to trigger the following effect:
Blocks all opened Exit Gates for 40/50/60 seconds, preventing any remaining Survivor from leaving the Trial through them.
perks.name: Blood Warden

perks.desc:
You benefit from the following permanent effect:
Increases your Vaulting speed by 5/10/15 %.
Whenever you vault a Window, Bamboozle calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks it to all Survivors for 8/12/16 seconds.
Vaulting it again within that time resets the timer.
Vaulting a different one transfers the effect to it instead.
Bamboozle does not extend its effects to vaulting a dropped Pallet.
perks.name: Bamboozle

perks.desc:
Overwhelming pain reverberates outwards.

The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Start the Trial with 4 Token.
Whenever a Survivor is hooked onto a Scourge Hook for the first time, Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance consumes -1 Token and applies the following effects:

Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by 10/15/20 % of its total Progression.

Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance is disabled for the remainder of the Trial once all Tokens are consumed.

perks.desc: Identical to Cull the Weak.
perks.name: Dying Light

perks.desc: Identical to Keep Them Waiting.
perks.name: Save the best for last

perks.desc:
You move with a speed and fury that makes blood run cold.
You can no longer gain the Bloodlust Status Effect.
Successfully hitting a Survivor with a Basic Attack grants you a +5 % Haste Status Effect for 8/9/10 seconds.
perks.name: Rapid Brutality

perks.desc: Every 30 seconds, if the Obsession is 40 metres away from you, you see their aura for 2/2.5/3 seconds. Otherwise, the farthest Survivor becomes the Obsession.
perks.name: Celestial Witness

killers.name: The Ghoul
killers.otzComment:
The Ghoul is a high-mobility Killer with a unique ability that makes injuring Survivors very easy. While this ability does not let him down Survivors directly, it still provides a lot of utility to help end chases fast. Thanks to his average 4.6m/s speed, you can play him as a regular Killer and slowly use his power in chase more and more often as you become experienced with him.
Despite being relatively easy for beginners to learn, Kaneki has a tremendously high skill ceiling for any player that wants to master the use of his power. His perks can sometimes be useful in very niche builds, but they are overall not the absolute best for beginners.

teachables.name: Forever Entwined
teachables.desc:
Whenever a Survivors takes damage, Forever Entwined gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 6/7/8 Tokens:
Increases the Action speeds for Dropping, Hooking, and Picking up a Survivor by a stack-able +4 % per Token, up to a maximum of 24/28/32 %.

teachables.name: Hex: Nothing But Misery
teachables.desc:
After damaging Survivors a total of 4 times with Basic Attacks, a random Dull Totem becomes a Hex Totem, cursing all Survivors:
Survivors damaged by a Basic Attack suffer from:
-5 % Hindered Status Effect for 10/12.5/15 seconds.
-10 % slower vaulting speed for 10/12.5/15 seconds.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

teachables.name: None Are Free
teachables.desc:
Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, None Are Free gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 4 Tokens.
Once all Generators are completed, None Are Free calls upon The Entity to trigger the following effect:
Blocks all Windows and upright Pallets for a stack-able 12/14/16 seconds per Token, up to a maximum of 48/56/64 seconds.

builds.name: Generic Build
notes: Reliable and well-rounded build; a good starting point until you find the ideal build for your playstyle.
This build is heavily based on Scourge Hook perks; even if you're unlucky with the scourge hook spawn, you will be able to create new ones with Jagged Compass!

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance
perks.desc:
Overwhelming pain reverberates outwards.
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Start the Trial with 4 Token.
Whenever a Survivor is hooked onto a Scourge Hook for the first time, Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance consumes -1 Token and applies the following effects:
Causes the Generator with the most progression to explode, damaging it.
Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by 10/15/20 % of its total Progression.
Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing afterwards.
Causes all Survivors repairing the Damaged Generator to scream.
This does not trigger a Loud Noise Notification.
Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance is disabled for the remainder of the Trial once all Tokens are consumed.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Jagged Compass
perks.desc:

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked from a normal Hook, the following effect applies:
The Hook is converted into a Scourge Hook.
Whenever you hook a Survivor onto a Scourge Hook, the following effect applies:
The Aura of the Generator with the most progression is highlighted in yellow for 6/8/10 seconds.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Monstrous Shrine
perks.desc:
At the start of the Trial, the 4 Hooks located inside the Basement and an additional 4 Hooks located throughout the Trial Grounds are all changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of Scourge Hooks are highlighted to you in white.
Whenever you are farther than 24 metres from a Survivor hooked onto a Scourge Hook, the following effect applies:
All Generators regress at 150/175/200 % of the default Regression rate.

alts.name: Scourge Hook: Floods of Rage
alts.desc:
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Each time a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook, the following effects apply:
The Auras of all other Survivors are revealed for 5/6/7 seconds.

alts.name: Scourge Hook: Hangman's Trick
alts.desc:
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
While carrying a Survivor, Scourge Hook: Hangman's Trick triggers its primary effect:
The Auras of all Survivors within 12/14/16 metres of a Scourge Hook are revealed to you.
Whenever a Survivor starts the Sabotage action on any Hook, Scourge Hook: Hangman's Trick triggers its secondary effect:
Triggers a Loud Noise Notification at the location of that Hook.

alts.name: Barbecue & Chilli
alts.desc:
A deep bond with The Entity unlocks potential in one's Aura-reading ability.
After hooking a Survivor, all Survivors who are at least 60/50/40 metres away from that Hook have their Aura revealed to you for 5 seconds.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Weeping Wounds
perks.desc:
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Each time a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook, the following effects apply:
Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Haemorrhage Status Effect for 90 seconds.
After the first time that Survivor is healed back to full health, they suffer from the following effect until they are injured again by any means:
Reduces their Action speeds for Healing and Repairing by 10/13/16 %.

alts.name: Coup de Grâce
alts.desc:
As the end nears, you go in for the kill.
Whenever a Generator is completed, Coup de Grâce gains +2 Tokens, up to a maximum of 10 Tokens per Trial:
Increases the range of your next Lunge Attack by 70/75/80 %, while consuming -1 Token.
Coup de Grâce can only hold a maximum of 5 Tokens at a time.

alts.name: Enduring
alts.desc:
You benefit from the following effect:
Reduces the duration of Pallet Stuns by 40/45/50 %.
This effect does not apply when stunned while carrying a Survivor.

perks.name: Hex: Ruin
perks.desc:
All Generators not currently being repaired experience the following effect:
Causes them to automatically regress at 100/125/150 % of the default Regression rate.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Hex: Undying
perks.desc:
Whenever a Survivor is within 2/3/4 metres of a Dull Totem, Hex: Undying triggers its primary effect:
Their Aura is revealed to you for as long as they remain in that range.
Whenever a Hex Totem is cleansed, Hex: Undying triggers its secondary effect:
Transfers the cleansed Hex to the Hex Totem associated with Hex: Undying instead, replacing it.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

alts.name: Hex: Thrill of the Hunt
alts.desc:
If there is still a Dull Totem in the environment, Hex: Thrill of the Hunt lights a Hex Totem whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, cursing them with its Hex Effects.
For each lit Hex Totem located in the environment, gain a token.
Hooking a Survivor causes all Totems to be blocked by the Entity by a stack-able 4/5/6 seconds per Token, up to a maximum of 20/25/30 seconds.
Hex: Thrill of the Hunt loses -1 Token whenever a Hex Totem is cleansed.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Hex: Hive Mind
perks.desc:
The first time you hook any Survivor, a random Dull Totem becomes a Hex Totem, provided that a Dull Totem remains in the Trial Grounds.
Generators are highlighted; the intensity of the generator's Auras reveals their repair progress.
As soon as a total of 4 generators have been completed in the Trial:
All remaining generators explode, lose 6/8/10 % progess, and start regressing.
The associated Hex Totem becomes dull, and this perk becomes disabled for the remainder of the trial.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Hex: Pentimento
perks.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability:
The Auras of cleansed Totems are revealed to you in white.
Press the Interaction button over the remains of a cleansed Totem to resurrect it as a Rekindled Totem.
For each Rekindled Totem, Hex: Pentimento gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 5 Tokens:
1 Token: Reduces the Action speeds for Healing and Repairing by -20 %.
2 to 5 Tokens: Increase the strength of the Action Speed penalty by a stackable 1/2/3 % per Token, up to a maximum of 24/28/32 %.
Survivors cursed by Hex: Pentimento see the Auras of Rekindled Totems within 16 metres.
Once Hex: Pentimento has reached its limit of 5 Tokens, it calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks all Rekindled Totems for the remainder of the Trial.
Totems may only be rekindled once per Trial, with The Entity consuming the remains of Rekindled Totems once they are cleansed.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

perks.name: Lethal Pursuer
perks.desc:
At the start of the Trial, the Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 7/8/9 seconds.
Extends the duration of all instances of a Survivor Aura being revealed to you by +2 seconds.
Lethal Pursuer benefits from its own effect.

perks.name: Alien Instinct
perks.desc:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, Alien Instinct activates:
The Aura of the farthest Survivor from your current location who is in the Injured State is revealed to you for 8 seconds.
Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect for 40/50/60 seconds.

alts.name: Barbecue & Chilli
alts.desc:
A deep bond with The Entity unlocks potential in one's Aura-reading ability.
After hooking a Survivor, all Survivors who are at least 60/50/40 metres away from that Hook have their Aura revealed to you for 5 seconds.

alts.name: Friends 'til the End
alts.desc:
When you hook any Survivors that is not the Obsession, the following effects apply to the Obsession:
Their Aura is revealed for 6/8/10 seconds.
They suffer from the Exposed Status Effect for 20 seconds.
When you hook the Obsession, the following effects apply to a random Survivor:
Causes the Survivor to scream and reveal their location to the Killer.
They become the new Obsession.
You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

perks.name: Dead Man's Switch
perks.desc:
After hooking a Survivor, Dead Man's Switch triggers its effect:
The first Generator any Survivor stops repairing for 2 seconds is blocked for 30/35/40 seconds
The Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.
Dead Man's Switch cannot activate if its effect is still active from a previous activation.

alts.name: Pop Goes the Weasel
alts.desc:
After hooking a Survivor, Pop Goes the Weasel activates for 35/40/45 seconds.
While active, manually damaging a Generator triggers the following effect:
Increases the regression amount by +15 % resulting in 20 % regression.
Pop Goes the Weasel deactivates after use or once its timer elapses.

alts.name: Nowhere to Hide
alts.desc:
Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator triggers Nowhere to Hide:
The Auras of all Survivors within 24 metres of the Generator's location are revealed to you for 3/4/5 seconds.

perks.name: Grim Embrace
perks.desc:
Your act of servitude to The Entity has not gone unnoticed.
Each time a Survivor is hooked for the first time, Grim Embrace gains +1 Token and activates once you are at least 16 metres away from the Hook:
1-3 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 6/8/10 seconds.
4 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 40 seconds and the Aura of the Obsession is revealed to you for 6 seconds.

alts.name: No Way Out
alts.desc:
Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, No Way Out gains +1 Token.
Once the Exit Gates are powered, No Way Out activates:
Causes the first Survivor to interact with either Exit Gate Switch to trigger a Loud Noise Notification at their location.
Upon triggering the Loud Noise Notification, No Way Out calls upon The Entity for the following effect:
Blocks both Exit Gate Switches for 12 seconds.
This time is extended by an additional 6/9/12 seconds per accumulated Token, up to a combined maximum of 36/48/60 seconds.

builds.name: Beginner Perks Only
notes: Only uses perks available to this Killer or global perks available to everyone. It might include some alternative perk ideas from one of the five free Killers too.

perks.name: No Holds Barred
perks.desc:
Each time a Generator is completed, No Holds Barred calls upon The Entity for the following effects:
Blocks the Generator with the most Progression for 15/20/25 seconds.
The Aura of the Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.

perks.name: Sloppy Butcher
perks.desc:
Survivors hit with your vicious Basic Attack suffer from the following effects for 70/80/90 seconds:
Inflicts the Haemorrhage and Mangled Status Effects.
Modifies the potency of Haemorrhage:
Increases the Spawn frequency of Pools of Blood by 50/75/100 %.
Increases the Regression rate of partial Healing progression by +25 %.

alts.name: Scourge Hook: Weeping Wounds
alts.desc:
At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks:
The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white.
Each time a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook, the following effects apply:
Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Haemorrhage Status Effect for 90 seconds.
After the first time that Survivor is healed back to full health, they suffer from the following effect until they are injured again by any means:
Reduces their Action speeds for Healing and Repairing by 10/13/16 %.

perks.name: Forever Entwined
perks.desc:
Whenever a Survivors takes damage, Forever Entwined gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 6/7/8 Tokens:
Increases the Action speeds for Dropping, Hooking, and Picking up a Survivor by a stack-able +4 % per Token, up to a maximum of 24/28/32 %.

perks.name: Hex: Fortune's Fool
perks.desc:
If there is still a Dull Totem in the environment, Hex: Fortune's Fool lights a Hex Totem whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, cursing them with its Hex Effects.
Inflicts the Oblivious Status Effect.
Blocks the Hex Totem for all other Survivors for 90 seconds.
Blocked Hex Totems cannot be cleansed or blessed by Survivors.
This does not affect the Cursed Survivor.
The Aura of the Hex Totem is revealed to the Cursed Survivor within 24/20/16 metres.
The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.

addons.name: Yamori's Mask
addons.comment: Makes other Survivors scream when hooking someone while enraged as long as they are 40 meters away. Since enraged is fairly easy to keep going, this add-on can trigger many times during a match and will certainly provide very valuable information for such a high-mobility Killer. The scream also forces Survivors to interrupt their action, which can trigger perks such as Dead Man's Switch or completely reset the progress of a totem cleansing action.
addons.desc:
Hooking a Survivor while in Enraged Mode triggers the following effect:
Causes all Survivors further than 40 metres to scream and reveal their location to you for 3 seconds.

addons.name: Fresh Coffee
addons.comment: Provides a small increase to your leaping speed, something universally useful whether you're enraged or not. The effect is not incredibly noticeable, but it's certainly there and will probably be quite helpful over the course of the match.
addons.desc: Increases the Movement speed during Kagune Leaps by +2 m/s.

addons.name: Red-Headed Centipede
addons.comment: Blocks windows after vaulting them in any way while you're enraged. Since staying enraged constantly is fairly easy, you'll be able to use it very often. Blocking windows isn't always extremely necessary with this Killer, but it can help you shut down structures like shack very quickly, forcing Survivors to give up resources even faster.
addons.desc:
Performing a Vault action while in Enraged Mode triggers the following effect:
Blocks that Window to all Survivors for 10 seconds.

addons.name: Rize's Glasses
addons.comment: Shows auras of Survivors when you enter enraged mode. You should ideally not be losing enraged mode very frequently but being occasionally aware of Survivor locations is really helpful due to the Ghoul's immense mobility.
addons.desc:
Upon entering Enraged Mode, you benefit from the following effect:
The Auras of healthy Survivors currently repairing a Generator are revealed to you for 8 seconds.

addons.name: Blood-Stained Handkerchief
addons.comment: Extends the maximum distance that you can reach with your kagune tentacles, effectively making it easier to travel longer distances a bit more consistently. The effect is not huge, however, as it's only one extra meter.
addons.desc: Increases the maximum reach of Kagune Leaps by +1 metre.

addons.name: Iridescent Eye Patch
addons.comment: Automatically destroys pallets that you vault during your third leap, which can only be done during enraged mode. Trying to trigger it constantly in chase is not recommended, as it might actually backfire. Instead, it's best to use it occasionally when the right opportunity presents itself during chase. You can also use it outside of chase to clean up dropped pallets while you traverse the map. When used correctly, the effect is certainly quite decent.
addons.desc:
Unlocks potential in the third consecutive Kagune Leap while in Enraged Mode:
If used to vault a dropped Pallet, it instantly breaks.

addons.name: Hide's Headphones
addons.comment: Gives Survivors the Oblivious status effect for as long as they're marked, which typically lasts for as long as they're in deep wound. Even if you decide not to chase them, they might still waste a bit of time being extra cautious. Not a bad effect for its rarity.
addons.desc:
Survivors affected by the Kagune Mark experience the following effect while carrying it:
Causes them to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect until the mark is removed.

addons.name: Broken Chain
addons.comment: This add-on noticeably shortens the power recovery after you use your leap, allowing you to use it again much sooner, but only when you're not enraged. Since it's very easy to keep the enraged status going, this add-on will often be inactive. That being said, it's still quite helpful and can help you ensure that you put pressure on Survivors with minimal downtime at key times, such as the start of the game. Not a bad effect for an add-on of this rarity.
addons.desc: Reduces the Cool-down duration of Kagune Leap by -1.4 seconds per Token when outside of Enraged Mode.

addons.name: Kaneki's Satchel
addons.comment: Provides a significant boost of 30% speed to the final third leap, which only happens when you're enraged. This effect seems quite significant, but do keep in mind that your final leap never has any sliding and that it will typically be much shorter than the initial ones. For that reason, the effect of this add-on is somewhat diminished. Still not a bad effect, especially considering its rarity.
addons.desc: Increases the Movement speed of the third consecutive Kagune Leap by +4.2 m/s.

addons.name: Amon's Necktie
addons.comment: Highlights the auras of nearby points of safety similarly to Zanshin Tactics' or Windows of Opportunity's effect, but only during the brief period between leaps instead of permanently. This effect isn't incredibly impactful but it can occasionally improve your awareness of your surroundings and help you in chase. Pairs well with the purple Red-Headed Centipede add-on to help you remember where you've left dropped pallets so you can break them with your vault.
addons.desc:
While aiming Mid-Leap, you benefit from the following effect:
The Auras of Pallets and Windows are revealed to you within 32 metres.

addons.name: Kaneki's Wallet
addons.comment: Greatly extends the time between leaps during which you can damage a Survivor with your tentacle. Similar effect to Wesker's Egg or Nurse's Watch, but since you can manually end this period with a button press, this add-on does not actually have any downsides. The effect of this add-on is quite noticeable and can sometimes help you land a hit after maneveuring around some obstacles, but the situations where it makes a difference are very rare. Keep in mind that during this period, your movement speed is very slow and you cannot navigate your surroundings effectively. If you find yourself unable to land a hit after leaping, it's sometimes best to cancel your second leap manually since you'll be able to try again very soon anyway.
addons.desc: Extends the window of opportunity to perform consecutive Kagune Leaps by +3 seconds.

addons.name: Hinami's Umbrella
addons.comment: This add-on provides a 10 second increase to your enraged mode timer, but only if you hit the "perfect timing" prompt that occurs when you initially injure someone with your power. If you press the attack button at the perfect time, you'll hear a sound effect and see a score bonus confirming that you did it correctly. This effect helps you to stay in this mode more consistently, but it's not extremely necessary.
addons.desc: Increases the amount of time added to the Countdown for each perfectly timed Grab-Attack by +10 seconds.

addons.name: Red Spider Lily
addons.comment: Makes your basic attacks apply the Haemorrhage status effect for 60 seconds while enraged, which is typically pretty often. This can occasionally waste their healing progress when interrupted, but this is simply not that terribly necessary for a Killer that already has such an easy time injuring Survivors repeatedly anyway.
addons.desc:
Survivors hit with a Basic Attack while in Enraged Mode inflicts the following effect:
Causes them to suffer from the Haemorrhage Status Effect for 60 seconds.

addons.name: Mado's Glove
addons.comment: Inflicts a decently long 15 seconds of Exhaustion status effect to any Survivor that removes the kagune mark, which typically happens when they mend their deep wound status effect. This does not normally provide any value during prolonged chase, but it can occasionally rob Survivors of their exhaustion perks when you're bouncing between multiple targets. Not a terrible effect, but it's quite hard to know when exactly it is being helpful.
addons.desc:
Survivors affected by the Kagune Mark experience the following effect after it is removed:
Causes them to suffer from the Exhausted Status Effect for 15 seconds.

addons.name: Aogiri Tree Robe
addons.comment: Gives you Undetectable status effect for a few seconds when a generator gets repaired and you're enraged, which will be more often than not. This can occasionally help you catch someone by surprise, but since you don't really control it, it has far fewer chances to be useful compared to the green Hide's Headphones, which can be triggered many times in a match.
addons.desc:
Whenever a Generator is completed while in Enraged Mode, you benefit from the following effect:
Grants the Undetectable Status Effect for 20 seconds.

addons.name: Taiyaki
addons.comment: Slightly extends the timer of your enraged status effect, giving you more time to keep it going before it disappears. This effect seems really useful, but the current timer is already quite generous and you can easily keep it going for as long as you don't lose track of Survivors for a while. For that reason, this add-on will most likely feel redundant.
addons.desc: Extends the Countdown by +5 seconds.

addons.name: CCG ID Card
addons.comment: This add-on reveals the auras of Survivors when you perform a vault using your leap. Sounds useful in theory, but keep in mind that this aura reveal is extremely brief and it'll typically happen when the Survivor is already in front of you. It also only reveals Survivors that are marked by your power. This add-on might occasionally reveal someone hiding nearby or allow you to pull off some unusual mindgame, but it's extremely situational and generally not worth bringing.
addons.desc:
Performing a Kagune Leap Vault action triggers the following effect:
The Auras of all Survivors affected by the Kagune Mark are revealed to you within 24 metres of your location for 3 seconds.

addons.name: Torture Apparatus
addons.comment: This add-on gives a very tiny haste effect that boosts your movement speed for a few seconds. This effect is supposed to help you bounce back after you've lost your enraged status, but if you play the Ghoul properly you will not lose it very often. You could quite literally play through an entire match and only trigger this add-on a few times, typically outside of chase. It's most definitely not worth running.
addons.desc:
Whenever Enraged Mode ends, you benefit from the following effect:
Grants a +5 % Haste Status Effect for 6 seconds.

addons.name: The Black Goat's Egg
addons.comment: This add-on has zero effect on gameplay. It only provides additional bloodpoints when you successfully click the "attack" when the icon flashes on screen when you're injuring someone with your kagune tentacle. In case you're not aware, getting this perfect time awards extra points and makes the enraged mode last longer, but that's about it.
addons.desc: Succeeding the Quick Time Event during a Grab-Attack grants +100 % bonus Bloodpoints.

addons.name: Anteiku Apron
addons.comment: This add-on removes the "slide" that occurs after leaping. This makes it slightly easier to control your movement but it's overall a really awful effect, since the sliding gives you extra distance and is very worth keeping. Keep in mind that your final leap already lacks any sliding and that you can also minimize the slide by cancelling the leap mid-air without the use of this add-on. killers.name: The Animatronic
killers.otzComment:
The Animatronic is a powerful ranged Killer that can threaten Survivors from a short distance with his throwable fire axe. He can enter any of the seven security doors to quickly traverse across the map, become stealthy and possibly catch someone by surprise. At higher levels, you'll also need to be prepared to deal with Survivors using your security door cameras against you. Don't forget that you are slightly slower than the normal Killer speed while you're holding the axe, so it's okay to not recall it immediately after you've thrown it!
The Animatronic's power is fairly simple to grasp for newer players but also has a profound skill ceiling for dedicated players willing to learn it. Help Wanted is a phenomenal perk that works great on him and especially other Killers that rely mostly on their basic attack. Phantom Fear is a very decent option to track sneaky Survivors (especially for Killers that don't lose their terror radius like Springtrap does). Haywire is a really useless endgame perk that's almost never worth running.

teachables.desc:

Causes Survivors to see the lights atop the switch flickering randomly while it regresses.

The Auras of all Compromised Generators are highlighted to you in yellow.
Once a Compromised Generator is completed, Help Wanted triggers its effects for 70/80/90 seconds:
Increases the Recovery speed of successful Basic Attacks by +25 %.
All Generators not being repaired will automatically regress at 150 % of the default Regression rate.
Additionally, all other Generators are no longer Compromised.
